Account opening/closure scored in Part 04, complete Pay Part 06, staff workspace Part 08, full Admin reversal Part 12 and full Android Part 14 are not rescored.
- **Complete workflow steps:** Web FinancialForm stores raw decimal text; lib/finance/money.ts accepts positive plain decimal with <=2 fractional digits, rejects scientific, symbols, negatives, zero; transactionsApi sends JSON string amount (not JS Number) via BFF. Spring DepositRequest/WithdrawalRequest/TransferRequest use StrictDecimalTextDeserializer rejecting JSON numeric token; FinancialWorkflowServiceImpl calls MonetaryAmount.fromCustomerInput with CurrencyCode.LKR, BigDecimal plain regex, scale <=2, positive, normalizes to scale4 with UNNECESSARY (no rounding). PostingEngine total maximum 999999999999999.9999, Account.balance and SQL journal/posting/transactions DECIMAL(19,4). JSON account/receipt numeric BigDecimal parsed as decimal strings by web HTTP layer; web display preserves server string. CurrencyCode validates ISO-4217 formatting and registry, but customer finance workflows hardcode LKR.

#### TXN-009 — Bounded fresh-transaction deadlock retry for financial commands

- **Review part:** 05 — banking transactions and double-entry ledger.
- **User roles:** Internal financial service, indirectly customer/admin endpoints.
- **User objective:** Retry safe MySQL deadlock rollbacks without duplicating financial effects.
- **Workflow boundary:** Retry safe MySQL deadlock rollbacks without duplicating financial effects; scoped to the concrete client or internal operation named here. Account opening/closure scored in Part 04, complete Pay Part 06, staff workspace Part 08, full Admin reversal Part 12 and full Android Part 14 are not rescored.
- **Complete workflow steps:** FinancialWorkflowServiceImpl deposit/withdraw/transfer delegates complete coordinator+posting action to BoundedFinancialTransactionRetryExecutor, which uses FinancialTransactionAttempt @Transactional(REQUIRES_NEW) for each attempt, up to 3 attempts with 25ms/50ms backoff. TransientTransactionFailureClassifier retries MySQL deadlock 1213 or SQLSTATE 40001, explicitly excludes lock-wait timeout 1205 even if wrapped. ReversalWorkflow also uses executor. Retry exhaust maps to 503 ERR_TRANSACTION_TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE; no partial ledger rows if attempt rolled back; idempotency claim is recreated/reused safely.

#### TXN-011 — Synchronous ledger-to-legacy transaction history projection

- **Review part:** 05 — banking transactions and double-entry ledger.
- **User roles:** Internal posting path; account owner history reads.
- **User objective:** Expose immutable posted journal effects as account transaction-history rows.
- **Workflow boundary:** Expose immutable posted journal effects as account transaction-history rows; scoped to the concrete client or internal operation named here. - **Complete workflow steps:** PostingEngineImpl after journal and posting legs synchronously calls LegacyTransactionProjectionServiceImpl with journal + net customer balance deltas and locked Accounts. For DEPOSIT creates 1 Transaction(type DEPOSIT, positive amount, balanceAfter, journalEntryId); for WITHDRAWAL 1 WITHDRAWAL, amount positive; TRANSFER creates 2 rows TRANSFER_OUT/TRANSFER_IN sharing one journalEntryId; reversal inserts compensating rows reflecting inverse signs/transaction types. Projection uses @Transactional(MANDATORY), repository save and V4 UNIQUE(journal_entry_id,account_id); failure of second row/DB trigger rolls back account balances/journal/previous projection. Pre-ledger historic rows may have null journal_entry_id and remain queryable.

#### TXN-015 — Admin-only journal reversal and compensating postings API

- **Review part:** 05 — banking transactions and double-entry ledger.
- **User roles:** ADMIN direct API; no connected Admin web UI confirmed.
- **User objective:** Correct a posted eligible journal without editing original financial history.
- **Workflow boundary:** Correct a posted eligible journal without editing original financial history; scoped to the concrete client or internal operation named here. Account opening/closure scored in Part 04, complete Pay Part 06, staff workspace Part 08, full Admin reversal Part 12 and full Android Part 14 are not rescored.
- **Complete workflow steps:** TransactionController POST /api/v1/transactions/{journalEntryId}/reversal @PreAuthorize ADMIN with ReversalRequest {reason:not blank}, authenticates actor. ReversalWorkflowImpl -> bounded fresh retry -> PostingEngineImpl.postReversal, locks original POSTED journal row, disallows reverse of REVERSAL/OPENING_BALANCE, validates original shape/class/currency/postings and active accounts, queries existing reversal_of natural unique identity, inserts new REVERSAL journal and opposite debit/credit postings, applies inverse customer Account.balance and creates inverse legacy Transaction projection. Repeat original returns natural replay receipt with reversalJournalEntryId, original id, amount/currency, resulting balances, postedAt. If original funds already spent and reversal would overdraw, rejects atomically. No unambiguous journal-list/read API or connected Admin reversal form; web transactionsApi.reverse client helper is not a workflow.

#### TXN-019 — Ledger migration, balance cutover and legacy-history compatibility

- **Review part:** 05 — banking transactions and double-entry ledger.
- **User roles:** Flyway database bootstrap/migration infrastructure.
- **User objective:** Introduce double-entry accounting without silently losing existing stored balances/history.
- **Workflow boundary:** Introduce double-entry accounting without silently losing existing stored balances/history; scoped to the concrete client or internal operation named here. Account opening/closure scored in Part 04, complete Pay Part 06, staff workspace Part 08, full Admin reversal Part 12 and full Android Part 14 are not rescored.
- **Complete workflow steps:** Flyway V1 baseline stores Account and legacy transactions. V2 adds accounts.currency, ledger_accounts, journal_entries, journal_postings and core_transaction_idempotency with constraints. V3 prechecks no negative balances, only LKR, no ledger cutover marker/preexisting ledger rows; then one SQL transaction with exception rollback persists ledger_cutover_at marker, seeds SYSTEM_VAULT_CASH:LKR and SYSTEM_OPENING_BALANCE:LKR, creates a customer LIABILITY ledger account for each existing Account, and for preexisting positive balances writes POSTED OPENING_BALANCE journal with debit SYSTEM_OPENING_BALANCE asset and credit customer LIABILITY. Legacy Account.balance and transactions remain unchanged. V4 adds journalEntryId nullable FK and UNIQUE(journal_entry_id,account_id), upgrades legacy transaction decimals to scale4. Runtime PostingEngine rejects OPENING_BALANCE (migration-only) and reversals use dedicated method. Source migration tests cover preconditions, rollback/second startup and preserved balances.
- **Frontend / Android:** Web: Not applicable (no independent client/transport for this scoped feature). Android: Not applicable (no independent client/transport for this scoped feature).
- **Next.js BFF / API integration:** Not applicable (no independent client/transport for this scoped feature).. Web calls use CSRF-aware authenticated Next BFF forwarding; Android Core reads use direct Retrofit bearer.
- **Spring Boot implementation:** [core/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/ledger/domain/JournalEntryType.java](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-core/blob/9f58e595a653db9d8aa59b70a35af8e2b0e725d3/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/ledger/domain/JournalEntryType.java); [core/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/ledger/application/impl/PostingEngineImpl.java](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-core/blob/9f58e595a653db9d8aa59b70a35af8e2b0e725d3/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/ledger/application/impl/PostingEngineImpl.java); [core/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/accounts/domain/Account.java](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-core/blob/9f58e595a653db9d8aa59b70a35af8e2b0e725d3/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/accounts/domain/Account.java)
- **Database / ledger:** V1/V2/V3/V4 migrations; V3 is idempotent-by-precondition not a recurring posting workflow; V2 journal status only POSTED and ledger account separate from Account.
- **External dependencies:** Internal Spring + MySQL/ledger where described; no source-confirmed external cash settlement, third-party processor, or FastAPI dependency for these financial workflows.

### Part 06 — Internal Pay and receipt recovery

**Status:** COMPLETE — GitHub source-inspected assessment, not observed live browser/Core/MySQL acceptance.

**Reconfirmed repository main HEADs on 2026-11-24:** bank-web `012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27`; bank-core `9f58e595a653db9d8aa59b70a35af8e2b0e725d3`; bank-service `cabdd323b4aa394910cb192ead6d233e9a12d9d3`; bank-app `9d98ba24cb754b8295bd58770cd502438d3b7b38`. All four match Part 05 pinned baselines. Relevant bank-web, bank-core and bank-app trees were fully enumerated (not truncated) and implementation/test paths read. bank-service has no evidenced Internal Pay integration; no artificial KYC/ML financial dependency or source inspection is claimed.

**Scope:** Customer Pay-specific entry, recipient, exact amount, review, transfer API, ownership, atomic internal payment, durable key, payer receipt, authorized receipt lookup, automatic postcommit recovery, unresolved precommit handling, same-key manual retry, payment errors, activity discoverability, and Android transfer preview. Underlying ledger architecture (TXN-003/005/006/007/008/009/011/012) is referenced, not re-scored; account opening/ownership/status ACC-003/005/006/012, full journal reversal Part12, PayHere/external payments Part13, full Android Part14 remain distinct.

### Actual customer Pay journey

`CUSTOMER authenticated login → AppHeader Pay → /customer/pay or /customer/transactions/transfer → InternalPaymentForm` ([bank-web/app/(customer)/customer/pay/page.tsx](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/app/(customer)/customer/pay/page.tsx); [bank-web/app/(customer)/customer/transactions/transfer/page.tsx](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/app/(customer)/customer/transactions/transfer/page.tsx); [bank-web/components/banking/InternalPaymentForm.tsx](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/components/banking/InternalPaymentForm.tsx)). On mount it loads GET `/api/v1/accounts/my`, filters actual `ACTIVE` accounts with UUID IDs, defaults first, shows account number/type/LKR stored balance and offers source selection. If no eligible account it shows guidance and disables Review; if fetch fails it offers Reload. Banking Customer linkage and latest KYC are previously established at self-service account opening, but this payment does **not** re-check KYC or Customer.status on every transfer.

Recipient is entered as raw **destination Account UUID**, not 10-digit account number, User UUID or Customer UUID. The form requests that the recipient share UUID from account history. It checks UUID formatting and distinctness but offers no human-recipient name, verification lookup, account number resolution, saved beneficiary or recipient address book. Core validates the actual destination ACTIVE/LKR/mapping independently and permits other Customer's account or own distinct account; the sender must own source account. Frontend does not expose the destination owner's private details.

The amount stays an exact decimal **string**, displayed in a review snapshot together with payer's account number/type and destination UUID. `0010.20` stays `"0010.20"` in JSON; Core normalizes to `10.2000` BigDecimal for ledger/receipt comparison. Positive LKR amount has at most two fractional digits, no scientific notation or silent rounding; monetary storage uses four-digit DECIMAL(19,4). Edit returns to draft with existing fields. **The idempotency key is generated only at explicit Confirm payment**, using browser crypto.randomUUID; confirm locks against duplicate clicks with busy/inFlight state.

### Transfer POST contract and financial write

`transactionsApi.transfer(payload,key) → POST /api/v1/transactions/transfer`; HTTP JSON `{"sourceAccountId":"<Account UUID>","destinationAccountId":"<Account UUID>","amount":"0010.20"}`; `Idempotency-Key: <UUID from crypto.randomUUID>`. [bank-web/lib/api/transactions.ts](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/lib/api/transactions.ts) and [bank-web/lib/api/http.ts](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/lib/api/http.ts) obtain CSRF token for POST; [bank-web/lib/server/banking-upstream.ts](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/lib/server/banking-upstream.ts) authenticates via cookie-held bearer and forwards body/header to Spring. BFF rejects invalid CSRF with 403, maps upstream unreachable to 502 `BANKING_UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE`, timeout to 504 `BANKING_UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT`; account/receipt JSON responses are no-store. GET receipt is a separate no-body CSRF-free read.

[bank-core/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/transactions/interfaces/TransactionController.java](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-core/blob/9f58e595a653db9d8aa59b70a35af8e2b0e725d3/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/transactions/interfaces/TransactionController.java) `@PreAuthorize("hasRole('CUSTOMER')")` extracts authenticated User UUID and `TransferRequest(UUID sourceAccountId, UUID destinationAccountId, String amount)`; strict deserializer rejects numeric JSON tokens, controller requireKey rejects missing key (400), despite header `required=false`. [bank-core/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/transactions/application/impl/FinancialWorkflowServiceImpl.java](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-core/blob/9f58e595a653db9d8aa59b70a35af8e2b0e725d3/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/transactions/application/impl/FinancialWorkflowServiceImpl.java) requires distinct source/destination, owner of source by `User UUID → Customer UUID → Account.customerId`, both ACTIVE LKR accounts and ACTIVE customer LIABILITY mappings; it locks in sorted Account UUID order. No staff use of the same endpoint; no PayHere/wallet dependency.

**Accounting contract:** PostingEngineImpl receives one `TRANSFER` `POSTED` journal, same exact amount on **DEBIT source customer LIABILITY** and **CREDIT destination customer LIABILITY**. Locked source Account.balance decreases; destination increases; negative source resulting balance rejects. The idempotency claim, both updated Account.balance rows, journal header, two postings, source TRANSFER_OUT and destination TRANSFER_IN legacy history projections all participate in one physical database transaction. Projection failure rolls back the whole payment. No system vault debit/credit or external interbank settlement occurs in a pure internal transfer ([bank-core/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/ledger/application/impl/PostingEngineImpl.java](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-core/blob/9f58e595a653db9d8aa59b70a35af8e2b0e725d3/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/ledger/application/impl/PostingEngineImpl.java); [bank-core/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/transactions/application/impl/LegacyTransactionProjectionServiceImpl.java](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-core/blob/9f58e595a653db9d8aa59b70a35af8e2b0e725d3/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/transactions/application/impl/LegacyTransactionProjectionServiceImpl.java)). One new journal and two history rows are expected, not separate independent transfers.

### Payment-specific durable idempotency

[bank-core/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/transactions/idempotency/application/CoreIdempotencyCoordinator.java](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-core/blob/9f58e595a653db9d8aa59b70a35af8e2b0e725d3/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/transactions/idempotency/application/CoreIdempotencyCoordinator.java) and [bank-core/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/transactions/idempotency/domain/CoreRequestFingerprint.java](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-core/blob/9f58e595a653db9d8aa59b70a35af8e2b0e725d3/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/transactions/idempotency/domain/CoreRequestFingerprint.java) implement `(authenticated user_id, operation_type=TRANSFER, client_key)` UNIQUE claim and SHA-256 fingerprint of ordered source UUID, destination UUID, normalized LKR amount. Same key/payload returns cached immutable original receipt and journal UUID with `replayed:true`; changed destination/source/amount returns 409 `ERR_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT`; concurrent duplicate claims serialize with an idempotency locking read, returning one financial journal. PROCESSING can yield 409 `ERR_IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS`; failed transaction rolls back claim+finance data so same key can be retried as a *first* successful payment. Key state survives Core restart as committed DB row but **browser only keeps key/payload in page memory**, and server has no retention cleanup mechanism in inspected code. This is the TXN-008 financial coordinator, separate from ACC-005 account-opening idempotency.

### Transfer receipts: internal versus public

Core internal `TransferReceipt` stores operationType `TRANSFER`, journalEntryId UUID, journalReference, sourceAccountId, destinationAccountId, BigDecimal(4) amount, currency LKR, **sourceResultingBalance and destinationResultingBalance**, postedAt and replayed. It is serialized in the completed Core idempotency row with journal FK. The **public** `TransferResponse` deliberately excludes destinationResultingBalance; caller sees both account UUIDs but only the payer's resulting balance. The web verifies operation, LKR, source/destination, journal UUID/reference, normalized amount, payer balance and timestamp before displaying its confirmed receipt with reference, amount, payer postpayment balance, timestamp and journal UUID. No standalone Receipt entity or downloadable/email receipt. When source balance/history refresh fails, confirmation remains intact and Refresh account data is offered ([bank-core/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/transactions/application/TransferReceipt.java](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-core/blob/9f58e595a653db9d8aa59b70a35af8e2b0e725d3/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/transactions/application/TransferReceipt.java); [bank-core/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/transactions/interfaces/dto/TransferResponse.java](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-core/blob/9f58e595a653db9d8aa59b70a35af8e2b0e725d3/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/transactions/interfaces/dto/TransferResponse.java); [bank-web/components/banking/InternalPaymentForm.tsx](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/components/banking/InternalPaymentForm.tsx)).

**Receipt GET:** `GET /api/v1/transactions/transfer/receipt`, `Idempotency-Key: <original>`, CUSTOMER-authenticated, no CSRF, `Cache-Control: no-store`. Calls `findCommittedTransfer(current User UUID,key)` and `CoreIdempotencyCoordinator.findCompleted(userId,TRANSFER,key)`, reads cached original receipt and maps public DTO with `replayed:true`. **GET does not create or retry money movement**; different Customer, recipient with payer key, missing/PROCESSING or unknown claim yields 404 ERR_NOT_FOUND, unauthorized 401, noncustomer 403, missing key 400. 404 is *only not currently found/COMPLETED*, not proof that original payment is economically failed; journal reference and transaction UUID are not alternate lookup credentials.

### Recovery: post-commit versus pre-commit

1. **POST commits, HTTP success is lost:** browser `send` handles transport/parse, 408, 5xx, and pending-key conflict by automatically invoking a **GET** receipt with *original* key (not another POST). If persisted COMPLETED claim is visible, read returns authoritative sanitized receipt; `verifyReceipt` checks original draft and web marks payment confirmed and refreshes payer account/history. Source Playwright mock scenario `pay-timeout` checks one POST + one GET on BFF timeout 504.
2. **No completed receipt visible when GET runs:** a not-yet-committed, rolled-back or never-arrived transfer can all appear as 404. Web retains `uncertain` state, original key and original frozen payload, explains original might still finish; exposes **Check receipt** (GET only) and **Retry same payment** (explicit POST using exact key/payload), plus full account history link. Failed/timeout receipt lookup leaves uncertain. No unreviewed automatic repeated payment POST. In current page there is no New Payment in uncertain state; reload or navigation loses the recovery key. Mock `pay-retry` scenario checks 404 then same-key replay, `pay-lookup-error` checks lookup timeout then manual GET.

### Payment outcomes and user-visible handling

| Case | Core / web classification | Economic/next-step meaning |
|---|---|---|
| No account / inactive source | Review disabled/client guidance; server rejects inactive | No payment POST from blocked form; active source required |
| Malformed/missing recipient UUID | Client error 'Enter destination account UUID' | No POST |
| Unknown recipient / unowned source | 422 ERR_ACCOUNT_ACCESS_DENIED, UI combined ownership/destination guidance | No journal, key rolls back |
| Self-transfer | Client blocks; Core 422 ERR_SELF_TRANSFER | No journal |
| Frozen/closed source or destination | 422 ERR_ACCOUNT_NOT_ACTIVE, UI ineligible-account message | No journal |
| Non-LKR or ledger mapping inactive | 422 ERR_UNSUPPORTED_CURRENCY / ERR_CURRENCY_MISMATCH / ERR_LEDGER_ACCOUNT_NOT_ACTIVE | No journal |
| Amount 0, negative, exponent, >2 decimals | Web blocks, Core 422 ERR_AMOUNT_INVALID or 400 invalid JSON | No journal |
| Balance insufficient | 422 ERR_INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS, explanatory UI text | No debit, claim rolled back |
| Missing/invalid key or body | 400 ERR_VALIDATION | No transfer; controller requires key even if header annotation optional |
| Session expired / wrong role / CSRF | 401 / 403 / CSRF_VALIDATION_FAILED; draft or sign-in guidance | No authorized transfer via path |
| Same key, altered payment | 409 ERR_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT; conflict state without resend | No new transfer; user instructed to inspect history/support |
| Same key still processing | 409 ERR_IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS triggers receipt GET | Receipt may still be missing, leave uncertain |
| BFF gateway unavailable / timeout | 502 BANKING_UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE or 504 BANKING_UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT | Ambiguous; automatic GET original-key receipt, no automatic extra POST |
| Core retries exhausted | 503 ERR_TRANSACTION_TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE | UI treats >=500 as ambiguous, checks receipt; retry remains manual |
| Receipt GET 200 | Completed stored payment returned, validated against reviewed draft | Confirmed UI; no financial write |
| Receipt GET 404 / failed lookup | State remains uncertain; Check receipt and Retry same payment | 404 does NOT establish financial failure; key kept only in live page |
| Payment confirmed, source refresh fails | Receipt remains confirmed, warning + Refresh account data | No new financial POST |

**Payment history and later discoverability:** Customer Account history GET `/api/v1/accounts/{accountId}/transactions` returns `TRANSFER_OUT` (payer) and `TRANSFER_IN` (recipient), ordered newest first, with separate account-specific balanceAfter. The underlying legacy rows share journal UUID, but public `TransactionResponseDTO` excludes journalEntryId/reference, counterparty and idempotency key. Web shows five latest outgoing rows after success and links full account history and CSV. History remains after page reload/login/closed account, **but the original Pay receipt cannot be reopened from history**, nor searched by journal ID in a customer receipt API. No dedicated Payments transaction directory, filters, saved beneficiaries, scheduling/recurring transfers, fee/limit policy, transfer cancel/dispute, or automatic receipt email identified as connected features.

**Android:** [bank-app/app/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/mobile/features/payments/interfaces/ui/PaymentsRoute.kt](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-app/blob/9d98ba24cb754b8295bd58770cd502438d3b7b38/app/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/mobile/features/payments/interfaces/ui/PaymentsRoute.kt) → [bank-app/app/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/mobile/features/payments/interfaces/ui/TransferScreen.kt](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-app/blob/9d98ba24cb754b8295bd58770cd502438d3b7b38/app/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/mobile/features/payments/interfaces/ui/TransferScreen.kt) → [bank-app/app/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/mobile/features/payments/interfaces/ui/PaymentReviewScreen.kt](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-app/blob/9d98ba24cb754b8295bd58770cd502438d3b7b38/app/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/mobile/features/payments/interfaces/ui/PaymentReviewScreen.kt) → [bank-app/app/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/mobile/features/payments/interfaces/ui/PaymentReceiptScreen.kt](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-app/blob/9d98ba24cb754b8295bd58770cd502438d3b7b38/app/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/mobile/features/payments/interfaces/ui/PaymentReceiptScreen.kt) is a UI-only local draft and preview; confirm just advances screen without calling Core POST. Android accepts manual source text, account number-like recipient and destination bank, not Core's Account UUID financial transfer contract; no key, true receipt, recovery, or server posting. Receipt screen explicitly says no money moved. Separate Android GET /accounts/{id}/transactions supports real TRANSFER_OUT/IN history with Double amounts, under TXN-018; do not confuse with real Android Pay. Full Android parity Part14.

**Automated evidence and limits:** [bank-web/e2e/internal-payment.spec.ts](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/e2e/internal-payment.spec.ts) is Playwright test source for customer authorization, exact review/confirm, postcommit timeout recovery, missing receipt and same-key replay, lookup timeout, refresh error, conflicts, and domain errors; [bank-web/playwright.config.ts](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/playwright.config.ts) runs [bank-web/e2e/mock-bank-core.mjs](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/e2e/mock-bank-core.mjs) instead of actual bank-core. #### PAY-001 — Customer Pay entry and eligible source-account selection

- **Review part:** 06 — Internal Pay and receipt recovery.
- **User roles:** Authenticated web CUSTOMER.
- **User objective:** Enter real Internal Pay from the customer navigation and choose a source account allowed to pay.
- **Workflow boundary:** Enter real Internal Pay from the customer navigation and choose a source account allowed to pay. Core shared posting/monetary/idempotency infrastructure remains TXN-003/005/006/007/008/009/011/012 in Part 05; Part 06 scores the payment-specific client, transport, receipt and recovery journeys. Account ownership/status are ACC-006/009/012, and full Android/External payments/Admin reversal are Parts 14/13/12.
- **Complete workflow steps:** AppHeader CUSTOMER Pay link /customer/pay renders PayPage and InternalPaymentForm, also shared by /customer/transactions/transfer. useAuth role+status sets canPay; GET /api/v1/accounts/my through authenticated BFF returns current Customer-owned Account rows; UI filters Account.status ACTIVE and valid Account UUID, defaults to first eligible, shows accountNumber/type/materialized LKR balance and permits changing source before review. Loading, account-fetch error + Reload accounts, and no-active-account guidance exist. Review payment disabled without eligibility. Server ownership enforced again during transfer; web does not run a payment-time KYC preflight.
- **Frontend / Android:** Web: [bank-web/components/layout/AppHeader.tsx](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/components/layout/AppHeader.tsx); [bank-web/app/(customer)/customer/pay/page.tsx](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/app/(customer)/customer/pay/page.tsx); [bank-web/app/(customer)/customer/transactions/transfer/page.tsx](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/app/(customer)/customer/transactions/transfer/page.tsx); [bank-web/components/banking/InternalPaymentForm.tsx](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/components/banking/InternalPaymentForm.tsx); [bank-web/lib/api/accounts.ts](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/lib/api/accounts.ts); [bank-web/lib/auth/navigation.ts](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/lib/auth/navigation.ts) Android: Not applicable for this scoped feature.

#### PAY-002 — Destination identification by Account UUID and recipient privacy

- **Review part:** 06 — Internal Pay and receipt recovery.
- **User roles:** Web CUSTOMER payer and recipient with bank Account UUID.
- **User objective:** Identify an internal recipient without exposing unrelated account-owner details.
- **Workflow boundary:** Identify an internal recipient without exposing unrelated account-owner details. Core shared posting/monetary/idempotency infrastructure remains TXN-003/005/006/007/008/009/011/012 in Part 05; Part 06 scores the payment-specific client, transport, receipt and recovery journeys. Account ownership/status are ACC-006/009/012, and full Android/External payments/Admin reversal are Parts 14/13/12.
- **Complete workflow steps:** Pay form asks for 'Destination account UUID' as manually entered text, with guidance to obtain UUID from recipient's account history. On Review it trims and checks UUID regex and rejects same source UUID; does not call recipient lookup. Core TransferRequest destinationAccountId UUID, FinancialWorkflowServiceImpl resolves destination Account under lock, requires ACTIVE LKR + customer LIABILITY ledger ACTIVE, permits other-customer and same-customer distinct Account destinations, rejects missing/inactive/currency mismatches; source ownership alone must match payer. The response includes destinationAccountId but no recipient name, Customer UUID, owner data, destination balance, or destination accountNumber.

#### PAY-003 — Exact LKR payment draft, review, edit and explicit confirmation

- **Review part:** 06 — Internal Pay and receipt recovery.
- **User roles:** Web CUSTOMER.
- **User objective:** Review source, destination and exact decimal amount before authorizing a transfer.
- **Workflow boundary:** Review source, destination and exact decimal amount before authorizing a transfer. Core shared posting/monetary/idempotency infrastructure remains TXN-003/005/006/007/008/009/011/012 in Part 05; Part 06 scores the payment-specific client, transport, receipt and recovery journeys. Account ownership/status are ACC-006/009/012, and full Android/External payments/Admin reversal are Parts 14/13/12.
- **Complete workflow steps:** Draft fields sourceAccountId from owned ACTIVE account selector, raw destinationAccountId UUID and amount as string. Web validateAmount trims whitespace, requires positive plain decimal <=2 fractional digits, rejects zero/negative/exponent/currency symbol; review snapshots immutable {sourceAccountId,destinationAccountId,amount:trimmed string}, displays selected source account number/type, full destination UUID and amount LKR, allows Edit payment to return draft and preserve field values. Confirm payment generates crypto.randomUUID idempotency key only at confirmation, captures frozen payload and executes through inFlight ref + busy lock to ignore duplicate clicks. Core StrictDecimalTextDeserializer requires JSON string, MonetaryAmount.fromCustomerInput uses BigDecimal at ledger scale4 (UNNECESSARY) and LKR, posting checks SQL DECIMAL(19,4) ceiling. Leading-zero amount 0010.20 is sent unchanged as a string but Core interprets 10.2000; verified receipt compares normalized decimal values.

- **Complete workflow steps:** Confirm calls transactionsApi.transfer with POST /api/v1/transactions/transfer, JSON body {sourceAccountId:UUID,destinationAccountId:UUID,amount:decimal text} and Idempotency-Key. lib/api/http.ts acquires X-CSRF-Token for POST, sends same-origin authenticated cookie, BFF app/api/v1/[...path] handles POST and server banking-upstream forwards bearer from cookie, exact idempotency header and unchanged request body to Spring. BFF maps timeouts 504 BANKING_UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT and unavailable upstream 502 BANKING_UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE; GET and POST response Cache-Control no-store. Core TransactionController @PreAuthorize CUSTOMER parses UUIDs and string decimal, requires valid key, delegates transfer and returns HTTP 200 TransferResponse.from(receipt). #### PAY-005 — Transfer ownership, account eligibility and insufficient-funds enforcement

- **Review part:** 06 — Internal Pay and receipt recovery.
- **User roles:** Authenticated CUSTOMER source payer; recipient may belong to another Customer.
- **User objective:** Authorize only supported payer-to-recipient account movements.
- **Workflow boundary:** Authorize only supported payer-to-recipient account movements. Core shared posting/monetary/idempotency infrastructure remains TXN-003/005/006/007/008/009/011/012 in Part 05; Part 06 scores the payment-specific client, transport, receipt and recovery journeys. Account ownership/status are ACC-006/009/012, and full Android/External payments/Admin reversal are Parts 14/13/12.
- **Complete workflow steps:** TransactionController CUSTOMER guard obtains User UUID from AuthenticatedUserIdProvider. Transfer service rejects source==destination, locks source/destination Account rows in canonical UUID order, validates source ACTIVE/LKR and linked banking Customer owner by User UUID, destination ACTIVE/LKR without owner constraint, same LKR currency, each linked customer LedgerAccount identity CLASS LIABILITY and ACTIVE; PostingEngine refreshes both locked Account rows, rechecks status/currency and aggregate source balance minus amount >=0, otherwise ERR_INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS. A Customer can pay a different owned account or another Customer's account, not debit someone else's source. Frozen/closed on either side block. No payment-time Customer.status ACTIVE or latest APPROVED KYC recheck, no account-type-specific transaction limit or fees.

#### PAY-006 — Atomic two-account double-entry settlement and history effects

- **Review part:** 06 — Internal Pay and receipt recovery.
- **User roles:** Core internal finance for CUSTOMER transfer.
- **User objective:** Move exact LKR between internal Customer liability balances without partial economic commit.
- **Workflow boundary:** Move exact LKR between internal Customer liability balances without partial economic commit. Core shared posting/monetary/idempotency infrastructure remains TXN-003/005/006/007/008/009/011/012 in Part 05; Part 06 scores the payment-specific client, transport, receipt and recovery journeys. Account ownership/status are ACC-006/009/012, and full Android/External payments/Admin reversal are Parts 14/13/12.
- **Complete workflow steps:** FinancialWorkflowServiceImpl.executeTransfer obtains ordered source/destination Account row locks and builds PostingCommand TRANSFER, LKR, actor=current User, channel WEB, posting 0 DEBIT source Customer LIABILITY, posting 1 CREDIT destination Customer LIABILITY with same MonetaryAmount. PostingEngineImpl validates equal debits and credits, canonical locks+refreshes affected Accounts, rejects overdraw, adjusts stored balances (-source/+destination), persists one POSTED immutable journal with UUID/reference, two ledger posting rows and mandatory LegacyTransactionProjectionServiceImpl: separate TRANSFER_OUT payer and TRANSFER_IN recipient rows sharing journal UUID. All under Spring transaction plus CoreIdempotencyCoordinator claim; projection or posting failure rolls back both sides, claim, journal and rows. No system-vault leg and no external rails for this internal transfer.
- **Frontend / Android:** Web: [bank-web/components/banking/InternalPaymentForm.tsx](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/components/banking/InternalPaymentForm.tsx) Android: Not applicable for this scoped feature.

#### PAY-007 — Durable per-payment idempotency, duplicate prevention and conflict handling

- **Review part:** 06 — Internal Pay and receipt recovery.
- **User roles:** CUSTOMER transfer POST and Core financial coordinator.
- **User objective:** Commit one economic transfer per original key and normalized payment request.
- **Workflow boundary:** Commit one economic transfer per original key and normalized payment request. Core shared posting/monetary/idempotency infrastructure remains TXN-003/005/006/007/008/009/011/012 in Part 05; Part 06 scores the payment-specific client, transport, receipt and recovery journeys. Account ownership/status are ACC-006/009/012, and full Android/External payments/Admin reversal are Parts 14/13/12.
- **Complete workflow steps:** Web creates crypto.randomUUID only when Confirm payment is clicked; repeated in-flight clicks blocked by inFlight ref, not sole financial guarantee. POST Idempotency-Key required in practice by controller.requireKey (missing invalid → 400). Core MonetaryAmount normalized scale4 and CoreRequestFingerprint.forTransfer SHA-256 encodes TRANSFER, source UUID, destination UUID, LKR and decimal amount (source/destination order significant). CoreIdempotencyCoordinator MySQL unique(user_id, operation_type TRANSFER, client_key) INSERT IGNORE claim; same-key concurrent request waits locking read. Claim, full economic posting and cached full TransferReceipt HTTP result commit in one transaction, linked to journal entry; identical replay returns same entryId and original resulting balance replayed true, conflicting changed amount/destination/source 409 ERR_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT, still PROCESSING 409 ERR_IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS. Unsuccessful financial attempt rolls back claim; Core retry executor uses new physical attempts for safe DB deadlocks.

#### PAY-008 — Authoritative payment receipt creation, privacy and confirmation display

- **Review part:** 06 — Internal Pay and receipt recovery.
- **User roles:** CUSTOMER payer web and internal Core service.
- **User objective:** Show confirmed journal posting details and payer's authoritative balance.
- **Workflow boundary:** Show confirmed journal posting details and payer's authoritative balance. Core shared posting/monetary/idempotency infrastructure remains TXN-003/005/006/007/008/009/011/012 in Part 05; Part 06 scores the payment-specific client, transport, receipt and recovery journeys. Account ownership/status are ACC-006/009/012, and full Android/External payments/Admin reversal are Parts 14/13/12.
- **Complete workflow steps:** Core executeTransfer builds internal TransferReceipt with TRANSFER, journalEntryId, journalReference, sourceAccountId, destinationAccountId, amount BigDecimal(4), LKR, sourceResultingBalance, destinationResultingBalance, postedAt, replayed=false; stores internal full JSON inside completed idempotency claim, with journal FK. Spring maps public TransferResponse excluding destinationResultingBalance, returns HTTP 200 no-store. Web verifyReceipt checks operation TRANSFER, LKR, both UUIDs, journal UUID/reference, exact normalized decimal amount, sourceResultingBalance decimal, timestamp and boolean replayed; only then confirmed state presents payment reference, amount/currency, payer balance-after, posting time and journal UUID. Refresh source account/history after receipt without changing confirmed state on refresh failure; Start a new payment reinitializes key only for subsequent confirm. Receipt is not a separately indexed payment-receipt table.

#### PAY-009 — Customer-authorized read-only receipt lookup by original key

- **Review part:** 06 — Internal Pay and receipt recovery.
- **User roles:** Signed-in CUSTOMER payer owning original key namespace.
- **User objective:** Check whether a committed transfer already exists without posting again.
- **Workflow boundary:** Check whether a committed transfer already exists without posting again. Core shared posting/monetary/idempotency infrastructure remains TXN-003/005/006/007/008/009/011/012 in Part 05; Part 06 scores the payment-specific client, transport, receipt and recovery journeys. Account ownership/status are ACC-006/009/012, and full Android/External payments/Admin reversal are Parts 14/13/12.
- **Complete workflow steps:** Web transactionsApi.transferReceipt(key) issues authenticated GET /api/v1/transactions/transfer/receipt with exact Idempotency-Key and cache no-store; BFF forwards bearer+header but GET has no CSRF token/body. Core Controller @PreAuthorize CUSTOMER validates key and calls TransferWorkflow.findCommittedTransfer(principal.userId, key). Coordinator findCompleted(userId, operation TRANSFER, key) queries persisted claim and only returns COMPLETED with cached internal receipt; service validates cached 200/status, journal UUID and operation then TransferResponse.from sanitizes destination balance, sets replayed true. Missing/PROCESSING/nonexistent key returns 404 ERR_NOT_FOUND; does not mutate balances, create journal, force action retry, or authorize another user using only known key. Public API receipt identified by original key (not journal UUID or journal reference).

#### PAY-010 — Automatic post-commit lost-response recovery by receipt GET

- **Review part:** 06 — Internal Pay and receipt recovery.
- **User roles:** Web CUSTOMER with current pending payment in memory.
- **User objective:** Confirm already-posted payment after timeout or lost POST response without a second payment write.
- **Workflow boundary:** Confirm already-posted payment after timeout or lost POST response without a second payment write. Core shared posting/monetary/idempotency infrastructure remains TXN-003/005/006/007/008/009/011/012 in Part 05; Part 06 scores the payment-specific client, transport, receipt and recovery journeys. Account ownership/status are ACC-006/009/012, and full Android/External payments/Admin reversal are Parts 14/13/12.
- **Complete workflow steps:** InternalPaymentForm.send on network failure, malformed response, 408, >=500, or isUncertainTransactionOutcome(409 ERR_IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS, BFF 502/504) enters checkReceipt(payment), preserving original key/payload. checkReceipt sends **one GET receipt lookup**, not a second POST, sets uncertain message while loading, validates returned receipt matches reviewed payload. If Core committed but POST response lost, GET returns stored receipt and UI confirmed receipt + source account/history refresh; web Playwright with mock Core covers after-persist BFF 504 and verifies one POST followed by one GET with same key, no CSRF on GET. The BFF and Core do not intrinsically know whether timeout was pre/post-commit; lookup resolves only if COMPLETED visible.

#### PAY-011 — Unresolved pre-commit receipt and manual Check receipt flow

- **Review part:** 06 — Internal Pay and receipt recovery.
- **User roles:** Web CUSTOMER after ambiguous submission.
- **User objective:** Preserve uncertainty safely when no completed receipt is visible yet.
- **Workflow boundary:** Preserve uncertainty safely when no completed receipt is visible yet. Core shared posting/monetary/idempotency infrastructure remains TXN-003/005/006/007/008/009/011/012 in Part 05; Part 06 scores the payment-specific client, transport, receipt and recovery journeys. Account ownership/status are ACC-006/009/012, and full Android/External payments/Admin reversal are Parts 14/13/12.
- **Complete workflow steps:** After ambiguous POST, checkReceipt GET may return 404 ERR_NOT_FOUND because Core transfer not yet committed, aborted, or no claim; web maintains state.kind='uncertain', stores payment:{key,payload} in React memory and says no committed receipt was visible, original may still complete. UI displays 'Check receipt' button whose callback invokes receipt GET again with same key and no write. A 502/504/parse/lookup-auth problem shows cannot verify, retaining uncertain state and original payment details and showing history link. Confirm button and Edit/New Payment are unavailable in uncertain branch; Retry same payment is separate explicit POST action. Web recognizes that 404 is not a definitive failure, but state is lost when leaving/reloading page, and 404 cannot distinguish processing, rollback or never arrived.

#### PAY-012 — Manual same-key payment retry after unresolved outcome

- **Review part:** 06 — Internal Pay and receipt recovery.
- **User roles:** Web CUSTOMER with uncertain original payment.
- **User objective:** Intentionally retry original payment request without creating second journal for an already committed transfer.
- **Workflow boundary:** Intentionally retry original payment request without creating second journal for an already committed transfer. Core shared posting/monetary/idempotency infrastructure remains TXN-003/005/006/007/008/009/011/012 in Part 05; Part 06 scores the payment-specific client, transport, receipt and recovery journeys. Account ownership/status are ACC-006/009/012, and full Android/External payments/Admin reversal are Parts 14/13/12.
- **Complete workflow steps:** When state.kind='uncertain', UI offers 'Retry same payment' distinct from 'Check receipt'. Its onClick runs send(state.payment, true), retaining immutable payload and original idempotency key under busy+inFlight lock. If earlier request committed, Core same-key/normalized fingerprint replays cached original journal and resultingBalance, HTTP 200 replayed true. If rolled back or never reached Core, same key can obtain claim and create first journal; any ambiguous/error retry routes back to read-only checkReceipt. Changed details cannot be retried under this key via the UI; Core would return 409 conflict if called directly. New payment intentionally appears after confirmed success, not during unresolved state. Manual retry is a financial POST, unlike Check receipt GET.

#### PAY-013 — Payment-specific validation errors, conflict and recovery messaging

- **Review part:** 06 — Internal Pay and receipt recovery.
- **User roles:** Web CUSTOMER.
- **User objective:** Distinguish definitively rejected transfer from uncertain outcome and avoid duplicate initiation.
- **Workflow boundary:** Distinguish definitively rejected transfer from uncertain outcome and avoid duplicate initiation. Core shared posting/monetary/idempotency infrastructure remains TXN-003/005/006/007/008/009/011/012 in Part 05; Part 06 scores the payment-specific client, transport, receipt and recovery journeys. Account ownership/status are ACC-006/009/012, and full Android/External payments/Admin reversal are Parts 14/13/12.
- **Complete workflow steps:** Web draft rejects inactive/missing source, malformed/missing UUID, same source/dest and invalid decimal before POST. Core returns 400 strict DTO/key validation, 401 unauthenticated, 403 non-CUSTOMER/CSRF, 422 BusinessException (ERR_ACCOUNT_ACCESS_DENIED for unowned/unknown, ERR_SELF_TRANSFER, ERR_INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS, ERR_ACCOUNT_NOT_ACTIVE, ERR_LEDGER_ACCOUNT_NOT_ACTIVE, ERR_CURRENCY_MISMATCH/ERR_UNSUPPORTED_CURRENCY, ERR_AMOUNT_INVALID), 409 ERR_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT or ERR_IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS, 503 retry-exhausted ERR_TRANSACTION_TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE. BFF gives 502 unavailable or 504 timeout. In send(), any non-in-progress 409 leads to conflict state with no resubmit action; 5xx/408/transport/parse/pending → receipt GET, definitive domain errors → draft rejectionMessage with user-facing guidance and ability to review again after corrections. Receipt GET 404 → uncertain, not failed. On confirmed receipt, refresh failures show warning without revoking confirmation.

#### PAY-014 — Pay-specific history visibility and later receipt discoverability

- **Review part:** 06 — Internal Pay and receipt recovery.
- **User roles:** Web CUSTOMER payer and recipient; Android account-history reader.
- **User objective:** Find outgoing/incoming payment activity and recover evidence after leaving receipt screen.
- **Workflow boundary:** Find outgoing/incoming payment activity and recover evidence after leaving receipt screen. Core shared posting/monetary/idempotency infrastructure remains TXN-003/005/006/007/008/009/011/012 in Part 05; Part 06 scores the payment-specific client, transport, receipt and recovery journeys. Account ownership/status are ACC-006/009/012, and full Android/External payments/Admin reversal are Parts 14/13/12.
- **Complete workflow steps:** Transfer posting creates one TRANSFER_OUT payer transaction row and one TRANSFER_IN recipient row sharing same journalId, with positive amount and each account's balanceAfter. After confirmed web payment, InternalPaymentForm GETs payer account detail and GET /accounts/{source}/transactions to display latest five and View full account history link. HistoryView /customer/accounts/{id}/transactions GETs actual owner-scoped stored Transaction projections, renders sorted list and client-side CSV. Recipient can open own account history to see TRANSFER_IN. Closed-account history remains readable. TransactionResponseDTO only includes transactionId/accountId/type/amount/balanceAfter/description/createdAt; it omits shared journal UUID/ref, counterparty account UUID and receipt recovery key. After navigation/reload, confirmed receipt UI and original key vanish; no link from TRANSFER_OUT row back to TransferResponse or dedicated Pay history/receipt library.

Do not count delete/Customer self-registration again here.

### Staff journey and data-source map

`TELLER/MANAGER login → /staff → Customers link/card → /staff/customers (GET /api/v1/customers) → Customer directory → /staff/customers/{customerId} (GET /customers/{Customer UUID}) → optional seven-field Edit (PUT /customers)`. ADMIN reaches the same shared workspace from Admin Staff workspace link. Customer create uses `/staff/customers/new`: `GET /customers` (linked-user exclusion) + debounced `GET /users/all?search=...` → choose existing CUSTOMER-role User UUID → seven personal fields+status → `POST /customers` → 201 response with newly generated Customer UUID → navigate detail. [web/components/banking/StaffCustomerDirectory.tsx](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/components/banking/StaffCustomerDirectory.tsx); [web/components/banking/StaffCustomerCreate.tsx](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/components/banking/StaffCustomerCreate.tsx); [web/components/banking/StaffCustomerDetail.tsx](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/components/banking/StaffCustomerDetail.tsx); [web/lib/api/customers.ts](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/lib/api/customers.ts); [core/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/customer/interfaces/CustomerController.java](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-core/blob/9f58e595a653db9d8aa59b70a35af8e2b0e725d3/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/customer/interfaces/CustomerController.java); [core/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/customer/application/impl/CustomerServiceImpl.java](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-core/blob/9f58e595a653db9d8aa59b70a35af8e2b0e725d3/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/customer/application/impl/CustomerServiceImpl.java).

| Capability | Method & route | Core role | Persistence/query | Data exposed | Boundary |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Staff list | GET /api/v1/customers | ADMIN/TELLER/MANAGER | CustomerRepository.findAll; entire list | Customer UUID, name, email, phone and status; username, userId in DTO | No paging/query/sort |
| Directory search | None after first GET | Same list permission | React useMemo on full Customer[] | first/last, email, phone, username, Customer UUID, User UUID | Local case-insensitive substring |
| Existing User lookup | GET /api/v1/users/all?search=<term> | ADMIN/TELLER/MANAGER | Role=CUSTOMER AND LOWER(first,last,email) LIKE %term% | User UUID, name, username, email, contact/address DTO | No username/phone/ID search, not paginated |
| Customer details | GET /api/v1/customers/{customerId} | ADMIN/TELLER/MANAGER | CustomerRepository.findById(UUID) | Customer identity fields + linked User UUID/username | No accounts/KYC joined |
| Staff create | POST /api/v1/customers | ADMIN/TELLER/MANAGER | Find User by UUID; CustomerRepository.save | 201 CustomerResponseDTO with new Customer UUID | Requires existing User, no KYC guard or create key |
| Staff update | PUT /api/v1/customers | ADMIN/TELLER/MANAGER | findByUserUserId(request.userId) then save | 200 updated CustomerResponseDTO | Web status and association frozen; API can change status |
| Admin deletion boundary | DELETE /api/v1/customers/{customerId} | ADMIN only | Find Customer, detach User.customer, delete/flush | 204 or 409 dependent FK conflict | Full deletion and recovery review reserved Part11 |

**Directory details:** StaffCustomerDirectory renders Customer name, Customer.email, phone and status; Customer.customerId is the row-link key. No branch scope, page size, database ordering or server-side filter. Local search lowercases and finds substrings in 7 actual values (first/last name, email, phone, username, customer UUID, user UUID); it does not filter by Customer.status, NI number, account number or branch. Loading and empty/no-results and 401/403/generic error with Try again implemented. Search is memory-local, lost on navigation. Directory displays no linked account count/balance or timestamps.

**Existing User search versus Customer directory:** UserController `GET /api/v1/users/all?search=` uses role `CUSTOMER` filter and case-insensitive `LIKE` against User.firstName/lastName/email only. It does not search username, phone or User UUID, and does not filter User.isActive, emailVerified or KYC approval. The frontend applies 300 ms debounce, role confirmation, and removes already-linked User IDs from the complete Customer list; selection prepopulates name/email/address from User. No User gets created by staff Customer POST. API accepts existing target User UUID; the UI filter is not a backend validation guarantee.

### Customer identity and fields

`users.user_id` is login User UUID; `customers.customer_id` separate generated banking Customer UUID; `customers.user_id` nullable unique FK to User; `users.customer_id` separate nullable FK back to Customer. Customer JPA has `@OneToOne` User link while User has `@ManyToOne` Customer pointer; this reverse pointer is not unique in V1. Both tables have independent unique email, with no cross-table equality constraint. Customer.email/name/contact/DOB/status are Customer-owned, not the User login contact. Staff update does **not** update User.email, name or password. [core/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/customer/domain/Customer.java](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-core/blob/9f58e595a653db9d8aa59b70a35af8e2b0e725d3/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/customer/domain/Customer.java); [core/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/auth/domain/User.java](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-core/blob/9f58e595a653db9d8aa59b70a35af8e2b0e725d3/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/auth/domain/User.java); [core/src/main/resources/db/migration/V1__baseline.sql](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-core/blob/9f58e595a653db9d8aa59b70a35af8e2b0e725d3/src/main/resources/db/migration/V1__baseline.sql).

**Creation validation:** `CustomerRequestDTO` uses `@NotBlank` first/last/email/phone, `@Email` email, `@NotNull` gender/dateOfBirth/status/User UUID; address is optional. Gender enum MALE/FEMALE/OTHER, Status enum ACTIVE/INACTIVE/PENDING/RESIGNED, date is LocalDate. Web fields are HTML required, email/date/tel type; no business-specific phone/age/ID rules. Service @Transactional sets createdAt/updatedAt, assigns User by submitted UUID, populates both customer→user and user→customer and saves. Missing User is 404; invalid fields 400. DB UNIQUE(user_id) and UNIQUE(Customer.email) prevent duplication, but service does not precheck existing Customer association or map all create unique violations to stable 409. Web blocks duplicate clicks while pending and warns to check directory after ambiguous timeouts; no durable Customer creation idempotency/recovery. Unlike `PUT /customers/me` self-service, staff POST does **not** recheck latest approved KYC, User target role, User activation or email verification.

**Existing Customer editing:** Web GET by Customer UUID; Edit loads seven Customer fields (name, gender, email, phone, address, DOB) then PUT /customers with immutable linked `userId` and unchanged current status; Core **locates the Customer by request.userId**, not route Customer UUID, and persists the fields plus status and updatedAt. The UI confirms 200 response then GETs detail as read-back; read-back failure warns without revoking confirmed edit. No concurrency version check/audit change record, and updates may diverge from User contact data. Role is same three staff roles. Core PUT accepts any valid status even though UI does not permit changing it. No unlink/reassign endpoint.

### Customer status and role permissions

| Customer.status | Backend/creation | Distinct from | Unconnected step |
|---|---|---|---|
| ACTIVE | Available at creation and backend PUT | Stored Customer field only; not a User active flag | No status edit UI or per-status rules |
| INACTIVE | Available at creation and backend PUT | Not an Account.status FROZEN; account posting checks Account.ACTIVE | No demonstrated automatic account/session suspension |
| PENDING | Available at creation and backend PUT | Not equal to KYC case PENDING | No transition approvals or queue |
| RESIGNED | Available at creation and backend PUT | Not account CLOSED or User BANNED | No archival/restoration workflow |

Status is not the same as `User.isActive`, KYC case decision, or Account.status. Customer.status alone is **not enforced as a payment posting eligibility gate** in inspected financial commands; Teller account opening finds linked Customer by User UUID without a Customer.status guard; self-service account opening independently requires approved KYC. The four statuses do not define an operational transition graph or full deactivation workflow.

| Operation | CUSTOMER | TELLER | MANAGER | ADMIN |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Staff workspace & Customers link | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| GET /api/v1/customers (directory) | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| GET /api/v1/users/all?search= (CUSTOMER role) | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| GET /api/v1/customers/{Customer UUID} | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| POST /api/v1/customers | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| PUT /api/v1/customers (including status at API) | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Visible edit existing Customer status | No | No | No | No |
| Customer details → Teller account-opening shortcut | No | Yes | No | No |
| DELETE /api/v1/customers/{Customer UUID} | No | No | No | Yes |
| Customer self /customers/me (different workflow) | Yes if authenticated and applicable | Authenticated route only; not staff workflow | Authenticated route only; not staff workflow | Authenticated route only; not staff workflow |

**Staff Employee/account scoping:** Current User can authenticate only if active, role allowed and linked Employee (if present) ACTIVE (AUTH-003/008). CustomerController then guards by role; it does not run branch/staff assignment or additional Employee-status queries in each Customer CRUD handler. These staff endpoints return global Customer records, not a branch-owned subset.

### Customer/account relationships and deletion boundary

Customer detail has banking Customer UUID and linked login User UUID but **no embedded accounts, balances, counts, status breakdown, history or branch**. Only TELLER sees a connected `Open Teller account form` link passing **User UUID** as `customerUserId`; StaffAccountForm verifies it against currently loaded Customers before opening through TELLER-authorized `POST /api/v1/accounts/{targetUserId}`. The actual account creation/financial lifecycle is ACC-008 and Part08 and is not re-scored.

ADMIN alone sees StaffCustomerDeletion on Customer detail. It asks for exact typed Customer UUID and performs current-record read-before-delete, sends CSRF-protected DELETE and reconciles ambiguous results with read-only GET. Core delete detaches User.customer and deletes Customer; when accounts or other FK-dependent records exist (including zero-balance CLOSED account), it returns 409 and transaction rolls back, retaining Customer and financial history. Deleting a Customer **does not delete login User or KYC records**. No staff soft-delete, restore or deactivation UI. This role/dependency boundary is recorded here, but the complete Admin deletion workflow is **reserved for Part11**, not counted as an independent STAFF-CUST feature.

### Mobile and backend-only boundaries

Android AppNavHost/Routes contains Home, customer My Accounts, KYC, Payments, profile and CustomerRegistrationScreen, **not** a staff Customer directory, User selector, staff create/edit/status or staff navigation flow. CustomerApi exposes `POST /customers` only as a legacy fallback after failed `/customers/me` in CustomerRepositoryImpl, which normally requires staff authorization; it is not an Android staff Customer management experience. Existing mobile self-service was KYC/DASH and full mobile review remains Part14.

Backend-only or missing UI capabilities include post-create status change through PUT, direct Customer getByUserId supporting self /me (already reviewed), no Customer search/pagination, no Customer search by NI/email API, no branch assignment, Customer merge/unlink/reassign, status audit, contact verification, Customer-linked account directory, or historical changes. Do not invent them as features or treat their absence as proof of production defect.

**Tests and evidence:** [web/e2e/staff-customer-directory.spec.ts](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/e2e/staff-customer-directory.spec.ts) covers Teller/Manager/Admin shared directory/detail, creation, edit, local search, duplicate UI filtering, role denial, missing/transport states and Teller handoff, but runs with [web/e2e/mock-bank-core.mjs](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/e2e/mock-bank-core.mjs) under [web/playwright.config.ts](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/playwright.config.ts) (not real Spring/MySQL). [web/tests/staff-customer-directory.test.tsx](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/tests/staff-customer-directory.test.tsx), [web/tests/staff-customers-api.test.ts](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/tests/staff-customers-api.test.ts) and [web/tests/staff-customers-navigation.test.ts](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/tests/staff-customers-navigation.test.ts) cover component/client/roles via unit/mock source. [web/e2e/admin-customer-deletion.spec.ts](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/e2e/admin-customer-deletion.spec.ts) and [core/src/test/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/customer/CustomerDeletionIntegrationTest.java](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-core/blob/9f58e595a653db9d8aa59b70a35af8e2b0e725d3/src/test/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/customer/CustomerDeletionIntegrationTest.java) and [core/src/test/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/customer/CustomerDeletionServiceTest.java](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-core/blob/9f58e595a653db9d8aa59b70a35af8e2b0e725d3/src/test/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/customer/CustomerDeletionServiceTest.java) check Admin deletion boundary with mock browser and Spring persistence test code, but full deletion remains Part11. No source-identified comprehensive Spring staff-create/update/customer-role-enforcement integration test nor attributable actual F1–F8 Staff Customer live acceptance output found in repo trees. **None were executed**. All 10 records Source-confirmed; zero L5, no real Customer mutations.

#### STAFF-CUST-005 — Existing CUSTOMER User search and selection for staff creation

- **Review part:** 07 — staff Customer management.
- **User roles:** TELLER, MANAGER, ADMIN creating Customer record.
- **User objective:** Find a preexisting CUSTOMER login not already linked to a Customer.
- **Workflow boundary:** Find a preexisting CUSTOMER login not already linked to a Customer. Staff banking Customer record work only: AUTH-003/008/010 covers login/authorization, KYC-011/012 self-service profile and opening, DASH-006 User-versus-Customer data, ACC-008/010 Teller opening and accounts. Full Admin Customer deletion Part 11, Teller account operations Part 08, Manager Teller management Part 09, KYC case administration Part 10, Android-wide Part 14.
- **Complete workflow steps:** On /staff/customers/new, StaffCustomerCreate first GETs all customers to build linked userId exclusion Set. Typing nonblank term schedules 300ms debounced customersApi.searchCustomerUsers(GET /api/v1/users/all?search=<encoded>) through protected BFF. UserController.listAllUsers @PreAuthorize ADMIN/TELLER/MANAGER → UserServiceImpl.getAllUsers: returns role CUSTOMER only via UserRepository.searchByRoleAndNameOrEmail LOWER(firstName,lastName,email) LIKE %lowersearch%, unpaginated; search blank Core returns all CUSTOMER Users but web does not send blank query. Frontend further requires roleName CUSTOMER and filters already-associated user IDs based on initial Customer list. Select displays name/email and captures User UUID, then prefills Customer name/email/address from User, leaves gender/DOB/phone blank. - **Complete workflow steps:** Staff chooses searched existing User and fills required Customer fields + explicit initial status (ACTIVE/INACTIVE/PENDING/RESIGNED). StaffCustomerCreate on submit locks pending, submits customersApi.createStaffCustomer POST /api/v1/customers body CustomerRecordRequest {userId,firstName,lastName,gender,email,phone,address,dateOfBirth,status}. Next BFF adds CSRF and bearer. CustomerController @Valid @PreAuthorize ADMIN/TELLER/MANAGER returns HTTP 201, CustomerServiceImpl.mapToEntity finds User by UUID, copies Customer fields/status, sets Customer.user and User.customer association, sets timestamps, customerRepository.save; generated Customer UUID returned. Web checks returned customerId and routes to its detail page. Missing User 404, invalid DTO 400, known conflict 409, upstream uncertainty warns to check directory before repeating. Neither User registration nor KYC approval is triggered. Server creation does not require User.role==CUSTOMER, User.isActive, verified email, latest KYC APPROVED, nor check existing association before save; UI limits selection but direct staff POST can name another role. No create idempotency key, GET by creation key or POST uncertainty reconciliation.

#### STAFF-CUST-007 — Customer-User one-to-one association and duplicate identity protection

- **Review part:** 07 — staff Customer management.
- **User roles:** All staff creators/editors; linked CUSTOMER User.
- **User objective:** Maintain distinct User and Customer identities without duplicate Customer associations.
- **Workflow boundary:** Maintain distinct User and Customer identities without duplicate Customer associations. Staff banking Customer record work only: AUTH-003/008/010 covers login/authorization, KYC-011/012 self-service profile and opening, DASH-006 User-versus-Customer data, ACC-008/010 Teller opening and accounts. Full Admin Customer deletion Part 11, Teller account operations Part 08, Manager Teller management Part 09, KYC case administration Part 10, Android-wide Part 14.
- **Complete workflow steps:** Customer entity has unique nullable one-to-one user_id FK, generated customer_id PK and unique Customer.email; baseline V1 customers UNIQUE(user_id), UNIQUE(email), FOREIGN KEY user_id→users; users independently has nullable customer_id FK and User.customer ManyToOne, plus unique User.email. New staff create mapToEntity loads existing User UUID and assigns both pointers. GET maps Customer.userId/username; staff edit PUT does not change Customer.user, only looks up Customer by submitted User UUID. Client creation hides existing link using Customer list and filters; same User submitted twice can collide on unique Customer.user_id, same Customer.email can collide independently. No explicit pre-create findByUser or DataIntegrityViolationException translation in CustomerServiceImpl.createCustomer, unlike delete, so 409 is not guaranteed on duplicate; SQL constraint is final guard. Nullable database Customer.user_id allows older/unlinked records, but staff creation DTO requires nonnull User ID. No separate reassign/unlink/merge API exposed.

Controller @Valid role guard → CustomerServiceImpl.updateCustomer resolves CustomerRepository.findByUserUserId(request.userId) and updates Customer fields, status (copied old value in UI) and updatedAt, saves, maps DTO; 200. Missing/forbidden/validation/conflict/timeout mapped, cancel restores original fields.
