### Part 08 — Teller-assisted opening and staff account operations

**Status:** COMPLETE — source-confirmed staff operational assessment, not live integrated-stack acceptance.

**Reverified four repository main HEADs on 2026-11-24:** bank-web `012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27`; bank-core `9f58e595a653db9d8aa59b70a35af8e2b0e725d3`; bank-service `cabdd323b4aa394910cb192ead6d233e9a12d9d3`; bank-app `9d98ba24cb754b8295bd58770cd502438d3b7b38`. All match Part 07 snapshots; recursive trees for all four were not truncated. Directly read staff web forms/list/detail/history, BFF and contracts, Core controller, service, repository, status, ledger, relevant Spring and web test source and Android navigation. No direct bank-service FastAPI/ML call is evidenced for Teller opening; it resolves Customers and Posts internally via Core ledger.

**Boundary:** Part 08 evaluates how staff actually *operate* existing Account capabilities: navigation, directory, selection, Teller form, opening/confirmation, uncertain opening, details, metadata change/read-back, status visibility, closure and closure recovery, account-scoped history/CSV. Source-confirmed Account product minimums/Customer FK/ledger/closure invariants were originally scored ACC-001/002/006/007/008/010/011/012/013/014; double-entry/history TXN-005/006/011/013; Customer/User context STAFF-CUST-010. Those remain independent original ratings. No new staff cash deposit/withdraw/transfer features were invented from Customer-only transaction endpoints.

### Staff account architecture and navigation

`Teller login → /staff → Open account (/staff/accounts/new)` for creation; `Teller/Manager login → /staff → Browse accounts (/staff/accounts) → /staff/accounts/{Account UUID} → Edit / Close / History`. ADMIN logs into /admin and enters common /staff through Staff workspace link. Header Accounts available ADMIN/MANAGER/TELLER, Open account TELLER only. Staff layout [bank-web/app/(staff)/staff/layout.tsx](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/app/%28staff%29/staff/layout.tsx) and staff page guards [bank-web/lib/auth/navigation.ts](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/lib/auth/navigation.ts) prevent CUSTOMER/EMPLOYEE/BANNED staff navigation. Backend [bank-core/features/accounts/interfaces/AccountController.java](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-core/blob/9f58e595a653db9d8aa59b70a35af8e2b0e725d3/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/accounts/interfaces/AccountController.java) has role guards separately; authenticated User.isActive and linked Employee ACTIVE checks are provided by AUTH-003/008. No branch/Employee assignment filter is imposed on staff account GET/PUT/DELETE in Controller/AccountRepository.

`GET /api/v1/accounts` → [bank-core/features/accounts/application/impl/AccountServiceImpl.java](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-core/blob/9f58e595a653db9d8aa59b70a35af8e2b0e725d3/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/accounts/application/impl/AccountServiceImpl.java) `getAllAccounts` → [bank-core/features/accounts/domain/repository/AccountRepository.java](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-core/blob/9f58e595a653db9d8aa59b70a35af8e2b0e725d3/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/accounts/domain/repository/AccountRepository.java) `findAll()`, returns complete global AccountResponseDTO list, including CLOSED/FROZEN, no pagination/query/ordering/owner-scope. [bank-web/components/banking/StaffAccountDirectory.tsx](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/components/banking/StaffAccountDirectory.tsx) displays account number linked by Account UUID, Account UUID, type, status, balance and created/updated; loading, empty, 401/403/404/transport and explicit error Reload supported, scrollable on small screens. **No search control at all**, no backend account number lookup, type/status/branch filter, owner name/Customer ID, sort or page navigation. Direct detail GET `/api/v1/accounts/{Account UUID}` is available when UUID known; account number is display only.

[bank-web/components/banking/StaffAccountDetail.tsx](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/components/banking/StaffAccountDetail.tsx) shows account number, UUID, type, status, stored LKR balance and timestamps, plus Edit account type or branch, conditional Close account, Refresh account and View transaction history. [bank-core/features/accounts/interfaces/dto/AccountResponseDTO.java](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-core/blob/9f58e595a653db9d8aa59b70a35af8e2b0e725d3/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/accounts/interfaces/dto/AccountResponseDTO.java) **does not include Customer UUID, linked User UUID, branch, currency or ledger-derived balance**, although Account.entity has Customer/Branch FKs. No Customer link or current branch can be displayed/verified. All status values remain visible even on CLOSED/FROZEN. No Customer/branch-specific account lists in staff Account directory.

### Teller-assisted opening: identity, product, eligibility and ledger

Form entry via [bank-web/app/(staff)/staff/accounts/new/page.tsx](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/app/%28staff%29/staff/accounts/new/page.tsx) or Customer detail handoff `?customerUserId=<linked User UUID>` ([bank-web/components/banking/StaffCustomerDetail.tsx](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/components/banking/StaffCustomerDetail.tsx)). [bank-web/components/banking/StaffAccountForm.tsx](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/components/banking/StaffAccountForm.tsx) concurrently loads staff GET /customers and GET /branches?page=1&limit=100, filters out missing User link, validates handoff UUID against linked User IDs, and offers manual selection from the full unfiltered Customer selector. It **does not search by Customer name, User UUID or account number within form**. The form clearly shows selected Customer name/status/Customer UUID and **linked User UUID which goes in Core path**, plus selected Branch name/id, account type and original decimal amount string.

| Identifier | Meaning in Teller workflow |
|---|---|
| User UUID | Beneficiary login identity carried from Customer detail and POST path /accounts/{id}; resolved by findByUserUserId |
| Customer UUID | Banking Customer row whose ID is displayed separately and stored as Account.customer_id FK, NOT Teller endpoint path |
| Account UUID | New generated Account.account_id, returned by Core, used for detail/history/update/close routes |
| Account number | New 10-digit human number, displayed and linked in directory through Account UUID; no number-based lookup API |
| Branch ID | Real integer from GET /branches, passed in AccountRequestDTO and validated by BranchRepository.findById |

| Product | Core minimum LKR | Staff form checks |
|---|---|---|
| SAVINGS | 1000.00 | Nonnegative exact decimal with >=1000 |
| CHECKING | 0.00 | Zero permitted; no opening journal |
| FIXED_DEPOSIT | 5000.00 | Nonnegative exact decimal with >=5000 |

`POST /api/v1/accounts/{User UUID}`, body `{"accountType":"SAVINGS","initialDeposit":"1000.10","branchId":21}`; web [bank-web/lib/api/staff.ts](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/lib/api/staff.ts)→[bank-web/lib/api/accounts.ts](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/lib/api/accounts.ts)→[bank-web/lib/api/http.ts](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/lib/api/http.ts) adds CSRF and body; [bank-web/lib/server/banking-upstream.ts](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/lib/server/banking-upstream.ts) forwards authenticated bearer and body. Unlike CUSTOMER `POST /accounts`, **Teller endpoint has no Idempotency-Key argument and does not call CustomerAccountOpeningIdempotencyService**. Core @PreAuthorize TELLER and [bank-core/features/accounts/application/impl/AccountServiceImpl.java](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-core/blob/9f58e595a653db9d8aa59b70a35af8e2b0e725d3/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/accounts/application/impl/AccountServiceImpl.java).openAccount() resolves target `CustomerRepository.findByUserUserId(targetUserId)`. TELLER branch of implementation **bypasses latest APPROVED KYC check**; it does not recheck beneficiary User.role, Customer.status or User activation, only linked Customer existence, branch, account type and money. This is currently supported behavior, distinct from Customer self-service KYC gate; no presumption of policy correctness.

Core validates actual persisted Branch, product minimum and precise positive LKR amount through BigDecimal/MonetaryAmount. With fund >0 it validates active ASSET `SYSTEM_VAULT_CASH:LKR`, creates zero Account + ACTIVE Customer LIABILITY ledger mapping, posts a `DEPOSIT` journal with DEBIT vault and CREDIT customer liability through PostingEngine using current Teller User actor and `LedgerChannel.WEB`, updates Account.balance and legacy history in same transaction. Zero-funded Checking creates Account+liability mapping with no journal; no observed physical cash receipt, cashier register, external funding or cash provenance integration. Source tests cover service postings/rollback and Teller bypass; no test execution.

**Success:** Core returns HTTP 201 AccountResponseDTO (accountId, accountNumber, accountType, status, balance, createdAt/updatedAt). Web receipt shows those returned fields, selected Customer and Branch as *request context*, and explicitly discloses that Core response does not return Customer or Branch identifiers. Web GETs `/accounts/{new Account UUID}` for current status/balance and shows Refresh details if it fails, while still retaining confirmed creation. Links lead to account-scoped history (funded opening shows 'Opening deposit') and selected Customer details. The Teller form has no separate review-before-POST screen.

**Failure/recovery:** Frontend submit uses ref lock/disabled fieldset, rejects no linked Customer, no Branch and invalid decimal/minimum; definitive 400/401/403/404/422 show actionable messages. On 502/504/network/timeout or ambiguous 5xx it suppresses form and displays **uncertain**, warns the account may already exist, forbids a simple Retry and directs staff to authorized reconciliation. There is **no durable Teller opening idempotency key, client operation record, customer-scoped opening recovery GET or receipt lookup**; page reload resets this memory-only state and another POST could independently create another account. A unique random account number prevents identifier collision, **not repeated logical openings**.

### Staff metadata update and status boundary

`Edit account type or branch → GET /branches (real list) → select type, select Branch explicitly → Review account changes → Confirm`. Current type comes from AccountResponseDTO; current Branch **unknown**, so no initial branch preselection. Before POST-like mutation the form GETs fresh Account and compares ID/type/status/balance/updatedAt to loaded snapshot; a mismatch blocks change and requests review, but this **is not a server-side compare-and-swap**. PUT `/api/v1/accounts/{Account UUID}` uses shared AccountRequestDTO with accountType, Branch ID, `initialDeposit=latest.balance`. Core [bank-core/features/accounts/application/impl/AccountServiceImpl.java](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-core/blob/9f58e595a653db9d8aa59b70a35af8e2b0e725d3/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/accounts/application/impl/AccountServiceImpl.java).updateAccount() locks Account row, updates type+branch+updatedAt and **does not read/deposit the initialDeposit or post journal entries**. A 200 response and GET verify account type and unchanged balance but **do not verify Branch assignment** because API omits Branch. Uncertain PUT never auto-replays, warns about unverified Branch. CLOSED account metadata can still be edited; no product-transition business rules, interest/maturity handling or historical journal rewrite.

Status enum `ACTIVE/FROZEN/CLOSED`, read/directory display and closure eligibility are functional. [bank-core/features/accounts/interfaces/dto/UpdateAccountStatusDTO.java](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-core/blob/9f58e595a653db9d8aa59b70a35af8e2b0e725d3/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/accounts/interfaces/dto/UpdateAccountStatusDTO.java) is empty; [bank-core/features/accounts/application/impl/AccountServiceImpl.java](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-core/blob/9f58e595a653db9d8aa59b70a35af8e2b0e725d3/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/accounts/application/impl/AccountServiceImpl.java).changeAccountStatus() internally supports status changes (routing CLOSED to closure checks) but **there is no @PreAuthorize staff controller status update endpoint, no web freeze/unfreeze/reopen action**. Posting rejects non-ACTIVE accounts. The internal service method does not establish a staff callable workflow. Account.status differs from Customer.status; avoid conflating with Staff Customer lifecycle (STAFF-CUST-009) or account domain status score (ACC-013).

### Staff zero-balance closure, retention and uncertain outcome

Staff details enable Close only on ACTIVE and exact zero string balance, allow cancel, show explicit confirmation with both stored and derived-ledger-zero rule, and re-fetch current Account before DELETE (snapshot ID/type/status/balance/updatedAt compare). If stale, no DELETE. API client `DELETE /api/v1/accounts/{Account UUID}` with CSRF expects **204**; Core [bank-core/features/accounts/application/impl/AccountServiceImpl.java](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-core/blob/9f58e595a653db9d8aa59b70a35af8e2b0e725d3/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/accounts/application/impl/AccountServiceImpl.java).closeAccount @Transactional uses PESSIMISTIC_WRITE Account lock and refresh, checks **stored Account.balance = 0 AND derived Customer liability ledger balance = 0**, valid linked ACTIVE LedgerAccount, Account ACTIVE (repeat CLOSED at zero returns 204 no-op), then sets Account.status CLOSED and updatedAt, retaining account, ledger mapping and all history. Frozen cannot close; positive and negative balances fail. Posting/closure share Account row lock, preventing completion with unsettled amount; no cash-settlement is performed by close.

After HTTP 204 the UI **GETs account details again** and only shows confirmed CLOSED when read-back says CLOSED. If readback fails, records confirmed-but-not-verified and disables premature close. On transport/BFF 502/504 or parse uncertainty, it GETs current Account: CLOSED → confirmed by readback, ACTIVE → unresolved original may still finish, GET failed → unresolved/manual Refresh. **No second DELETE is sent automatically**. 422 ERR_ACCOUNT_BALANCE_NONZERO is a definitive rejection with fresh Account read; backend can reject a displayed stored zero when ledger-derived balance is nonzero. CLOSED remains listed and its full account history accessible, while Close action disappears and metadata Edit can remain. Full financial posting/closure lock foundations ACC-012/TXN-006 are not re-scored.

### Staff account-scoped history and financial permissions

`/staff/accounts/{accountId}/transactions` renders [bank-web/components/banking/HistoryView.tsx](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/components/banking/HistoryView.tsx) and [bank-web/components/banking/TransactionTable.tsx](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/components/banking/TransactionTable.tsx), simultaneously GETs account details and `GET /api/v1/accounts/{Account UUID}/transactions`. [bank-core/features/transactions/application/impl/TransactionQueryServiceImpl.java](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-core/blob/9f58e595a653db9d8aa59b70a35af8e2b0e725d3/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/transactions/application/impl/TransactionQueryServiceImpl.java) validates Account exists, then `TransactionRepository.findByAccountAccountIdOrderByCreatedAtDesc` returns actual persisted legacy projections with type, positive amount, balanceAfter, description, timestamp. Web validates every row's Account UUID, displays current balance, full newest-first list, empty/error/reload and client-created **CSV export of loaded rows**. This includes history for CLOSED accounts. No date/type search, pagination, receipt/journal reference, counterparty details, debit-credit sign normalization, account statement or true finance reconciliation UI. The generic `GET /api/v1/transactions` returns literal `"All transactions"` placeholder and is **not** used by staff HistoryView (TXN-016).

Customer deposit/withdraw/transfer endpoints are `CUSTOMER`-only in [bank-core/features/transactions/interfaces/TransactionController.java](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-core/blob/9f58e595a653db9d8aa59b70a35af8e2b0e725d3/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/transactions/interfaces/TransactionController.java), not Teller cash-desk actions. Admin reversal `POST /transactions/{journalEntryId}/reversal` is ADMIN-only backend API reserved for Part12, not a staff account detail button. No connected Teller financial adjustment/cash drawer/payment/transfer/scheduled account-opening actions were discovered; do not count missing functionalities as Level0 records.

### Permission matrix: web and Core

| Action | CUSTOMER | TELLER | MANAGER | ADMIN |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Staff account directory (GET /accounts) | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Staff Account detail, any owner (GET /accounts/{id}) | Owner only via API | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Teller-assisted create (POST /accounts/{User UUID}) | No | Yes | No | No |
| Customer self-open (POST /accounts) | Yes, approved KYC | No | No | No |
| Account type/Branch update (PUT /accounts/{id}) | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Freeze/unfreeze/reopen status action | No exposed operation | No exposed operation | No exposed operation | No exposed operation |
| Account closure (DELETE /accounts/{id}) | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Account-scoped history (GET /accounts/{id}/transactions) | Owner only | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Customer deposit/withdraw/transfer endpoints | Yes (owned) | No | No | No |
| Admin reversal API (Part 12) | No | No | No | Yes |
| Generic GET /transactions literal stub | No | Yes | No | Yes |

'Owner only' for CUSTOMER means Core detail/history permits `@securityService.isAccountOwner` on a Customer Account UUID, while staff **web routes** remain guarded for staff. All staff roles have global Account list/detail/PUT/DELETE/history, no branch-specific account authorization. Teller has uniquely permitted staff opening, and Manager/Admin cannot access that POST merely because they can manage accounts. Staff login state depends on User active, current role and Employee ACTIVE when linked; all authenticated browser mutations also need CSRF, but Core role checks remain authoritative.

### Actual outcomes and operational recovery

| Scenario | Backend/BFF outcome | Staff action/result |
|---|---|---|
| Teller opening success | POST /accounts/{User UUID} 201 + AccountResponseDTO | Shows new account receipt, GET by new Account UUID, History/Customer links; no key replay |
| Missing linked Customer or wrong handoff UUID | No valid selection or Core 404 Customer not found | Shows invalid selection/404; refresh Customers, no account created |
| Wrong/missing Branch, no branches | Web requires selected real branch; Core findById 404 | Blocks submit or shows branch missing and load retry |
| Below product minimum / invalid decimal | Web blocks; Core ERR_MIN_DEPOSIT/ERR_DEPOSIT_INVALID 422 or DTO 400 | Correct form; no committed opening |
| Checking zero opening | Core 201 without deposit journal | Account ACTIVE and liability LedgerAccount created, balance 0 |
| Positive funding accepted | Core 201 in atomic account+ledger/journal transaction | LKR vault debit/liability credit; history 'Opening deposit', no external-cash evidence |
| Opening POST timeout after possible commit | BFF 502/504/network/parse or 5xx | No retry button; uncertain warning, manual operator reconciliation required; no GET by operation key |
| Opening auth denied/expired | Core 403/401 | Definitive rejection, redirect/session guidance; no automatic POST replay |
| Account directory missing data / backend down | GET /accounts fails 401/403/404/transport | Shows error with Reload accounts |
| Unknown Account UUID | GET /accounts/{id} 404 | Detail load error and Reload/Back |
| Metadata update success | PUT /accounts/{id} 200 | Type and balance reread; desired Branch cannot be verified by DTO |
| Metadata update concurrent change | Preflight GET mismatches client snapshot | Stops without PUT, refreshes; no server CAS after preflight |
| Metadata PUT ambiguous response | Network/504 | No auto retry; GET readback, branch cannot be verified |
| Close at ACTIVE exact zero | Preflight GET then DELETE 204 + GET | CLOSED displayed with history preserved, close button hidden |
| Nonzero stored or derived ledger balance | UI blocks stored nonzero; Core 422 ERR_ACCOUNT_BALANCE_NONZERO for either | No closure, refresh; settlement through separate authorized operation |
| FROZEN account at zero | UI Close disabled; Core rejects ERR_ACCOUNT_NOT_ACTIVE | No closure; no staff freeze/unfreeze workflow |
| Already CLOSED account | UI hides Close, Core repeated close zero is no-op 204 | CLOSED row/detail/history retained, metadata editing still possible |
| Posting/closure concurrency | Core locks+refreshes, rejects nonzero or non-ACTIVE as applicable | No partial closure; UI readback after result |
| Closure DELETE timeout | BFF 504 or network, GET status | If CLOSED confirm, if ACTIVE/failed lookup leave uncertain; no duplicate DELETE |
| Staff history empty / unavailable | GET history [] / 401/403/404/transport | No transactions message or Reload history; loaded rows CSV download |

#### STAFF-ACC-005 — Teller-assisted opening, product and branch rules, and atomic initial funding

- **Review part:** 08 — Teller-assisted opening and staff account operations.
- **User roles:** TELLER only; beneficiary is selected linked Customer.
- **User objective:** Create real internal LKR bank Account using staff-assisted form with product, branch and opening amount.
- **Workflow boundary:** Create real internal LKR bank Account using staff-assisted form with product, branch and opening amount. This Part 08 record scores a staff-facing interaction or operational recovery boundary, NOT a second score for ACC-001/002/006/007/008/010/011/012/013/014 or TXN-005/006/011/013. - **Complete workflow steps:** On Teller form choose SAVINGS/CHECKING/FIXED_DEPOSIT, real Branch integer and initialDeposit decimal text (SAVINGS min LKR1000, CHECKING 0, FIXED_DEPOSIT 5000), no separate pre-submit review stage. Form validateOpeningDeposit enforces nonnegative plain amount with at most two fractional digits for positive funding and integer minimum, then pendingRef+fieldset disable double-clicks. POST /api/v1/accounts/{targetUserId} JSON AccountRequestDTO {accountType,initialDeposit:string,branchId:integer}, CSRF-protected BFF bearer-forwarded, no Idempotency-Key header, Core Controller @PreAuthorize TELLER. Service @Transactional resolves Customer by target User, bypasses latest KYC for Teller and does not check Customer.status/target User role; verifies branch exists, nonnegative/min deposits and exact LKR. Creates new generated Account UUID, 10-digit accountNumber, ACTIVE LKR account and linked LIABILITY ledger; when funded, vault ACTIVE ASSET SYSTEM_VAULT_CASH:LKR debit/Customer liability credit, journal DEPOSIT, materialized balance + legacy Transaction in same DB transaction; zero Checking creates no opening journal. HTTP 201 AccountResponseDTO followed by confirmation workflow. Teller is not modeled as physical cash collection; LedgerChannel.WEB and current staff User actor. No teller-specific key or authenticated cash drawer proof.

#### STAFF-ACC-007 — Teller opening uncertain-outcome protection without durable reconciliation

- **Review part:** 08 — Teller-assisted opening and staff account operations.
- **User roles:** TELLER after ambiguous opening response.
- **User objective:** Avoid accidentally creating a second account when POST result cannot be confirmed.
- **Workflow boundary:** Avoid accidentally creating a second account when POST result cannot be confirmed. This Part 08 record scores a staff-facing interaction or operational recovery boundary, NOT a second score for ACC-001/002/006/007/008/010/011/012/013/014 or TXN-005/006/011/013. STAFF-CUST-010 only establishes the source Customer-detail handoff, whereas this part follows the Teller opening form. Full Manager Teller lifecycle Part 09, Admin User/Customer Part 11, admin reversals Part 12, Android-wide Part 14, platform Part 15 remain unreviewed.
- **Complete workflow steps:** StaffAccountForm uses pendingRef to block repeated clicks while opening in flight; isUncertainStaffAccountOpening covers network/timeout, 502 BANKING_UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE, 504 BANKING_UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT, retryable transport and unspecified 5xx (excluding auth expiry/401/403). On uncertain POST, sets uncertain to selected Customer, replaces form with explicit 'Account opening result is uncertain', warns that an account may already exist and **no safe idempotent retry/customer-scoped opening lookup exists**, asks authorized operations reconciliation and gives Back to customer details. There is no Retry opening button, no repeated POST, no automatic account GET because account UUID may not have been returned, and no persisted key/payload or cross-navigation recovery. Definitive 401/403/404/400/422 errors preserve editable form; absence of retry on ambiguous result reduces immediate duplication risk, but page reload resets warning and another independent POST may create another account. Core POST /accounts/{User UUID} has no Idempotency-Key parameter and does not invoke customer self-service claim coordinator; multiple intentional same-customer account types are allowed.

#### STAFF-ACC-008 — Staff account type and branch metadata review, change and limited verification

- **Review part:** 08 — Teller-assisted opening and staff account operations.
- **User roles:** TELLER, MANAGER, ADMIN.
- **User objective:** Change account type and chosen Branch without moving funds.
- **Workflow boundary:** Change account type and chosen Branch without moving funds. This Part 08 record scores a staff-facing interaction or operational recovery boundary, NOT a second score for ACC-001/002/006/007/008/010/011/012/013/014 or TXN-005/006/011/013. STAFF-CUST-010 only establishes the source Customer-detail handoff, whereas this part follows the Teller opening form. Full Manager Teller lifecycle Part 09, Admin User/Customer Part 11, admin reversals Part 12, Android-wide Part 14, platform Part 15 remain unreviewed.
- **Complete workflow steps:** StaffAccountDetail loaded by Account UUID → Edit account type or branch → GET /branches?page=1&limit=100, initialize current accountType from AccountResponseDTO but branch selection blank because DTO has no current Branch. Select one of three account types plus explicit real branch, Review account changes displays accountType old→new and desired branch; Confirm reads fresh GET /accounts/{id} and compares accountId/type/status/balance/updatedAt in browser against previously loaded snapshot. If changed, aborts and asks re-review. Builds AccountRequestDTO {accountType,branchId,initialDeposit:latest.balance}, forwards exact four-decimal balance string **only because DTO requires deposit**, performs CSRF-protected PUT /accounts/{id}. Core updateAccount @Transactional locks Account row and refreshes, sets type and finds real Branch, updatedAt; ignores initialDeposit entirely, does not post ledger funding/change owner/status or balance. Web reads returned accountId and GETs same account again. Type/status/balance are verifiable, but **branch cannot be verified by AccountResponseDTO**, even after reread. No server If-Match/optimistic precondition; web snapshot comparison is not atomic. API does not forbid metadata changes to CLOSED account; web keeps edit available after closure. A 409 triggers GET; uncertain outcome no automatic PUT replay, advises branch verification.

#### STAFF-ACC-009 — Staff account status visibility with backend-only freeze/reactivate boundary

- **Review part:** 08 — Teller-assisted opening and staff account operations.
- **User roles:** TELLER, MANAGER, ADMIN staff readers; no exposed staff status mutation.

Core enum declares three, AccountServiceImpl.changeAccountStatus(id,status) internally locks account and routes CLOSED through closeLockedAccount; for ACTIVE/FROZEN it sets status and updatedAt, but AccountController exposes no @PatchMapping/PUT status endpoint, UpdateAccountStatusDTO is empty, and StaffAccountDetail has no freeze, unfreeze, reactivate or reopen controls. Existing staff DELETE closes zero ACTIVE Account; status method otherwise not callable as standalone exposed flow. Core posting rejects Account != ACTIVE even while linked ledger may remain ACTIVE on CLOSED; a FROZEN Account at zero cannot close via staff UI. UI shows status and impacts Close button, not management of FROZEN state. Refer to ACC-013 existing backend-only status service instead of scoring it as another implemented backend feature.

#### STAFF-ACC-010 — Staff confirmation-based zero-balance account closure and retention

- **Review part:** 08 — Teller-assisted opening and staff account operations.
- **User roles:** TELLER, MANAGER, ADMIN.
- **User objective:** Close eligible ACTIVE Account without deleting financial history or moving funds.
- **Workflow boundary:** Close eligible ACTIVE Account without deleting financial history or moving funds. This Part 08 record scores a staff-facing interaction or operational recovery boundary, NOT a second score for ACC-001/002/006/007/008/010/011/012/013/014 or TXN-005/006/011/013. STAFF-CUST-010 only establishes the source Customer-detail handoff, whereas this part follows the Teller opening form. Full Manager Teller lifecycle Part 09, Admin User/Customer Part 11, admin reversals Part 12, Android-wide Part 14, platform Part 15 remain unreviewed.
- **Complete workflow steps:** Open /staff/accounts/{Account UUID}; account read shows status/balance and 'Close account' button for non-CLOSED, enabled only if ACTIVE and exact decimal zero (including 0.0000), disabled on nonzero or FROZEN. Confirm account closure panel notes both stored and ledger-derived balances must be zero; user confirms. Before DELETE, browser GETs latest Account, compares accountId/type/status/balance/updatedAt to prior snapshot and rechecks eligibility; if changed or unavailable, aborts without DELETE. Authorized accountsApi.close issues CSRF-protected DELETE /api/v1/accounts/{UUID}, expects exact HTTP 204. Core AccountController @PreAuthorize ADMIN/TELLER/MANAGER → AccountServiceImpl.closeAccount @Transactional PESSIMISTIC_WRITE row+refresh, requires stored balance zero and derived liability ledger balance zero, valid LIABILTY/LKR ledger mapping and ACTIVE Account/ledger, sets account.status CLOSED and updatedAt, no row deletion. Posting engine uses same Account row locks and rejects CLOSED. Web on 204 calls reconcileClose('confirmed') reading fresh GET and only reports verified CLOSED; stops closure button, retains history/edit links. Repeat Core close of zero CLOSED returns 204 no-op but web omits button. 422 ERR_ACCOUNT_BALANCE_NONZERO refreshes Account and shows rejection; FROZEN cannot close. Staff cannot settle remaining balance from this view; financial actions separate.

#### STAFF-ACC-011 — Closure timeout, stale-state and read-back recovery without duplicate DELETE

- **Review part:** 08 — Teller-assisted opening and staff account operations.
- **User roles:** TELLER, MANAGER, ADMIN who submitted closure.
- **User objective:** Resolve lost or ambiguous 204 response without automatically repeating financial-state change.
- **Workflow boundary:** Resolve lost or ambiguous 204 response without automatically repeating financial-state change. This Part 08 record scores a staff-facing interaction or operational recovery boundary, NOT a second score for ACC-001/002/006/007/008/010/011/012/013/014 or TXN-005/006/011/013. STAFF-CUST-010 only establishes the source Customer-detail handoff, whereas this part follows the Teller opening form. Full Manager Teller lifecycle Part 09, Admin User/Customer Part 11, admin reversals Part 12, Android-wide Part 14, platform Part 15 remain unreviewed.
- **Complete workflow steps:** StaffAccountDetail confirmClose mutationLock guards concurrent clicks. Before commit, preflight GET compares snapshot; failure stops submission. After successful DELETE 204 it runs reconcileClose('confirmed') GET by same Account UUID; if GET CLOSED displays confirmed success, if GET still ACTIVE or fails it flags confirmed-but-not-verified and disables immediate closure through closeReadback. For 502/504/network/timeout/parse after DELETE, UI states outcome uncertain and calls reconcileClose('uncertain') GET; if CLOSED confirms by readback, if still present ACTIVE says original request may still finish and **no retry was sent**; if GET fails tells staff to Refresh account details to check later. In all ambiguous cases no second DELETE is sent. 422 nonzero ledger balance is definitive, refreshes account, and allows staff to review whether future close becomes eligible. Reconciliation is a read-only status check, not an idempotency token; it cannot prove exact operation intent when account is still ACTIVE. Core duplicate CLOSED closure is internally idempotent under zero checks but UI never relies on retry to recover unknown state.
- **Frontend / Android:** Web: [bank-web/components/banking/StaffAccountDetail.tsx](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/components/banking/StaffAccountDetail.tsx); [bank-web/lib/api/accounts.ts](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/lib/api/accounts.ts); [bank-web/lib/api/http.ts](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/lib/api/http.ts). - **Next.js BFF / API integration:** [bank-web/lib/api/accounts.ts](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/lib/api/accounts.ts); [bank-web/lib/api/http.ts](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/lib/api/http.ts); [bank-web/app/api/v1/[...path]/route.ts](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/app/api/v1/%5B...path%5D/route.ts); [bank-web/lib/server/banking-upstream.ts](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/lib/server/banking-upstream.ts). Same-origin authenticated cookie/BFF forwards bearer to Core, requires CSRF for mutating POST/PUT/DELETE, handles upstream 502/504; authenticated responses no-store; DELETE expects 204. BFF does not supply business authority or Teller idempotency by itself.
- **Spring Boot implementation:** [bank-core/features/accounts/interfaces/AccountController.java](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-core/blob/9f58e595a653db9d8aa59b70a35af8e2b0e725d3/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/accounts/interfaces/AccountController.java); [bank-core/features/accounts/application/impl/AccountServiceImpl.java](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-core/blob/9f58e595a653db9d8aa59b70a35af8e2b0e725d3/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/accounts/application/impl/AccountServiceImpl.java); [bank-core/features/accounts/domain/repository/AccountRepository.java](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-core/blob/9f58e595a653db9d8aa59b70a35af8e2b0e725d3/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/accounts/domain/repository/AccountRepository.java).
- **Database / ledger:** Account.status/updatedAt are observable authority for closure; no separate closure receipt/operation status or closure idempotency claim; no second database DELETE by UI during reconciliation.
- **External dependencies:** Real Spring Boot/MySQL/ledger service, Next.js BFF and authorized User/Employee/Customer identities. No FastAPI ML call during Teller opening and no evidenced external cash-custody/PayHere payment event from this workflow. KYC is checked for Customer self-opening only.

### Part 09 — Manager Teller lifecycle

**Status:** COMPLETE — GitHub source-confirmed review only; integrated runtime verification NOT performed.

**Source snapshots, 2026-11-24:** bank-web `012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27`; bank-core `9f58e595a653db9d8aa59b70a35af8e2b0e725d3`; bank-service `cabdd323b4aa394910cb192ead6d233e9a12d9d3`; bank-app `9d98ba24cb754b8295bd58770cd502438d3b7b38`. All four main HEADs match prior snapshots; GitHub trees inspected and not truncated. Direct review includes ManagerTellerDirectory, navigation/authorization, Teller API and BFF, TellerController, EmployeeServiceImpl and Employee/User/Role/Session persistence, Admin-only access-control boundary, Spring tests, Playwright/Vitest and Android navigation. No direct FastAPI dependency found in Manager Teller lifecycle; only its ref inspected. No financial/identity writes or tests run.

**Boundaries:** This is the Manager-oriented **existing User→Employee/TELLER promotion and retirement workflow**. No general AUTH re-score (AUTH-003/005/008/010), no separate banking Customer identity (STAFF-CUST-005/006), no Teller bank Account creation (STAFF-ACC-005), no full Admin role editor (Part11), and no Android-wide review (Part14).

### Manager workspace, Teller directory and local search

Manager login lands /staff; its header Tellers link and Manager-only StaffPage card lead to `/staff/tellers`. [bank-web/app/(staff)/staff/tellers/page.tsx](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/app/(staff)/staff/tellers/page.tsx) uses PAGE_ROLES.manager=[MANAGER], and [bank-core/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/employee/interfaces/TellerController.java](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-core/blob/9f58e595a653db9d8aa59b70a35af8e2b0e725d3/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/employee/interfaces/TellerController.java) independently restricts every Teller lifecycle route to MANAGER. Admin/Teller/Customer are denied the Manager Teller endpoint; ADMIN has separate Admin-only general access-control endpoints reserved for Part11. `User.canAuthenticate` and protected JWT/session lookup require active User and linked Employee ACTIVE when present.

Directory `GET /api/v1/tellers` → findEmployeesByRoleName("TELLER") → EmployeeRepository.findByRole(TELLER) returns complete TELLER-role Employee rows, ACTIVE and INACTIVE former retained rows; no server pagination, search, sort, branch or managerId limit. Browser searches loaded full name, Employee email, phone, department, status and linked User UUID, case-insensitive. It supports loading, empty/no-match, 401/403/error, Retry/Refresh and inline email-keyed row selection. EmployeeRepository has an unused role/name/email search method, but this controller does not call it. [bank-web/components/banking/ManagerTellerDirectory.tsx](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/components/banking/ManagerTellerDirectory.tsx) shows details and available actions conditional on linked User UUID/status.

### Distinct identities and stored employee model

| Identifier | Implementation | Manager Teller meaning |
|---|---|---|
| User UUID | users.user_id | Existing login identity; POST /tellers?userId and PUT/DELETE /tellers/{id} expect this UUID |
| Employee UUID | employees.employee_id | Generated and retained separate employment row; not included in Teller EmployeeResponse |
| User.employee ID | users.employee_id UNIQUE FK | One linked Employee per User; cleared on removal |
| User and Employee role | users.role_id and employees.role_id | Both set TELLER on promotion, Employee role remains TELLER after resignation while User role reverts CUSTOMER |
| Employee status | employees.status: ACTIVE, INACTIVE, PENDING, RESIGNED | Assignment/edit sets ACTIVE; removal sets INACTIVE |
| Employee hire/resignation dates | employees.hire_date, resignation_date | HireDate available in DTO; resignationDate persisted but omitted from Manager response |
| Manager UUID | employees.manager_id self-reference | Optional backend TellerRequest.managerId, not exposed in Manager form |
| Branch ID | No TellerRequest/Employee branch field | Teller Branch assignment not supported |
| Banking Customer UUID | customers separate domain | Teller assignment does not create/modify banking Customer record |
| Employee number | No human employee number in Teller API | No separate Employee ID issued in Manager workflow |

The existing-User selector calls Manager-only GET `/api/v1/tellers/users`, which returns **all** UserDirectoryResponse entries; frontend narrows candidates to active CUSTOMER role with email, then locally searches name/username/email and prefills Employee draft fields. The backend assignment method restricts only **ADMIN** targets (not every non-CUSTOMER role, User.isActive, verified email or Manager self-target). That is a source-confirmed difference between UI eligibility and Core; not a claim that privileged direct invocation is a supported Manager UI feature.

### Creation/assignment and first Teller login

`MANAGER → Assign existing customer as Teller → choose User UUID → supply Employee profile → POST /api/v1/tellers?userId={User UUID}`. [bank-web/components/banking/ManagerTellerDirectory.tsx](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/components/banking/ManagerTellerDirectory.tsx) asks name, readonly User.email, phone, address, Gender MALE/FEMALE/OTHER, past DOB, optional department. [bank-core/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/employee/interfaces/dto/TellerRequest.java](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-core/blob/9f58e595a653db9d8aa59b70a35af8e2b0e725d3/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/employee/interfaces/dto/TellerRequest.java) validates required fields/email/address length/gender/date; BFF adds bearer/CSRF to request. [bank-core/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/employee/application/impl/EmployeeServiceImpl.java](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-core/blob/9f58e595a653db9d8aa59b70a35af8e2b0e725d3/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/employee/application/impl/EmployeeServiceImpl.java) @Transactional locks User by UUID, rejects ADMIN target, finds TELLER Role, finds existing Employee by User association or email else creates Employee, verifies email uniqueness, sets TELLER on both Employee and User, Employee ACTIVE, first hireDate, cleared resignation date, links User↔Employee, persists and revokes previously authorized sessions. It neither creates a new login nor sends an invitation/credential. Core responds **201 plain text** (not Employee object); web shows success and GETs refreshed Teller and eligible User list. **New Teller uses original username/password in a fresh session**; old CUSTOMER token cannot become TELLER simply by the role mutation.

### Employment details, edits and status

Selected Teller detail comes from list DTO, not a dedicated single-Teller GET. It shows Employee name/email/role/status/department/phone/hireDate/manager Employee UUID and linked User UUID, or not linked; explicitly says **Employee ID not returned** and Branch unsupported. Employee.address/Gender/DOB are returned and used in edit form, but User.username/current User.email/user active flag and resignationDate are not in DTO.

`Edit Teller profile → PUT /api/v1/tellers/{User UUID}` uses the same TellerRequest/EmployeeService. Updates Employee fields (including Employee.email independent of User.email), forces Employee.role=TELLER and Employee.status=ACTIVE, reasserts User.role=TELLER. If already ACTIVE TELLER, existing session remains; changed authorization revokes. The backend also supports optional `managerId` target Employee UUID through request, but Manager UI neither edits it nor validates/chooses Branch. No explicit role/status selector or Employee audit versioning/actor. Success 200 plain text and fresh directory read.

**Reactivation is partial:** still-linked inactive Employee can use "Reactivate and edit profile" and PUT to become ACTIVE. Confirmed removal detaches User and leaves historical INACTIVE Employee with `userId=null`; no direct "Reactivate" action on that row. The former User can be selected again as now CUSTOMER for a fresh POST; Core may reuse detached Employee record by unique email if matching, but no guaranteed Employee-UUID restoration or dedicated rehire contract. PENDING/RESIGNED are enum values without Manager status action. Admin generic Employee/role state maintenance Part11 remains unreviewed.

### Removal, session revocation and Manager recovery

Manager selects ACTIVE linked Teller → Remove Teller assignment → reads explicit confirmation → DELETE `/api/v1/tellers/{User UUID}`. [bank-core/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/employee/application/impl/EmployeeServiceImpl.java](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-core/blob/9f58e595a653db9d8aa59b70a35af8e2b0e725d3/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/employee/application/impl/EmployeeServiceImpl.java) locks User, finds Employee by User UUID, sets Employee INACTIVE and resignationDate, clears User/Employee linkage, changes User.role to CUSTOMER, revokes persisted Sessions, returns **204**. Employee record remains, Employee.role TELLER, historical row stays listed INACTIVE/null User UUID; User/password/Customer/Accounts/financial history never deleted. A repeated DELETE after detachment cannot find linked Employee, so is not a durable 204 no-op.

[bank-core/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/auth/application/impl/AuthServiceImpl.java](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-core/blob/9f58e595a653db9d8aa59b70a35af8e2b0e725d3/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/auth/application/impl/AuthServiceImpl.java) deletes user Session rows on role/Employee eligibility changes. [bank-core/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/modules/common/security/JwtAuthFilter.java](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-core/blob/9f58e595a653db9d8aa59b70a35af8e2b0e725d3/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/modules/common/security/JwtAuthFilter.java) checks persisted Session fingerprint and current User.role, User.isActive, BANNED and linked Employee ACTIVE state, so **old signed but revoked bearer receives 401** on next request; valid new CUSTOMER cannot use TELLER opening (403). Fresh login with old credentials returns current role; later restoration does not reactivate previous token. Generic session technology AUTH-005/008 not rescored.

One Manager write is guarded by `writeInFlight` ref/disabled buttons. For timeout/network/502/504/unknown response after POST, PUT or DELETE, Manager UI performs **only read-only** GET `/tellers` (plus GET `/tellers/users` for removal), comparing matching target User UUID/Employee role+status, full profile on update or inactive/detached former Employee plus CUSTOMER User on removal. Matching state reports prior response interrupted but confirmed by readback; no repeated write. Unmatched/read failure leaves unresolved attempt, disables further writes and offers Check current state. Definite 400/401/403/404/409/422/429 errors are not auto-replayed; known successful response with failed directory refresh stays acknowledged with warning. **No durable idempotency key, operation-receipt lookup, cross-reload pending record or actor-attributable reconciliation**; current-state match does not prove which Manager performed it.

| Scenario | Backend/BFF result | Manager-visible effect |
|---|---|---|
| Manager directory success | GET /tellers 200 EmployeeResponse[] | Full Teller-role Employee list including inactive former; client local search and selection |
| Wrong role or revoked session | Core 403 or 401 | Guard sends wrong-role to unauthorized, expired session to login; Manager operation unavailable |
| Candidate lookup | GET /tellers/users 200 all User records | Browser only shows active CUSTOMER candidates; User UUID used for POST |
| Missing target User | Core resource not found 404 | Manager corrects selection and refreshes candidate list |
| Valid promotion | POST /tellers?userId 201 plain success | Employee ACTIVE, User TELLER, sessions revoked; refreshed directory |
| Invalid fields | 400 @Valid or web client validation | Correct email/name/phone/address/gender/Past DOB, no persisted action |
| Duplicate Employee email | 409 ConflictException | Conflict surfaced and directory reloaded without repeat write |
| Direct Manager POST for non-ADMIN but non-CUSTOMER User | Backend only excludes ADMIN | Can assign TELLER despite browser filtering; server eligibility boundary |
| Profile update | PUT /tellers/{User UUID} 200 | Employee fields updated, User.email unaffected; normal active edit retains sessions |
| Still-linked inactive Employee edit | PUT restores ACTIVE/TELLER | Reactivates and revokes sessions as eligibility changed |
| Removed former Employee row | Employee status INACTIVE, userId null | Remains selectable for read-only history, no direct restore action |
| Confirmed removal | DELETE /tellers/{User UUID} 204 | User CUSTOMER, Employee INACTIVE/detached, sessions revoked and refresh |
| Repeat remove after detachment | Employee lookup by User UUID 404 | No idempotent 204 replay; UI hides action |
| Fresh login after promotion/removal | New session current role | Old token 401; fresh TELLER or CUSTOMER based on persisted role |
| Ambiguous create/update/remove | 502/504/network/timeout; commit may already exist | Read-only GET Teller list and User list for remove; no automatic repeat mutation |
| Read-back cannot verify outcome | GET fails or current data not matching | Unresolved disables Manager write and offers Check current state; no durable after-reload recovery |
| Audit/history request | Employee.hireDate, resignationDate persisted | No Manager lifecycle event/actor log query or reason exposed |

### Role/permission matrix

| Capability | CUSTOMER | TELLER | MANAGER | ADMIN |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET /tellers directory | No | No | Yes | No |
| GET /tellers/users (all-User read, client candidate filtering) | No | No | Yes | No |
| POST /tellers?userId existing-User promotion | No | No | Yes | No |
| PUT /tellers/{User UUID} Employee profile / ACTIVE | No | No | Yes | No |
| DELETE /tellers/{User UUID} remove assignment | No | No | Yes | No |
| Dedicated Manager status/restore/suspend endpoint | No | No | No | No |
| Admin GET /access-control/employees, /roles, /users | No | No | No | Yes |
| Admin PUT /access-control/roles/{User UUID} | No | No | No | Yes |
| Teller-assisted bank Account POST /accounts/{User UUID} | No | Yes | No | No |
| Manager-generated Teller password/invite | No | No | Not implemented | Not established here |

Backend Teller Controller methods all require MANAGER; ADMIN's general /access-control User/Employee/Role directory/update API is separate Part11. Manager cannot assign MANAGER/ADMIN roles through Teller workflow, which always sets TELLER. In Core a non-ADMIN target other than CUSTOMER is not independently prohibited by assignment service, unlike browser candidate filtering.

#### MGR-TELLER-004 — Manager Teller assignment from existing login and transactional TELLER promotion

- **Review part:** 09 — Manager Teller lifecycle.
- **User roles:** MANAGER assigns selected active CUSTOMER login (frontend policy).
- **User objective:** Turn an existing User into a linked active Teller Employee with TELLER role and new login eligibility.
- **Workflow boundary:** Defined Manager lifecycle objective above; not a duplicate of AUTH-003/005/008 session internals, STAFF-CUST User/Customer creation, STAFF-ACC Teller account opening or reserved full Admin role management Part 11.
- **Complete workflow steps:** Manager selects User UUID, fills first/last name, read-only candidate email, phone, address, gender, past DOB, optional department; browser checks email/required fields/date/length and server @Valid TellerRequest checks @Email/@NotBlank/@NotNull/@Past/address max255. Submit sends POST /api/v1/tellers?userId={User UUID} JSON via authenticated CSRF BFF. TellerController MANAGER-only delegates @Transactional createOrUpdateTeller: lock User with findByIdForUpdate, reject ADMIN, find TELLER Role, reuse Employee by User association or email else new Employee, validate unique email, write Employee profile/role TELLER/status ACTIVE/hireDate/resignationDate null, link User.employee and Employee.user and set User.role TELLER, save and revoke all sessions if role/Employee eligibility changed. Core responds 201 plain text; UI shows confirmation, fetches Teller and User directories and selects created User. Existing User username/password/email remain; no new User, password, invitation, branch or first-login screen. New Teller signs in afresh using old credentials and a new token.

#### MGR-TELLER-005 — User-Employee UUID linkage, email uniqueness and atomic conflict handling

- **Review part:** 09 — Manager Teller lifecycle.
- **User roles:** MANAGER performing Teller create or update.
- **User objective:** Preserve single linked Employee identity and avoid overwriting another Employee or login.
- **Workflow boundary:** Defined Manager lifecycle objective above; not a duplicate of AUTH-003/005/008 session internals, STAFF-CUST User/Customer creation, STAFF-ACC Teller account opening or reserved full Admin role management Part 11.
- **Complete workflow steps:** Within createOrUpdateTeller Core locks selected User UUID and resolves Employee by existing link then Employee unique email then creates new. Employee whose User is a different UUID rejected with 409; email reused by another Employee rejected; known DB Employee email uniqueness race translated into ConflictException while other data-integrity errors remain errors. Employee and User each reference same TELLER Role after successful transaction, Employee status ACTIVE, User.employee_id unique FK protects reuse. Employee.email is independent of User.email; User username/email also independently unique. Manager web surfaces definitive 409 and refreshes directory without automatically replaying POST/PUT. Transactional saveAndFlush Employee, save User and session revocation happen together, and User row lock serializes same-target mutations.
- **Frontend / Android:** [bank-web/components/banking/ManagerTellerDirectory.tsx](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/components/banking/ManagerTellerDirectory.tsx); [bank-web/lib/api/tellers.ts](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/lib/api/tellers.ts). #### MGR-TELLER-006 — Selected Teller details and Employee versus User field presentation

- **Review part:** 09 — Manager Teller lifecycle.
- **User roles:** MANAGER.
- **User objective:** Inspect Teller employment and linked login context before edit/removal.
- **Workflow boundary:** Defined Manager lifecycle objective above; not a duplicate of AUTH-003/005/008 session internals, STAFF-CUST User/Customer creation, STAFF-ACC Teller account opening or reserved full Admin role management Part 11.
- **Complete workflow steps:** Manager clicks Employee row in /staff/tellers, selected by email; frontend renders EmployeeResponse already loaded by GET /tellers (no independent GET /tellers/{id} detail). Displays first/last name, Employee email, roleName, status, department, phone, hireDate, managerId (Manager Employee UUID) and linked User UUID, or Not linked (former Teller). It explicitly says Employee ID not returned by Core and Branch not supported. Address, gender and DOB are returned and used to populate edit form. Employee entity also stores resignationDate but DTO omits it. User username, current login email/activation and Employee UUID are not joined into EmployeeResponse. Active linked row allows Remove and linked row allows Edit; unlinked former has neither.

#### MGR-TELLER-007 — Manager Teller profile editing with forced active-state synchronization

- **Review part:** 09 — Manager Teller lifecycle.
- **User roles:** MANAGER editing linked User/Employee.
- **User objective:** Maintain Teller employment profile without unintentionally changing login credentials.
- **Workflow boundary:** Defined Manager lifecycle objective above; not a duplicate of AUTH-003/005/008 session internals, STAFF-CUST User/Customer creation, STAFF-ACC Teller account opening or reserved full Admin role management Part 11.
- **Complete workflow steps:** Select a row with linked User UUID, click Edit Teller profile, prefill Employee first/last/email/phone/address/gender/dateOfBirth/department; validate required fields, email/length, past DOB; submit PUT /api/v1/tellers/{User UUID} with TellerRequest through CSRF BFF. Controller MANAGER-only invokes transactional createOrUpdateTeller. Service changes Employee attributes and always sets Employee.role=TELLER, status=ACTIVE, resignationDate=null, and User.role=TELLER, without changing User.email, username or password; normal ACTIVE unchanged-role profile editing does not revoke sessions. If optional request.managerId supplied to Core, service looks up Employee manager by UUID and updates it; Manager UI never sends managerId and current manager remains. API returns 200 literal Teller updated, UI reloads directory. UI explicitly warns Employee email edits do not update User login email. 400/409/401/403 and uncertain errors handled separately.

#### MGR-TELLER-008 — INACTIVE Teller activation and conditional reattachment after removal

- **Review part:** 09 — Manager Teller lifecycle.
- **User roles:** MANAGER handling inactive or formerly removed Employee.
- **User objective:** Restore eligible Teller access while preserving prior employment identity where possible.
- **Workflow boundary:** Defined Manager lifecycle objective above; not a duplicate of AUTH-003/005/008 session internals, STAFF-CUST User/Customer creation, STAFF-ACC Teller account opening or reserved full Admin role management Part 11.
- **Complete workflow steps:** Core Status enum ACTIVE, INACTIVE, PENDING, RESIGNED. When an INACTIVE Employee is still linked to User, Manager sees Reactivate and edit profile; PUT /tellers/{User UUID} invokes createOrUpdateTeller and forces Employee ACTIVE, User/Employee TELLER, resignationDate null, revoking sessions if status changed. But confirmed removal detaches User and keeps Employee INACTIVE with userId=null, so its former row has no Edit/Reactivate button. Manager may select now-CUSTOMER User under Assign Teller and POST; Core can reuse detached Employee by matching email, preserving UUID/hireDate if same; otherwise cannot guarantee original Employee reuse. There is no explicit /reactivate, restore by Employee UUID, status dropdown, suspend/RESIGNED/PENDING transition, new credential flow or row-specific reattachment UI. Admin separate generic status editor Part11.

#### MGR-TELLER-009 — Confirmed Teller removal, CUSTOMER demotion and retained former Employee

- **Review part:** 09 — Manager Teller lifecycle.
- **User roles:** MANAGER removing ACTIVE linked Teller.
- **User objective:** Remove Teller operating authority without deleting User or Employee history.
- **Workflow boundary:** Defined Manager lifecycle objective above; not a duplicate of AUTH-003/005/008 session internals, STAFF-CUST User/Customer creation, STAFF-ACC Teller account opening or reserved full Admin role management Part 11.
- **Complete workflow steps:** Select ACTIVE linked row, click Remove Teller assignment, read confirmation of INACTIVE, User.role CUSTOMER, detached association, session revocation and 401/403. On Confirm issue CSRF DELETE /api/v1/tellers/{User UUID}; MANAGER-only Controller invokes @Transactional EmployeeServiceImpl.resignEmployee: lock User, load Employee by linked User UUID, reject missing/already inactive, set Employee.status INACTIVE and resignationDate now, save; find CUSTOMER role and set User.role CUSTOMER, User.employee=null, Employee.user=null; revoke all User sessions. Return HTTP 204; UI shows confirmation then reloads Teller+User lists. Employee.role TELLER and Employee row remain, so historical former Teller appears INACTIVE/null userId but no editing/removal controls. User/username/password, existing banking Customer/Account/history retained untouched. Repeat remove by former User UUID finds no Employee and is not safely idempotent.

#### MGR-TELLER-010 — Role and Employee eligibility enforcement with persisted session revocation

- **Review part:** 09 — Manager Teller lifecycle.
- **User roles:** MANAGER changes; existing CUSTOMER and TELLER users affected.
- **User objective:** Prevent old tokens from continuing Teller operations after role or Employee status changes.
- **Workflow boundary:** Defined Manager lifecycle objective above; not a duplicate of AUTH-003/005/008 session internals, STAFF-CUST User/Customer creation, STAFF-ACC Teller account opening or reserved full Admin role management Part 11.
- **Complete workflow steps:** Promotion createOrUpdateTeller detects User role not TELLER, missing Employee or Employee not ACTIVE, and calls AuthService.revokeAllSessions(userId) after persisting. Removal always revokes. Core deletes stored session rows, and JwtAuthFilter checks JWT subject/role plus server-side Session fingerprint and current User.matchesAuthorization: User.isActive, not BANNED, current role matches token and linked Employee.status ACTIVE. Old CUSTOMER/TELLER bearer after promotion/demotion receives 401 even if signature valid, refresh cannot revive; a fresh login with existing username/password returns current role. Fresh CUSTOMER cannot access TELLER account POST (403). Pure unchanged ACTIVE Teller profile updates need not revoke; previously revoked token remains invalid after any later restoration. #### MGR-TELLER-011 — Read-only reconciliation after ambiguous Manager Teller mutations

- **Review part:** 09 — Manager Teller lifecycle.
- **User roles:** MANAGER after POST/PUT/DELETE unknown outcome.
- **User objective:** Avoid duplicate lifecycle writes and inspect current authoritative state following interrupted responses.
- **Workflow boundary:** Defined Manager lifecycle objective above; not a duplicate of AUTH-003/005/008 session internals, STAFF-CUST User/Customer creation, STAFF-ACC Teller account opening or reserved full Admin role management Part 11.
- **Complete workflow steps:** ManagerTellerDirectory writeInFlight ref and writePending disable double submit while request pending. On network, timeout, retryable transport or unclassified 5xx (including BFF 502/504), it does NOT resend mutation; calls reconcile(attempt) GET /tellers, plus GET /tellers/users for removals. Assignment comparison by User UUID and role TELLER/status ACTIVE; edit compares full profile and ACTIVE; removal requires Employee old email INACTIVE/null User UUID and User role CUSTOMER. Matching state displays previous response interrupted but confirmed by read-only refresh. Unmatched or failed reads preserve unresolved attempt, block new write and offer Check current state; advice to contact authorized Manager. Definitive 401/403/404/409/400/422/429 never automatically retry; 409 refreshes directory. On confirmed 201/200/204 but subsequent reload fails, success acknowledged with warning. No Idempotency-Key, persisted operation record/receipt, compare-and-swap or cross-page recovery; readback may reflect another Manager's change and cannot attribute actor. Reload loses local unresolved state.

### 10.B Queue, case selection and applicant context

| Browser route and method | Core endpoint | Data and authority |
|---|---|---|
| GET /api/admin/kyc?status=UNDER_REVIEW&page=0&size=20 | GET /admin/kyc | PageResponse: page, size, total, content; status enum, PageRequest, KycCaseRepository.findAllByStatus; filtered count |
| Inline select row (no new route) | No GET /admin/kyc/{id} | KycCaseResponse from list; case UUID, status, four upload IDs, decisionReason, createdAt, updatedAt, reviewerId, decidedAt, reviewerNotes |
| GET /api/admin/kyc/{id}/checks | GET /admin/kyc/{id}/checks | List<KycCheck> by case UUID; no case existence lookup in Admin checks method |
| GET /api/kyc/file/{id} | GET /kyc/file/{upload UUID} | KycUpload ownership OR ADMIN; protected bytes and inline MIME/filename |
| POST /api/admin/kyc/{id}/decision | POST /admin/kyc/{id}/decision | decision string and optional reason; current reviewer from auth; response KycCaseResponse |

Default web UNDER_REVIEW, default Core PENDING when no status supplied. All seven statuses are options, not evidence all have actual rows. UI page size 20 fixed, Core default 20, no explicit maximum in controller (positive size/page constraints from PageRequest); recovery size 50. Page zero-based, count from getTotalElements. No all-status aggregate, user/case UUID search, name search, date/check filters, sort order or explicit reset beyond changing status. Status changes clear selection and reset page; pagination can retain selected row; refresh updates selected if it remains on page, else retains old object. Success refreshes current queue and checks but does not navigate to target queue or adjust last page if it shrinks. No URL/storage persistence of filter or selection after remount. Loading, empty status result, retry, 401/403/404 and generic failure distinguished; no separate detail endpoint.

| Field | Authoritative source | Admin availability |
|---|---|---|
| Case UUID, current status, creation/update/decision times, decision reason | KycCase → DTO | Shown in selected panel; queue UUID/status/createdAt |
| Applicant User UUID | KycCase.userId | Stored, omitted from DTO and UI |
| Username/name/email/address/contact | User entity | Not joined/returned; UI explicitly says unavailable |
| Customer UUID, name, DOB, address etc. | Separate Customer entity if created | No join or Customer link; cannot identify onboarded vs not from KYC |
| Consent | KycSubmitRequest.consent gate | Required on submission, no case consent field or UI |
| Upload UUIDs and file metadata | KycCase document refs, KycUpload | Four buttons; metadata not displayed |
| Extracted identity or address | KycCheck.detailsJson / FastAPI diagnostics | Not rendered; not authoritative Customer fields |
| Reviewer UUID and notes | KycCase.reviewedBy/reviewerNotes | API returns reviewerId/reviewerNotes; UI omits both; reason and decidedAt shown |
| Priority, assignment, previous cases | No related Admin contract | Not provided |

### 10.C Protected document inspection

Four buttons: ID front (DOC_FRONT), ID back (DOC_BACK), Selfie, Address proof (ADDRESS_PROOF). Selected ID → kycApi.file → dedicated /api/kyc/file/{UUID} → /kyc/file/{UUID}, lookup upload, current User owner or ADMIN. Admin privilege is global to uploads, not tied to selected case. Storage reads filesystem bytes, content-type and inline original filename returned; BFF no-store, nosniff and sandbox headers. Component only accepts JPEG/PNG/WebP, creates blob URL, no-referrer image, max height 70vh, revokes on close/change/unmount. Loading, absent reference, 401/403/404, unsupported format and generic error displayed. No explicit download button/zoom/side-by-side/file metadata, no public URL. KycUpload stores checksum, size, filename, content type, uploader UUID and storage path. FastAPI aggregate consumes images in memory and may log diagnostics/calibration, no raw image persistence in inspected handler; Core owns stored file. Source: [bank-web/components/banking/AdminKycReview.tsx](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/components/banking/AdminKycReview.tsx); [bank-web/components/banking/AdminKycDocumentPreview.tsx](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/components/banking/AdminKycDocumentPreview.tsx); [bank-web/lib/api/kyc.ts](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/lib/api/kyc.ts); [bank-web/app/api/kyc/[...path]/route.ts](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/app/api/kyc/%5B...path%5D/route.ts); [bank-web/lib/server/banking-upstream.ts](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/lib/server/banking-upstream.ts); [bank-core/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/kyc/interfaces/KycFileController.java](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-core/blob/9f58e595a653db9d8aa59b70a35af8e2b0e725d3/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/kyc/interfaces/KycFileController.java); [bank-core/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/kyc/domain/KycUpload.java](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-core/blob/9f58e595a653db9d8aa59b70a35af8e2b0e725d3/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/features/kyc/domain/KycUpload.java); [bank-core/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/modules/common/support/storage/FileSystemStorageServiceImpl.java](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-core/blob/9f58e595a653db9d8aa59b70a35af8e2b0e725d3/src/main/java/com/bankingsystem/core/modules/common/support/storage/FileSystemStorageServiceImpl.java); [bank-service/app/api/v1/kyc.py](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-service/blob/cabdd323b4aa394910cb192ead6d233e9a12d9d3/app/api/v1/kyc.py).

### 10.D Automated assessment evidence and human responsibility

Core submit invokes orchestrator; scheduler selects PENDING (default fixed delay 10000 ms, up to 50 candidates), processing flag is automation coordination, not Admin ownership. PENDING → AUTO_REVIEW; four file inputs read as base64 (unavailable/empty/>6 MiB yields null), caseId meta and bankUserId → POST FastAPI /api/v1/kyc/aggregate using X-Bank-Core-Auth. FastAPI computes six checks, returns decision/reasons/checks; Core saves KycCheck (type, nullable Double score, Boolean passed, detailsJson with threshold/diagnostics, createdAt). UI labels advisory; no detailed JSON/thresholds/extracted fields or dedicated recommendation display, no rerun.

| Check | Source/meaning | Default threshold (configurable) | Admin display and boundary |
|---|---|---|---|
| FACE_MATCH | Best selfie vs document portrait candidate similarity | 0.85 | Pass/failed, % or null, time; not proven production biometric |
| LIVENESS | Selfie detector score | 0.80 | Same; default simple backend |
| OCR_ID | Front/back OCR extraction quality | 0.80 | Same; extracted fields not shown |
| DOC_CLASS | Document classification score | 0.80 | Same; class/country/diagnostics hidden |
| ADDRESS_MATCH | OCR address match or heuristic token/number/character comparison | 0.75 | Same; may default 0 when no usable address |
| DOC_VALIDITY | NIC extraction presence; 1 or 0, tries rotation if needed | 1.0 | Same; not authoritative external validity verification |
| ERROR | Core creates on exception | N/A | 0%, did not pass; diagnostics hidden, not biometric result |

Missing whole rows absent; empty check list explicitly shown, null score/pass labeled not reported; aggregate can return passed=false even when score null. No separate document quality record beyond check results. Thresholds can be country/doc segmented. Default face/liveness/OCR/classification and portrait backends simple; optional advanced artifacts/execution not established (Part 02). Policy actually tests DOC_CLASS, OCR_ID, FACE_MATCH and LIVENESS; all four pass -> APPROVE; failed and face or live score below 0.40 -> REJECT; otherwise UNDER_REVIEW. ADDRESS_MATCH and DOC_VALIDITY are produced but not inputs to policy decision. Core uses decide for automatic terminal outcomes, zero UUID system reviewer; auto approve reason auto_approved, auto rejection joins reasons; other/empty result marks UNDER_REVIEW and reviewerNotes (not necessarily decisionReason). ML exception stores ERROR and attempts UNDER_REVIEW ml_unavailable; batch failure also attempts UNDER_REVIEW. No Admin review required for terminal auto decisions; no reopen/override once terminal. Admin can decide AUTO_REVIEW or UNDER_REVIEW without completed checks or current files; no ML call for manual action. No direct persisted standalone recommendation/ML request receipt in case DTO; state and notes/checks are available. ### 10.E Manual decision path and state transitions

Three decisions use one endpoint/DTO. UI computes allowed targets from selected status, then confirmation shows exact action/case UUID and optional textarea (maxLength 500; trim, omit blank). Core KycDecisionRequest is simple string fields without Bean Validation annotations; no required reason for any decision, including rejection/RFI. DB decisionReason length 500, reviewerNotes length 1000; API does not explicitly enforce reason length before save. Do not promise a specific DB overflow outcome. Controller gets reviewer User UUID from auth (not submitted), converts enum; service @Transactional checks target and current state, saves status, decisionReason, reviewerNotes, reviewedBy, decidedAt and updatedAt. KycCaseResponse HTTP 200. No evidence/preview/check prerequisite, notification, session revocation, Customer or Account write. User can cancel before POST; confirmation disabled during pending, ref guards duplicates. Success selects returned DTO, clears reason/confirmation, refreshes page/checks.

| Current status | Actual way reached | Admin UI and Core accepted targets | Other enum transitions / limits |
|---|---|---|---|
| PENDING | New submission | NEEDS_MORE_INFO | AUTO_REVIEW or UNDER_REVIEW internal; cannot approve/reject directly |
| AUTO_REVIEW | Orchestrator starts | APPROVED, REJECTED, NEEDS_MORE_INFO | UNDER_REVIEW internal; manual decisions permitted even while automated process running |
| UNDER_REVIEW | Automation recommendation/default/failure; enum allows other internal path | APPROVED, REJECTED, NEEDS_MORE_INFO | No claim/assignment |
| NEEDS_MORE_INFO | Admin requests | REJECTED only | Enum permits UNDER_REVIEW but Admin controller restricts targets; submit controller returns existing active case and scheduler only PENDING |
| APPROVED | Auto or Admin decision | None | Terminal; no reopen |
| REJECTED | Auto or Admin decision | None | Terminal; new application creates separate case, no supersede relation |
| SUPERSEDED | Declared enum/filter; no transition to it found in inspected paths | None | Terminal; do not assume reachable |

RFI: free text optional; no structured requested document, notification, reply or correction history. Customer sees reason via /kyc/me after refresh. Web showDraft permits new case only none or REJECTED/SUPERSEDED; Core submit returns current active PENDING/AUTO_REVIEW/UNDER_REVIEW/NEEDS_MORE_INFO before reaching internal replace logic. No connected return to review, direct approval from NEEDS_MORE_INFO or manual rerun; Admin may reject and customer reapply. Distinct action works; resolution incomplete.

### 10.F Concurrency, confirmation and response reconciliation

No reviewer assignment/claim, priority, reviewer lock or decision row-lock query. KycCase has JPA @Version long; decide current-state read and save occur in a transaction, ordinary competing writes on same version use optimistic locking. Not merely @Transactional. Sequential final states reject subsequent actions; if new state still permits a target (e.g., RFI then reject), sequential second action may be accepted. Request carries neither expected version nor expected status. Automation processing flag not a reviewer lock; no blanket concurrent guarantee beyond code/ORM semantics. No specialized optimistic-lock error mapper found; 409 UI branch does not establish actual conflict HTTP status. No concurrency execution.

| Outcome | Source-supported result and UI |
|---|---|
| Approval, rejection, more-info successful | HTTP 200 KycCaseResponse; selected updated, reason cleared, queue/checks refreshed, target visible; status filter retained |
| Invalid decision reason | Optional reason and UI 500 max; no explicit backend length validation; no specific error code for oversize guaranteed |
| Invalid transition/target | IllegalArgumentException → 400 ERR_VALIDATION; UI 400/422 advises refresh |
| Case absent | decide throws IllegalArgumentException -> 400, not guaranteed 404; Admin checks returns repository list (possibly empty); UI has 404 mapping for actual 404 |
| Expired/revoked session, non-Admin | Cookie missing/invalid current session 401; role forbidden 403; role/session error, guard behavior |
| Concurrent/stale | Enum/current read or @Version conflict; 409 handling exists but Core optimistic conflict code not guaranteed; definitive errors reload current page/checks, may retain stale selection |
| Document unavailable | Not supplied label or preview 404/error/unsupported; decision not gated by preview availability |
| Timeout/network/retryable BFF 502/504 or unexpected response | UI read-only reconciliation scans statuses PENDING, AUTO_REVIEW, UNDER_REVIEW, NEEDS_MORE_INFO, APPROVED, REJECTED, SUPERSEDED, pages size 50, looks up UUID; no automatic resend |
| Decision committed but response lost | Found authoritative current status shown; cannot prove this specific operation committed, another reviewer may have acted; queue/checks refresh |
| Readback fails or case absent from scan | Unconfirmed warning, decision action buttons disabled, refresh retries scan; do not resubmit; verify with another Admin/support |
| Other definitive HTTP errors | 429/5xx/403/etc. mapped to guidance; normal page/check reload, not necessarily global readback |

No decision idempotency key/receipt/status endpoint or durable operation ID; KYC submit idempotency not shared. Confirmation target/case visible; one in-flight POST. Reconciliation local state can vanish across navigation/reload; scan has no snapshot guarantee and can miss case moving between queues. Found status can be same as previous or different; no automatic replay or operation attribution. Stronger PAY durable receipt/key and Part 08 closure single-account readback mechanisms not shared.
