### 10.G Role-permission and customer consequence matrix

| Role | Admin list/select | Shared document and checks access | Admin decision | Reopen/rerun/delete/archive/history |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| CUSTOMER | No Admin UI/API; /kyc/me own latest | Own upload and own case checks; simplified check DTO | No | No Admin operations; new case after rejection, no connected RFI correction |
| TELLER | No | Own upload/case if any, not global (shared endpoints authenticated + owner checks, no special staff privilege) | No | No Admin operations |
| MANAGER | No | Same as TELLER | No | No Admin operations |
| ADMIN | All status queues, selected inline, full check entities | Any upload ID; owner/ADMIN shared checks, Admin checks by case ID | Allowed three targets per state | Historical status queues/current metadata only; no reopen/rerun/delete/archive/history API |
| Internal automation | No Admin workspace or bearer access granted by service secret | Core orchestrator reads storage, FastAPI receives aggregate input | Core orchestrator calls service decide for APPROVE/REJECT with system UUID | PENDING scheduler/internal run; not Admin-triggered rerun |

Current JWT filter validates usable persisted session, current User active/role/name and active linked Employee if present; ADMIN does not require Employee association in KYC controller. Internal FastAPI secret distinct from browser/Core admin authorization. Shared /kyc/me is authenticated principal, not global Admin history endpoint.

| Decision | Customer-visible / downstream result |
|---|---|
| APPROVED | Latest KYC shows approval on read; web CustomerOnboarding displays CustomerRecordForm; PUT /api/v1/customers/me checks latest APPROVED (else 409), overrides body userId; separate Customer row/upsert; self-service account opening requires linked Customer and latest approval; no automatic creation |
| REJECTED | Latest status and optional reason visible; web new verification with new uploads/consent (KYC-007); old case remains; no automatic Customer/account removal or session revocation |
| NEEDS_MORE_INFO | Latest status and optional reason visible; no connected correction/resubmit as explained; no approval eligibility; existing Customer still exists |
| Existing Customer/account | Dashboard if no Customer directs onboarding; existing Customer/no account checks latest KYC; existing accounts displayed, no decision-side freeze/deletion/revocation |

Web status refresh via mount/manual Refresh status, dashboard load; no push, automatic Admin-to-customer email/in-app notification observed. Android own status polling stops APPROVED/REJECTED/NEEDS_MORE_INFO; not admin. Separate User/Customer/Account lifecycle. Existing Customer status or accounts unaffected by KycCaseService.decide.

### 10.H History, document retention, Android and unsupported extensions

KycCase stores current status, createdAt, updatedAt, decidedAt, reviewedBy, decisionReason/reviewerNotes; check rows retained. DTO returns reviewerId and reviewerNotes but UI does not show these; automatic decisions zero UUID; current reason and decision timestamp shown. No immutable decision history, transition log, reviewer timeline, per-applicant case list, reapplication linkage, bulk actions, notes distinct from current reason, priority/risk queue, assignment/escalation, Admin export or reporting. General AuditLog entity exists but KYC service does not write it; report controller literal placeholders unrelated to KYC. Do not equate metadata with audit trail.

Retention KYC-010: @Scheduled cron 0 15 3 * * * (scheduler local timezone not established), terminal APPROVED/REJECTED and updatedAt strictly before now minus 30 days, not SUPERSEDED; attempts delete four file UUIDs, storage deletes filesystem bytes and upload metadata row, ignores disk/delete exceptions; KycCase and KycCheck remain. Retained case IDs point to potentially unavailable upload; 404 if upload row deleted, generic read error if disk bytes unavailable. No expiry marker/UI reason, retention extension, reversible delete or reviewer reopen. No regulatory conclusion or cleanup runtime verified. No automatic expiration/reverification workflow observed.

Android AppNavHost starts HOME and routes customer Verify Identity and KYC Status; KycApi only upload/submit/me/checks, no Admin list, detail, preview, decision, search or recovery. No Admin destination found in complete app tree; no claim Android authentication refuses all ADMIN credentials. Android review deferred Part 14. Backend-only reviewer UUID/notes, userId/version, raw check diagnostics, internal markStatus/run and retention; frontend uses only connected endpoints, no mock applicant info. Declared SUPERSEDED filter and 409 UI branch do not establish backend writer or concurrency-specific status code. No separate feature assigned to absent optional enhancements.

### 10.I Individual feature records

#### ADMIN-KYC-001 Protected Admin workspace and navigation

- **Review part:** 10.
- **User roles:** ADMIN.
- **User objective:** Enter a role-restricted workspace and reach a human-review queue.
- **Workflow boundary:** ADMIN login → /admin landing or role-allowed returnTo → KYC review → inline case selection.
- **Complete workflow steps:** roleHome ADMIN=/admin; landing Review KYC and top-header KYC review link /admin/kyc; AdminLayout wraps ProtectedLayout/AuthGuard; anonymous login returnTo, wrong role /unauthorized, bootstrap error retry; review page renders AdminKycReview.
- **Frontend / Android:** /admin, /admin/kyc; AdminLayout, AuthGuard, AppHeader. No separate sidebar or Android admin destination.
- **Next.js BFF / API integration:** Initial queue GET /api/admin/kyc?status=UNDER_REVIEW&page=0&size=20; kycApi.admin → /api/admin/kyc dedicated BFF → unversioned Core /admin/kyc, query/body preserved, cookie bearer, no-store, bounded request/deadline; POST requires CSRF. Core is authoritative.
- **Spring Boot implementation:** KycReviewController class-level ADMIN method guard plus authenticated Spring filter chain.
- **Database / ledger:** Persisted User and Session authorization; initial queue reads kyc_cases. No ledger writes from this workflow.
- **External dependencies:** No ML request for workspace entry.
- **Authorization:** Authenticated ADMIN; AdminLayout/AuthGuard and Core @PreAuthorize independently enforce access. BFF obtains cookie bearer and requires CSRF for POST; JwtAuthFilter checks persisted usable session and current User authorization, including active linked Employee where present (AUTH-004/008).
- **Success, failure and recovery behavior:** Booting and unavailable session state differ; role rejection redirects; queue has role/session-specific errors and retry. Filter/selection local state resets on remount.
- **Existing automated tests:** Vitest navigation unit asserts role and redirect; mock-Core Playwright verifies landing link, default queue, forbidden non-Admin UI and requests.
- **Available live verification:** None independently attributable to this integrated Admin workflow. No tests or live operations executed in Part 10.
- **Completeness level:** **L4 — Functionally implemented**.
- **Independent status:** None.
- **Evidence confidence:** **Source-confirmed**.
- **Supported behavior:** Connected Admin-only entry, landing card, header navigation and actionable initial queue.
- **Unsupported / incomplete behavior:** No Admin KYC mobile workspace or persistent queue view state; no separate case URL.

#### ADMIN-KYC-003 Status filtering and server-side pagination

- **Review part:** 10.
- **User roles:** ADMIN.
- **User objective:** Navigate a potentially large status-specific queue.
- **Workflow boundary:** Select status and page through server-counted results.
- **Complete workflow steps:** Select status resets page zero, selected case/document/confirmation cleared; browser requests size 20; Next/Previous bounded by ceil(total/size)-1; Core default page 0 size 20 and PageRequest.of with no explicit max; filtered Page.getTotalElements; no explicit ordering.
- **Frontend / Android:** /admin/kyc status select, count and Previous/Next; browser converts total to Number; page change does not necessarily clear selected case.
- **Next.js BFF / API integration:** kycApi.admin → /api/admin/kyc dedicated BFF → unversioned Core /admin/kyc, query/body preserved, cookie bearer, no-store, bounded request/deadline; POST requires CSRF. Core is authoritative. GET list; status,page,size are actual applied parameters, not client-only filtering.
- **Spring Boot implementation:** PageRequest.of(page,size), findAllByStatus; no Sort argument, no dedicated search/date/check filters.
- **Database / ledger:** Status-filtered database query and count; no stable ordering contract. No ledger writes from this workflow.
- **External dependencies:** None.
- **Authorization:** Authenticated ADMIN; AdminLayout/AuthGuard and Core @PreAuthorize independently enforce access. BFF obtains cookie bearer and requires CSRF for POST; JwtAuthFilter checks persisted usable session and current User authorization, including active linked Employee where present (AUTH-004/008).
- **Success, failure and recovery behavior:** Status resets page; list reload after decision keeps current filter/page; no automatic last-page correction if count shrinks. Refresh can retain selected row if absent from current page.
- **Existing automated tests:** Mock-Core Playwright navigates next/previous and status; Vitest checks request values; BFF tests verify query forwarding.
- **Available live verification:** None independently attributable to this integrated Admin workflow. No tests or live operations executed in Part 10.
- **Completeness level:** **L4 — Functionally implemented**.
- **Independent status:** None.
- **Evidence confidence:** **Source-confirmed**.
- **Supported behavior:** Real server pagination with status-scoped totals, all seven filters and fixed UI page size 20.
- **Unsupported / incomplete behavior:** No page-size control, explicit API max, direct case/user lookup, name/date/check filters, sort, all-status search or URL persistence.

#### ADMIN-KYC-005 Protected submitted-document inspection

- **Review part:** 10.
- **User roles:** ADMIN.
- **User objective:** Inspect submitted ID front/back, selfie and address proof without public file URLs.
- **Workflow boundary:** Select case → choose available file → authorized binary request → temporary image preview → close.
- **Complete workflow steps:** docFrontId/docBackId/selfieId/addressId map to four labels. GET /api/kyc/file/{upload UUID} via kycApi.file → Core /kyc/file/{id}; upload lookup, owner or ADMIN, storage read; Content-Type and inline filename; supported JPEG/PNG/WebP temporary object URL, revoke on close/switch/unmount; no raw-document runtime request in review.
- **Frontend / Android:** AdminKycReview and AdminKycDocumentPreview; one image contained within 70vh, no explicit download/zoom/side-by-side or displayed metadata.
- **Next.js BFF / API integration:** Shared file BFF: authenticated GET, no-store, nosniff, CSP sandbox, safe upstream content-disposition and binary response. kycApi returns blob and disposition.
- **Spring Boot implementation:** KycFileController verifies UUID upload and owner OR ROLE_ADMIN (not tied to a selected case); FileSystemStorageServiceImpl reads bytes.
- **Database / ledger:** kyc_uploads tracks original/stored filename, MIME, size, checksum, path, uploader and createdAt; local filesystem raw bytes. Case references upload IDs. No ledger writes from this workflow.
- **External dependencies:** No FastAPI fetch for preview; aggregate consumes images from Core, no raw-image persistence in inspected aggregate handler.
- **Authorization:** Authenticated owner or any ADMIN for shared file endpoint; Admin workspace itself ADMIN only. Non-owner denied; TELLER/MANAGER have no global read privilege.
- **Success, failure and recovery behavior:** Loading, not supplied, 401/403/404, unsupported MIME and generic read errors; close/reopen retries. Cleanup removes upload row → 404; retained metadata with unreadable disk bytes may yield generic failure.
- **Existing automated tests:** Vitest mocks file, checks MIME/access denial and object URL revocation; mock-Core Playwright synthetic image and BFF request; mocked BFF binary headers. No real identity docs.
- **Available live verification:** None independently attributable to this integrated Admin workflow. No tests or live operations executed in Part 10.
- **Completeness level:** **L4 — Functionally implemented**.
- **Independent status:** None.
- **Evidence confidence:** **Source-confirmed**.
- **Supported behavior:** Four protected on-demand image previews, temporary object URLs.
- **Unsupported / incomplete behavior:** No explicit download, zoom, compare, file metadata display, expiry reason or retention extension. Admin permission spans uploads not limited by selected case.

#### ADMIN-KYC-006 Recorded automated verification-check presentation

- **Review part:** 10.
- **User roles:** ADMIN.
- **User objective:** Inspect persisted machine-generated advisory verification evidence.
- **Workflow boundary:** Select case → authenticated checks GET → render type/result/score/time; read-only evidence, no rerun.
- **Complete workflow steps:** Core sends four base64 images, User UUID, caseId meta to service aggregate; FastAPI returns recommendation/reasons and six checks; Core stores check rows with type, nullable score/passed, detailsJson, createdAt; Admin API returns full entities; client parses score, renders percent and labels.
- **Frontend / Android:** AdminKycReview displays raw type, Passed/Did not pass/Not reported, percentage or Not reported and timestamp; explanatory advisory text, no detailed JSON or thresholds shown.
- **Next.js BFF / API integration:** GET /api/admin/kyc/{id}/checks → GET /admin/kyc/{id}/checks → List<KycCheck>; caseId and check UUID included.
- **Spring Boot implementation:** KycAutoReviewOrchestratorImpl and MlKycClient persist each returned check; error record ERROR score=0, passed=false on ML exception; KycReviewController reads checks.findByCaseId.
- **Database / ledger:** kyc_checks type, nullable Double/Boolean, detailsJson (threshold and diagnostics where returned), check UUID, caseId, createdAt. No separate persisted recommendation object; terminal decision/reasons or reviewerNotes reflect automation. No ledger writes from this workflow.
- **External dependencies:** POST FastAPI /api/v1/kyc/aggregate with internal X-Bank-Core-Auth; FACE_MATCH, LIVENESS, OCR_ID, DOC_CLASS, ADDRESS_MATCH, DOC_VALIDITY; simple defaults and optional advanced models (KYC-004/015), no independent model availability evidence.
- **Authorization:** Authenticated ADMIN; AdminLayout/AuthGuard and Core @PreAuthorize independently enforce access. BFF obtains cookie bearer and requires CSRF for POST; JwtAuthFilter checks persisted usable session and current User authorization, including active linked Employee where present (AUTH-004/008).
- **Success, failure and recovery behavior:** Separate loading/empty/error/reload; missing whole row absent, null score/pass labeled; aggregate missing score can still be passed=false; address/validity can be zero and ERROR displayed generically. No claim of production biometric quality.
- **Existing automated tests:** Mock Vitest and Playwright check FACE_MATCH and hide details JSON; Core environment-gated ML contract test calls configured service with fixtures for APPROVE/UNDER_REVIEW/REJECT, not executed.
- **Available live verification:** None independently attributable to this integrated Admin workflow. No tests or live operations executed in Part 10.
- **Completeness level:** **L4 — Functionally implemented**.
- **Independent status:** None.
- **Evidence confidence:** **Source-confirmed**.
- **Supported behavior:** Connected display of persisted check summary and independent reload.
- **Unsupported / incomplete behavior:** No threshold/diagnostics, extracted fields, distinct recommendation panel, quality indicator beyond check scores, missing-input interpretation or rerun. ADDRESS_MATCH/DOC_VALIDITY returned but policy does not use them for approval.

#### ADMIN-KYC-007 Manual case approval

- **Review part:** 10.
- **User roles:** ADMIN; CUSTOMER affected downstream.
- **User objective:** Approve a case eligible for a human decision.
- **Workflow boundary:** AUTO_REVIEW or UNDER_REVIEW → explicit approval confirmation → persisted APPROVED → customer eligibility on read.
- **Complete workflow steps:** Select case; Approve case; optional reason; Confirm decision; POST; authoritative response; reload queue/checks; terminal case no more actions. No forced preview/check completion.
- **Frontend / Android:** AdminKycReview /admin/kyc; action only AUTO_REVIEW/UNDER_REVIEW.
- **Next.js BFF / API integration:** POST /api/admin/kyc/{caseId}/decision → POST /admin/kyc/{id}/decision; KycDecisionRequest {decision, optional reason}; KycCaseResponse JSON on HTTP 200. No KYC decision idempotency key, expected version or operation receipt.
- **Spring Boot implementation:** KycReviewController reads reviewer User UUID from Authentication, parses decision enum; transactional KycCaseServiceImpl.decide permits only APPROVED, REJECTED, NEEDS_MORE_INFO and validates current persisted KycStatus.canTransitionTo before save. Does not require documents or checks at decision time.
- **Database / ledger:** kyc_cases current status, reason, reviewerNotes (same reason), reviewedBy UUID, decidedAt, updatedAt and @Version; no new Customer/Account, ledger, mail or session mutation. No ledger writes from this workflow.
- **External dependencies:** No ML call on manual decision.
- **Authorization:** Authenticated ADMIN; AdminLayout/AuthGuard and Core @PreAuthorize independently enforce access. BFF obtains cookie bearer and requires CSRF for POST; JwtAuthFilter checks persisted usable session and current User authorization, including active linked Employee where present (AUTH-004/008).
- **Success, failure and recovery behavior:** Explicit confirmation with target and case UUID, optional trimmed reason (UI max 500), in-flight ref blocks duplicate clicks; server response updates selected case and refreshes filtered queue/checks; definitive error shows guidance and refreshes current page/checks; interrupted response scans status queues without resend. CUSTOMER latest /kyc/me reads APPROVED, can separately PUT /api/v1/customers/me and, with linked Customer, open account.
- **Existing automated tests:** Mocked component and Playwright exercise confirmation, approval and duplicate prevention; Core enum unit covers pending cannot approve and terminal cannot reopen; no real manual approval run.
- **Available live verification:** None independently attributable to this integrated Admin workflow. No tests or live operations executed in Part 10.
- **Completeness level:** **L4 — Functionally implemented**.
- **Independent status:** None.
- **Evidence confidence:** **Source-confirmed**.
- **Supported behavior:** Connected approval changes case state, stores actor/time/optional reason, enables separate customer eligibility.
- **Unsupported / incomplete behavior:** No mandatory reason or evidence checklist, no automatic Customer creation/account opening/notification; cannot approve NEEDS_MORE_INFO directly or reopen terminal.

#### ADMIN-KYC-009 Additional-information request and resolution

- **Review part:** 10.
- **User roles:** ADMIN; CUSTOMER affected downstream.

Web showDraft only no case or REJECTED/SUPERSEDED start-over; Core submit returns existing active case before service can replace IDs; Admin can reject but cannot move back to UNDER_REVIEW or approve directly.

- **Next.js BFF / API integration:** POST /api/admin/kyc/{caseId}/decision → POST /admin/kyc/{id}/decision; KycDecisionRequest {decision, optional reason}; KycCaseResponse JSON on HTTP 200. No KYC decision idempotency key, expected version or operation receipt. Customer GET /kyc/me and POST /kyc/submit; no Admin return-to-review endpoint.
- **Spring Boot implementation:** KycReviewController reads reviewer User UUID from Authentication, parses decision enum; transactional KycCaseServiceImpl.decide permits only APPROVED, REJECTED, NEEDS_MORE_INFO and validates current persisted KycStatus.canTransitionTo before save. Does not require documents or checks at decision time. Enum permits NEEDS_MORE_INFO → UNDER_REVIEW/REJECTED but decide only accepts three targets; submit controller short-circuits all active statuses, including NEEDS_MORE_INFO. Service has internal replacement path but not reached through normal controller; scheduler selects PENDING only.
- **Database / ledger:** kyc_cases current status, reason, reviewerNotes (same reason), reviewedBy UUID, decidedAt, updatedAt and @Version; no new Customer/Account, ledger, mail or session mutation. No structured request, replacement history or correction event; only current note. No ledger writes from this workflow.
- **External dependencies:** No automatic notification, no reviewer-triggered rerun.
- **Authorization:** Authenticated ADMIN; AdminLayout/AuthGuard and Core @PreAuthorize independently enforce access. BFF obtains cookie bearer and requires CSRF for POST; JwtAuthFilter checks persisted usable session and current User authorization, including active linked Employee where present (AUTH-004/008). Customer latest status and own checks/file read through principal.
- **Success, failure and recovery behavior:** Explicit confirmation with target and case UUID, optional trimmed reason (UI max 500), in-flight ref blocks duplicate clicks; server response updates selected case and refreshes filtered queue/checks; definitive error shows guidance and refreshes current page/checks; interrupted response scans status queues without resend. Customer sees request after refresh; rejection is remaining Admin decision; no complete correction/resolve path.
- **Existing automated tests:** Mock Playwright and Vitest confirm PENDING request, reason, and subsequent rejection; mocked Core duplicate-active tests cover UNDER_REVIEW/AUTO_REVIEW, not proof of correction.

#### ADMIN-KYC-010 Decision authorization transition and concurrency enforcement

- **Review part:** 10.
- **User roles:** ADMIN.
- **User objective:** Ensure only current authorized reviewers can commit permitted state transitions.
- **Workflow boundary:** From a current case, validate target and actor and persist a versioned transition.
- **Complete workflow steps:** UI status-specific actions mirror service; Spring role guard and authenticated principal reviewer UUID; transaction loads current case; restrict targets; enum rejects terminal/invalid; save versioned entity. Optimistic JPA @Version prevents ordinary competing writes to same version both succeeding; later request reads changed state, accepts only if transition still valid.
- **Frontend / Android:** AdminKycReview action matrix, confirmation and error guidance; no claim/assignment, lock UI or expected version in request.
- **Next.js BFF / API integration:** POST /api/admin/kyc/{caseId}/decision → POST /admin/kyc/{id}/decision; KycDecisionRequest {decision, optional reason}; KycCaseResponse JSON on HTTP 200. No KYC decision idempotency key, expected version or operation receipt.
- **Spring Boot implementation:** KycReviewController, KycCaseServiceImpl.decide, KycStatus.canTransitionTo; IllegalArgumentException mapped 400 ERR_VALIDATION. No explicit row lock in decision query; no specialized optimistic-lock handler in inspected GlobalExceptionHandler. Automation processing flag is not reviewer claim.
- **Database / ledger:** kyc_cases @Version long, status and reviewer fields; no decision history table or operation ID in decision path. No ledger writes from this workflow.
- **External dependencies:** Manual decision independent of FastAPI; orchestrator uses same caseService.decide for terminal automated decisions with zero UUID system reviewer.
- **Authorization:** Authenticated ADMIN; AdminLayout/AuthGuard and Core @PreAuthorize independently enforce access. BFF obtains cookie bearer and requires CSRF for POST; JwtAuthFilter checks persisted usable session and current User authorization, including active linked Employee where present (AUTH-004/008).
- **Success, failure and recovery behavior:** Invalid transition rejected; sequential NEEDS_MORE_INFO then REJECTED allowed; APPROVED/REJECTED/SUPERSEDED no outgoing decision. UI handles 409 if returned but exact JPA conflict HTTP code not guaranteed; refresh may leave stale selected row.
- **Existing automated tests:** Enum unit covers selected transitions; mocked browser/component role and stale 400 behavior. No real competing transaction test identified in KYC test tree.

#### ADMIN-KYC-011 Decision confirmation and uncertain-response recovery

- **Review part:** 10.
- **User roles:** ADMIN.
- **User objective:** Determine current authoritative status after a manual decision without blind replay.
- **Workflow boundary:** Confirm action → one POST → read response or reconcile unknown response with GET status queues.
- **Complete workflow steps:** Confirmation presents target label/case ID and optional reason; decisionInFlight ref and pending state prevent duplicate confirmation. Valid response sets selected and clears reason/confirmation, refreshes. Network/timeout/retryable 502/504 or unexpected/malformed response triggers findCurrentCase scanning all seven statuses at size 50 and pages. Found case shows current status, no decision resent; not found/read failure keeps warning and disables action buttons, Refresh queue retries scan.
- **Frontend / Android:** AdminKycReview uses local reconciliationCase/warning, notice, selected, checks reload; no reload persistence or operation receipt.
- **Next.js BFF / API integration:** POST /api/admin/kyc/{caseId}/decision → POST /admin/kyc/{id}/decision; KycDecisionRequest {decision, optional reason}; KycCaseResponse JSON on HTTP 200. No KYC decision idempotency key, expected version or operation receipt. Reconciliation GET /admin/kyc?status=...&page=...&size=50 across queues; no direct single-case GET.
- **Spring Boot implementation:** List read-only and transactional decide; no decision-specific idempotent replay; KycDecisionRequest no version/key. BFF idempotency scoped only to KYC submit. Current state read cannot attribute a specific operation.
- **Database / ledger:** Current case status/reviewer/time only, no durable decision operation ID or idempotency record; KycIdemKey belongs customer submit. No ledger writes from this workflow.
- **External dependencies:** No new ML call.
- **Authorization:** Authenticated ADMIN; AdminLayout/AuthGuard and Core @PreAuthorize independently enforce access. BFF obtains cookie bearer and requires CSRF for POST; JwtAuthFilter checks persisted usable session and current User authorization, including active linked Employee where present (AUTH-004/008).
- **Success, failure and recovery behavior:** Definitive errors (including 400/403/404/409/429/5xx not flagged transport) show mapped messages and reload current page/checks. Interrupted response may reconcile to unchanged or changed state; not confirmation this request committed. If still unconfirmed do not resend; local warning may be lost on reload/navigation.
- **Existing automated tests:** Vitest duplicate click, stale 400 and recovery; mock-Core Playwright committed-but-lost response ensures single attempt and current status, not real Core/MySQL acceptance.
- **Available live verification:** None independently attributable to this integrated Admin workflow. No tests or live operations executed in Part 10.
- **Completeness level:** **L3 — Partially functional**.
- **Independent status:** None.
- **Evidence confidence:** **Source-confirmed**.
- **Supported behavior:** Explicit confirmation and read-only multi-queue reconciliation on recognized uncertain results; no automatic duplicate write.
- **Unsupported / incomplete behavior:** No durable key/operation receipt, no single-case read, no safe same-key replay, no cross-reload recovery; scan not atomic and may miss moving case; found status cannot attribute decision. Weaker than PAY receipt/idempotency path and staff closure readback.
- **Source references:** [bank-web/components/banking/AdminKycReview.tsx](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-web/blob/012fbc6ff2687d126c67c85ce54cfc8d16f79f27/components/banking/AdminKycReview.tsx); #### ADMIN-KYC-012 Historical case review and decision metadata

- **Review part:** 10.
- **User roles:** ADMIN.
- **User objective:** Inspect previously decided cases and available evidence.
- **Workflow boundary:** Choose APPROVED/REJECTED/SUPERSEDED status queue → select case → inspect current decision metadata/checks and any retained document.
- **Complete workflow steps:** GET status-filtered page then checks and on-demand files; decision timestamp/reason shown; reviewerId and reviewerNotes returned but not rendered; automatic terminal decisions zero system reviewer. Cleanup daily 03:15 deletes four upload files and metadata for APPROVED/REJECTED updatedAt older than 30 days; case/check rows remain.
- **Frontend / Android:** AdminKycReview status queues and inline metadata; no case timeline, reviewer identity display, applicant case history, export or retention control.
- **Next.js BFF / API integration:** GET /api/admin/kyc and /{id}/checks; shared GET /api/kyc/file/{id}. No audit/history/export endpoints in reviewed KYC controller tree.
- **Spring Boot implementation:** KycCaseServiceImpl overwrites reason/notes/actor/time on decision; KycRetentionService scheduled purge; FileSystemStorageServiceImpl.delete deletes disk and upload row. General AuditLog entity exists but not written in KYC decide/markStatus; ReportController placeholders not KYC history.
- **Database / ledger:** kyc_cases current state and timestamps, kyc_checks individual recorded rows, upload row removed on purge; no immutable decision sequence or previous/new application linkage. Retention exceptions swallowed; no deletion event or recovery. No ledger writes from this workflow.
- **External dependencies:** No new FastAPI call; optional diagnostic logs are not Admin audit records.
- **Authorization:** Authenticated ADMIN; AdminLayout/AuthGuard and Core @PreAuthorize independently enforce access. BFF obtains cookie bearer and requires CSRF for POST; JwtAuthFilter checks persisted usable session and current User authorization, including active linked Employee where present (AUTH-004/008). Shared file endpoint owner or ADMIN.
- **Success, failure and recovery behavior:** Historical metadata/checks remain accessible, terminal actions absent, deleted upload row yields 404 and generic no-longer-available preview, disk failure generic. Old case UUID remains distinct from new rejection reapplication.
- **Existing automated tests:** Core enum terminal contract and mock browser status browsing; no direct retention or immutable audit test found in KYC test tree; no cleanup executed.
- **Available live verification:** None independently attributable to this integrated Admin workflow. No tests or live operations executed in Part 10.

#### 11.B Directory and details contracts

| Method / actual Core endpoint (same browser /api/v1 path) | Contract / implementation | UI behavior |
|---|---|---|
| GET /api/v1/access-control/users | UserRepository.findAll → UserDirectoryResponse[] | Global User list, local trim/lowercase substring username, email, first/last, role, UUID |
| GET /api/v1/access-control/users/{userName} | findByUsername → UserDirectoryResponse; missing ResourceNotFoundException 404 | Select row, authoritative detail, Refresh user |
| GET /api/v1/access-control/employees | EmployeeService.findEmployeesByRoleName(null) → findAll → EmployeeResponse[] | Global Employee list, local name/email/role/status/User UUID/manager UUID filter |
| GET /api/v1/access-control/employees/managers | findByRoleRoleNameIgnoreCase MANAGER → EmployeeDto(Employee UUID, names) | Manager selector; no status predicate |
| GET /api/v1/access-control/roles | RoleRepository.findAll → Role rows | Target role choices, no role CRUD/permission editing |
| PUT /api/v1/access-control/roles/{userId} | RoleUpdateRequest; 200 text | Confirmed role and Employee mutation |

Four initial reads in Promise.all; loading, empty list/no matches, error and retry/refresh; no server search/paging/sort or organizational scope, no dedicated role/active/verified filter. User details shows name heading, UUID, username, email, role, login active, email verified. DTO also includes first/last, lastLoginAt, createdAt, address/city/state/country/postal and phone numbers; not all shown. No password/token fields, Customer/Employee nested objects or session list; role summary roleId/name/description. Linked Employee derived by User UUID from list, not email; no Customer UUID or KYC relation exposed. Separate /users/all staff Customer lookup and /users/me own profile belong prior reviews; no arbitrary Admin User profile editor.

Employee detail displays name,email,role,status,department,hireDate,manager Employee UUID, linked User UUID or none; open linked User when present. Full EmployeeResponse additionally includes phone,address,gender,DOB (used in draft); no Employee UUID or resignationDate, no branch. Manager selector is exception exposing UUID for MANAGER Employees. Detached Employee remains visible, no direct independent editor. No role/status filters beyond text search. #### 11.C Provisioning, role assignment and privilege boundaries

No Admin new User, invitation, temporary password, forced password reset, direct login email/profile edit or arbitrary activation endpoint. Public register and verification own lifecycle (AUTH). RoleSeeder seeds ADMIN, EMPLOYEE, MANAGER, TELLER, CUSTOMER; BANNED declared enum but not seeded. DefaultUsersInitializer CommandLineRunner after RoleSeeder creates configured default ADMIN/CUSTOMER/TELLER/MANAGER login if username absent; active true, password encoded; no employment record required by initializer, no claim of current deployed defaults, no credential disclosed. Runtime roles come from DB, so BANNED assignment conditional on actual role row. No role creation/deletion or dynamic permission editor. User has single role_id; Employee has single role_id. Existing User can be targeted regardless of existing role/Customer link/activation. Role replacement is not KYC approval or Customer creation.

RoleUpdateRequest @NotNull fields firstName,lastName,email,phone,address,roleName,department,status,gender,dateOfBirth; optional managerId UUID. UI trims, requires nonblank first/last/phone/address, validates email pattern, role from loaded rows, status and gender enum, date YYYY-MM-DD; department optional UI but sends nonnull trimmed string; maxLength on selected controls. Login email readonly and sent as Employee email, not User email update. UI blocks linked Employee email mismatch or matching email linked to another User; Core does not impose equality to login email, uses requested email to write Employee; existing linked-elsewhere check on selected record, unique email constraints. No server Bean Validation email pattern or nonblank constraints in RoleUpdateRequest. Case-insensitive role lookup; User lock PESSIMISTIC_WRITE; transaction covers User/Employee writes and session deletion. No explicit expected prior role/version contract or separate Employee lock. Missing target/role/manager uses custom EntityNotFoundException (not mapped in inspected GlobalExceptionHandler); avoid claiming all are HTTP 404. @Valid 400; ConflictException 409; other persistence/IllegalStateException can be generic.

| Target role / starting condition | Frontend availability | Core effects and acceptance | Session effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| CUSTOMER, linked Employee not INACTIVE | Role row + full valid form | resignEmployee: INACTIVE, resignationDate now; User CUSTOMER, unlink; Employee row/old Employee role retained | All target sessions deleted |
| CUSTOMER, linked INACTIVE Employee | Same UI | resignEmployee throws IllegalStateException already resigned; no successful detachment | No committed change established |
| CUSTOMER, no Employee, previous non-CUSTOMER | Full form | Set User role CUSTOMER only | Revoke if role changed |
| CUSTOMER, already CUSTOMER no Employee | UI blocks same role request | Direct Core accepts unchanged role, no employment mutation | No revoke |
| TELLER / MANAGER / ADMIN / EMPLOYEE | Any existing User, role present, complete draft | Set User and Employee role; create/reuse/update linked Employee; supplied status; manager optional | Revoke if role or Employee status changed |
| BANNED | Only if returned by roles list | Same non-CUSTOMER branch if role exists; User cannot authenticate | Revoke on change |
| Nonexistent role | Not offered | Role lookup fails | No successful mutation |

EMPLOYEE/BANNED web roleHome /unauthorized; BANNED denied authentication; EMPLOYEE may be otherwise eligible but no dedicated workspace. ADMIN UI warns self changes but permits them. No self-demotion/self employment deactivation guard, other-Admin protection, last-eligible-Admin guard or special ADMIN assignment restriction found in service/controller; Admin role is offered if role row exists. No User activation/deletion endpoint, so no distinct self-deactivation/deletion operation. BFF requires session/CSRF, does not implement these business restrictions. Manager/Teller cannot invoke access-control endpoints; MANAGER-only Teller workflow separate. These are feature boundaries, not a security audit.

#### 11.D Employee lifecycle, identity activation and relationships

Non-CUSTOMER role update finds Employee by User UUID, else login email, else new. Reject if selected Employee belongs to another User; set email/name/phone/department/role, manager if provided, hireDate only if absent, status/gender/DOB/address, set both User/Employee references and save. Manager UUID only existence checked by Core (UI lists MANAGER records); blank omits field and preserves existing manager, no clear. All four employment status enum values ACTIVE, INACTIVE, PENDING, RESIGNED directly assignable without state-transition restriction; same-role non-CUSTOMER profile update allowed. No branch field, explicit Employee removal endpoint for ADMIN other than CUSTOMER demotion, direct detached Employee editing or restore by UUID. Non-CUSTOMER status edits do not set/clear resignationDate; reused former Employee may retain old resignation date. Separate Manager Teller service has different restrictions; Part 09 not rescored.

User.isActive distinct from Employee.status and Customer.status. Login active read-only; no Admin activation/deactivation operation, no role mutation toggles it. Auth registration creates inactive and email verification activates (AUTH); bootstrap creates active. User.canAuthenticate checks active, role nonnull/non-BANNED and linked Employee ACTIVE if present. Changing Employee to non-ACTIVE disables employment-based login; ACTIVE restoration can restore eligibility if other conditions met. No automatic re-verification or User contact change. Role/status changes delete all target persisted Sessions within transaction; same-role/status profile edit does not. Current Admin self change revokes own sessions, next protected request 401; fresh login role may no longer allow Admin. Restoring role/status cannot recreate deleted sessions. Customer deletion no session revoke. General physical User and Employee deletion not exposed; direct repository methods and inverse Employee cascade ALL mapping are not public deletion features.

| Identity | UUID/relationship | State / creation | Admin operation / retention |
|---|---|---|---|
| User | users.user_id; single role_id; nullable unique employee_id; nullable customer_id many-to-one (not unique in schema) | login isActive, emailVerified, role; public register/bootstrap | Role replacement only, retain User on Employee/Customer removal; no general User CRUD |
| Employee | employees.employee_id; inverse one-to-one User.employee, inverse cascade ALL; manager_id nullable FK Employee | status ACTIVE/INACTIVE/PENDING/RESIGNED; create/reuse via role or Manager Teller | Profile/status/role, detach via CUSTOMER; retain former row, hireDate/resignationDate |
| Customer | customers.customer_id; nullable unique customers.user_id owns distinct FK; users.customer_id separate nullable FK, service sets both | Customer.status; self KYC-approved upsert or staff creation | Shared staff edits/status API; Admin physical deletion if FK permits; no relink/restore control |
| KYC Case | kyc_cases.id string UUID, user_id binary UUID; reviewed_by UUID stored; no Customer FK in entity | KYC status; submit/auto/Admin decision | Part 10 controls, not changed by role/Customer deletion; historical reviewer User retained |
| Account | accounts.account_id; required customer_id many-to-one FK; branch optional | AccountStatus, balance; opening workflows | Part 08 closure retains Account; any Account blocks Customer deletion; no financial mutation in Part 11 |

User can retain both Employee and Customer links because independent nullable fields; role changes do not remove Customer or Account or KYC state. Do not infer reverse User.customer uniqueness beyond actual mapping/schema. Customer.user unique; User.employee unique; role rows unique role_name and Employee email unique. KYC UUID fields not equivalent to relational Customer identity. State controls: User role authorizes routes/methods; User.isActive and Employee.status control login/session; Employee role mirrors non-CUSTOMER role update; Customer.status separate profile lifecycle; KYC eligibility separate; Account.status governs banking operation rules. #### 11.E Admin Customer management and deletion

ADMIN uses same Staff Customer list/detail/create/edit and accounts directory as TELLER/MANAGER (STAFF-CUST and STAFF-ACC). Staff PUT /customers targets by supplied User UUID, changes profile and Customer.status in backend; UI preserves existing status and User link; no general reassignment/restore or dedicated status editor; STAFF-CUST-009 already covers backend-only status. Admin-specific addition DELETE /api/v1/customers/{Customer UUID}.

Select detail /staff/customers/{customerId}, role ADMIN renders StaffCustomerDeletion only when loaded, valid matching UUID, not editing. Dialog names target and displays full Customer UUID, warns permanent deletion, login retained, KYC retained, any Account/dependency incl CLOSED zero balance blocks. Exact typedId === customer.customerId case-sensitive, no whitespace trim; route and response UUID equivalence checks case-insensitive. Confirm disabled until exact text; cancel before submit, inFlight ref prevents duplicate and cancel while processing. Preflight GET same Customer UUID no-store; response shape/ID checked, compare every field in old/new DTO; changed record refreshes and stops for new confirmation; 404 ERR_NOT_FOUND already absent; other read error stops. No atomic expected snapshot/version in DELETE; preflight is not a server-side lock. DELETE body empty, frontend-only typed UUID confirmation, BFF CSRF and cookie bearer, controller ADMIN guard. CustomerService transactional: findById else ResourceNotFoundException, clear matching User.customer link if present, saveAndFlush User, delete Customer, flush. DataIntegrityViolationException inside delete/flush translated to ConflictException, handler HTTP 409 ERR_CONFLICT, ordinary rollback restores unlink and row. No explicit dependency query or Account balance/status inspection, no cascade to Accounts, User, Employee, KYC, ledger or sessions. Unlink flush is outside conflict catch, other persistence outcomes may be generic. 204 no-content success; router.replace('/staff/customers') directory reload. No restore/soft-delete. Recreating via eligible staff or KYC-approved Customer registration creates separate new Customer, not undo.

| Dependency scenario | Source-supported deletion outcome |
|---|---|
| No Account or other remaining FK dependent | Deletes Customer physically; retains linked User and clears matching pointer |
| ACTIVE/FROZEN/CLOSED Account (zero/nonzero balance) | Restrictive accounts.customer_id FK blocks regardless status/balance; no service predicate; CLOSED zero-balance specifically covered by integration-test source |
| Transaction/ledger history via existing Account | Account remains; no journal/posting deletion; indirect protection by retained Account |
| Cards linked_customer_id, credit_scores, devices, feedbacks, file_storage, loans, notifications, support_tickets | V1 direct restrictive Customer FKs; if referencing target, deletion blocked at DB; combinations not executed |
| Matching User.customer_id | Service clears matching pointer first, retains User and sessions |
| Additional User.customer_id references | Other pointer not explicitly cleared; FK can block |
| Customer.user_id | Outbound FK, deletion of Customer does not delete User; no cascade |
| KYC case/check/identity uploads | User-based, no Customer deletion operation; retained |
| Customer account opening idempotency | V5 refs User and Account, not direct Customer; Accounts retained |

No bypass of referential integrity or financial retention recommended. #### 11.F Permissions and mutation outcomes

| Operation | CUSTOMER | TELLER | MANAGER | ADMIN |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| General Admin User directory/detail | No | No | No | Yes |
| Shared /users/all CUSTOMER lookup | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| New User as Admin / arbitrary User editing | No | No | No | No |
| Own profile / registration | Own / public registration, separate AUTH | Own | Own | Own |
| General role assignment/Employee create/update | No | No | No | Yes |
| General Employee directory/managers | No | No | No | Yes |
| Manager Teller assign/update/remove | No | No | Yes | No |
| User activation/deactivation admin operation | No | No | No | No |
| Customer staff list/create/update | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Customer delete | No | No | No | Yes |
| Physical User/Employee deletion | No | No | No | No |

| Mutation | User | Employee | Customer/KYC/Account | Sessions | History |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Non-CUSTOMER role assignment | role replaced; isActive unchanged | create/reuse/link, role + supplied profile/status | unchanged | revoke on role/status change | Current fields only |
| Same role/profile edit | role unchanged | profile update, existing hire date | unchanged | no revoke if status unchanged | No event history |
| Employment status change | role same or changed, login active unchanged | selected status, no explicit resignationDate change | unchanged | all target sessions revoked on status change | Current status only |
| CUSTOMER demotion with eligible Employee | CUSTOMER, unlink | INACTIVE, resignationDate, retain row/role | unchanged | all target sessions revoked | Former Employee retained |
| CUSTOMER role without Employee | role set | none | unchanged | revoke if changed | Current role only |
| Customer deletion eligible | matching Customer pointer null; User retained | unchanged | Customer removed, KYC/accounts not deleted | unchanged | no deletion receipt/history |
| Customer deletion conflict | rollback ordinary transaction | unchanged | Customer and Account retained | unchanged | no mutation history established |

#### 11.G Confirmation and uncertain-response matrix

| Operation | Confirmation/preflight | Success and readback | Uncertain/error behavior | Durable key / reload |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Role assignment and Employee create/edit/status/demotion | Validate full draft, review exact role and status, reconfirm after edits, inFlight ref; no expected version | PUT 200 text then full directory snapshot + GET username, verify role/Employee fields (CUSTOMER verifies detach and former inactive email); mismatch unresolved | 400/422 field errors, 401/403, 409 refresh; missing role custom exception mapping not established. Timeout/network/retryable/5xx/unexpected or failed post-ack read → GET username and employees only; matched current state, no automatic resend; mismatch/failure blocks edit, Check current user state retries | No durable key/operation ID; local unresolved can vanish on reload; current state not causal proof; self-revocation may block readback |
| User activation/deactivation | Not available | N/A | N/A | N/A |
| Customer deletion | Exact displayed Customer UUID, fresh GET and all field comparison; no server atomic confirmation | 204 then directory navigation | 404 ERR_NOT_FOUND known absent, 409 dependent records, 401/403/CSRF and other definitive 4xx; 408/network/timeout/5xx/unexpected response → GET same Customer UUID. Only authoritative 404 ERR_NOT_FOUND establishes absence; present may still finish, read failure unknown, no automatic resend and outcome blocks repeat | No durable key/receipt; no proof which request caused absence; local outcome lost on reload |
| Customer status edit | Shared Staff API only (Part 07) | UI preserves status | Prior STAFF-CUST-009 boundary | Not rescored |

Both read-only reconciliations weaker than PAY durable receipt and same-key retry; Customer deletion has specific record GET vs KYC status-queue scan. Role editor no distinct mutation idempotency or version expectation. Exact UUID confirmation is not backend-required. Current readback is not an immutable receipt.

#### 11.H Audit, Android, unavailable capabilities

Role/service does not accept actor UUID/reason or store previous/new role event. User createdAt/lastLoginAt, Employee hireDate/resignationDate, Customer created/updated and current states not immutable audit. EmployeeService resignation log records target User ID, not actor operation history; AuditLog entity exists but no write in traced Admin role/deletion path, no Admin history API/export or confirmation record. Session delete not durable event. Historical KYC reviewedBy remains User UUID because User retained, no change to old case. Broader audit Part 15.

Android AppNavHost customer HOME/profile/accounts/KYC/payments/wallet, AuthApi registration/login/validate/logout/forgot only; complete tree no Admin directory, Employee/role operations, activation or Customer deletion. No claim Android refuses all Admin credentials. Bank-service has no Admin identity-management route in inspected tree; not part of mutation chain. No general User or Employee delete controller; bootstrap and email verification are not Admin provisioning/activation. Backend-only User timestamps/contact data, Employee fields/resignationDate, Role permissions, Customer status (prior STAFF-CUST-009); manager clearing, role definition CRUD, last-admin guard, unified User/Customer/KYC detail, standalone Employee provisioning, explicit audit/restore not implemented. No standalone L0 records manufactured.

#### ADMIN-ID-001 — Protected Admin identity workspace

- **Review part:** 11.
- **User roles:** ADMIN; affected target User/Employee or Customer where applicable.
- **User objective:** Reach general identity administration as ADMIN.

#### ADMIN-ID-005 — General role assignment and replacement

- **Review part:** 11.
- **User roles:** ADMIN; affected target User/Employee or Customer where applicable.
- **User objective:** Change existing login's single role using available role rows.
- **Workflow boundary:** Select User → role and Employee editor → review → confirm PUT → read authoritative role.

- **Frontend / Android:** AdminAccessManagement; no dedicated role create/delete or multi-role editor. Self changes warned not blocked.
- **Next.js BFF / API integration:** PUT /api/v1/access-control/roles/{User UUID}; RoleUpdateRequest {firstName,lastName,email,phone,address,roleName,department,managerId?,status,gender,dateOfBirth}; HTTP 200 text. Same-origin /api/v1 generic BFF (cookie bearer, unsafe-method CSRF, status/error forwarding, no-store upstream); Core method authorization is authoritative.
- **Spring Boot implementation:** AccessControlController @Valid → transactional AccessControlServiceImpl.updateUserRole; UserRepository.findByIdForUpdate pessimistic write lock; role looked up case-insensitively, existing User required. CUSTOMER branch with linked Employee delegates resignEmployee; other non-CUSTOMER targets create/reuse/update Employee. RoleSeeder seeds ADMIN, EMPLOYEE, MANAGER, TELLER, CUSTOMER; BANNED enum not seeded by this code but available if DB role exists. No actor-target/self/last-Admin restriction in service.
- **Database / ledger:** users.role_id and employees.role_id synchronized for non-CUSTOMER; Customer link and KYC untouched; User role or linked Employee status change revokes all target sessions by DELETE query (same transaction); normal profile-only change with unchanged role/status does not. No User.isActive or email verification change.
- **External dependencies:** No ML/mail.
- **Authorization:** Authenticated ADMIN via protected /admin layout and method-level hasRole('ADMIN'); current role and persisted usable session verified by JwtAuthFilter. No requirement for linked Employee if absent; if linked it must be ACTIVE. Any existing User can be targeted; no role-specific prior-role requirement; inactive User remains inactive; server requires existing target role.
- **Success, failure and recovery behavior:** Review and confirm, in-flight ref, full refresh and selected User GET after 200; uncertain transport/5xx/parse results read User by username and Employee list, no replay; mismatch/read failure unresolved. Form field errors and 409 refresh; no durable receipt. Custom EntityNotFoundException not mapped by inspected global handler; do not promise 404 for mutation missing target.
- **Existing automated tests:** Mock API/Vitest/browser role change and fields; JwtAuthorizationStateIntegrationTest real Spring/MockMvc source exercises Admin downgrade and promotion.

#### ADMIN-ID-012 — Customer deletion dependency protection

- **Review part:** 11.
- **User roles:** ADMIN; affected target User/Employee or Customer where applicable.
- **User objective:** Preserve related banking and financial records when deletion is attempted.
- **Workflow boundary:** Admin confirms DELETE → database checks FK dependencies on flush → success or rollback/409.

- **Frontend / Android:** StaffCustomerDeletion /staff/customers/{id}.
- **Next.js BFF / API integration:** GET /api/v1/customers/{Customer UUID} then DELETE same path, no body; apiDeleteNoContent expects 204. Same-origin /api/v1 generic BFF (cookie bearer, unsafe-method CSRF, status/error forwarding, no-store upstream); Core method authorization is authoritative.
- **Spring Boot implementation:** CustomerController DELETE @PreAuthorize ADMIN → CustomerServiceImpl transactional deleteCustomer: find Customer, clear matching User.customer link and saveAndFlush User, delete Customer and flush; integrity failure becomes ConflictException HTTP 409 ERR_CONFLICT. No explicit Account/balance/status query; database FK restriction, not service enumeration. Conflict thrown inside transaction rolls back unlink and deletion on ordinary Spring rollback.
- **Database / ledger:** V1 accounts.customer_id NOT NULL FK no cascade, cards, credit_scores, devices, feedbacks, file_storage, loans, notifications, support_tickets and users.customer_id also reference Customer; matching User pointer cleared, other references block. Accounts, journals/ledger not deleted. V5 idempotency references User and Account, not Customer directly.
- **External dependencies:** None.
- **Authorization:** ADMIN only; FK protection independent of actor.
- **Success, failure and recovery behavior:** 409 ERR_CONFLICT for DataIntegrityViolationException at delete/flush; missing Customer 404 ERR_NOT_FOUND; unlink saveAndFlush outside catch, other persistence failure may be generic. No promise of specific runtime outcome for untested dependency combinations.

#### ADMIN-ID-013 — Customer deletion uncertain-response recovery

- **Review part:** 11.
- **User roles:** ADMIN; affected target User/Employee or Customer where applicable.
- **User objective:** Determine whether target Customer still exists after interruption without resending DELETE.
- **Workflow boundary:** Preflight GET and exact confirmation → one DELETE → if response uncertain, GET same Customer UUID → absent/present/unknown.
- **Complete workflow steps:** StaffCustomerDeletion validates readback ID and shape, recognizes only 404 ERR_NOT_FOUND as absence; post-failure no automatic DELETE; pending/outcome blocks repeat.
- **Frontend / Android:** Inline dialog and local outcome; absent navigates directory, present warns original may still finish; no durable reload recovery.
- **Next.js BFF / API integration:** GET /api/v1/customers/{Customer UUID} then DELETE same path, no body; apiDeleteNoContent expects 204. Same-origin /api/v1 generic BFF (cookie bearer, unsafe-method CSRF, status/error forwarding, no-store upstream); Core method authorization is authoritative. Reconciliation read GET no-store; apiDeleteNoContent requires 204, unexpected response treated as uncertain.
- **Spring Boot implementation:** CustomerService delete not idempotent by operation key; second absent target yields 404; no operation receipt, no server expected snapshot/version.
- **Database / ledger:** Customer present/absent read only; no causal operation history.
- **External dependencies:** None.
- **Authorization:** ADMIN for delete; staff-authenticated GET; 401/403 distinct.
- **Success, failure and recovery behavior:** Definitive 4xx except 408 shows rejection; 409 dependent records; 401/403/CSRF; network/timeout/5xx/unexpected response reconciles; 404 ERR_NOT_FOUND confirms absence not attribution; present/failed leaves uncertainty and disables repeat in component; reload may lose state.
- **Existing automated tests:** Mock Core browser changed preflight, already absent, lost committed response, present readback 504 and no retry; no real-stack run.
- **Available live verification:** None attributable to the actual integrated browser/Core/MySQL stack in this review. Existing test code inspected, not executed.
- **Completeness level:** **L3 — Partially functional**.
- **Independent status:** None.
- **Evidence confidence:** **Source-confirmed**.
- **Supported behavior:** Safe preflight, single in-flight DELETE and read-only outcome reconciliation.
- **Unsupported / incomplete behavior:** No durable operation ID/key, no proof of causal request, TOCTOU window between GET and DELETE, no persistent unresolved state or restoration.

Disconnected web reversal helper → generic BFF → TransactionController ADMIN POST → ReversalWorkflowImpl → BoundedFinancialTransactionRetryExecutor / REQUIRES_NEW attempt → PostingEngineImpl → journal/postings/Account balance/projection. Internal reconciliation bean → AccountRepository/LedgerAccountRepository/JournalPostingRepository, no controller/scheduler/client. No external settlement implied.

#### 12.B Financial administration contract matrix

| Capability | Service | Core HTTP (versioned) | BFF | Client | Reachable web UI | Android / boundary |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Global transactions | No real list | GET /api/v1/transactions ADMIN/TELLER returns 200 literal All transactions | Generic | No operational list client | None | None; TXN-016 L1 |
| Own transactions | No real list | GET /api/v1/transactions/my CUSTOMER returns 200 literal User's transactions | Generic | No operational list client | None | None; TXN-016 |
| Individual transaction | Owner predicate; no detail query delegation | GET /api/v1/transactions/{id} ADMIN/TELLER or persisted transaction owner; 200 literal Transaction details | Generic | No detail client | None | None; TXN-016 |
| Account history | Query by Account UUID, descending createdAt | GET /api/v1/accounts/{id}/transactions staff or owner | Generic | accountsApi.history and transactionsApi.history | Customer/staff history & CSV | Native customer history; TXN-012/013, staff review preserved |
| Journal listing/search | Internal JPA and reference/entry relations only | No mapped journal GET | No Core contract to forward | None | None | None |
| Journal detail/postings/eligibility | Internal entity/repo, reversal validation | No read/preview contract | No Core contract | None | None | None |
| Reversal | Actual engine TXN-015 L2 | POST /api/v1/transactions/{journalEntryId}/reversal ADMIN | Generic authenticated CSRF forwarding | transactionsApi.reverse exists | No caller | None |
| Reversal receipt retrieval | Natural replay reconstructed from immutable reversal and projected balances | Same POST only, no GET | Generic POST | reverse helper only | None | None |
| Customer transfer receipt | Durable key/actor-scoped transfer receipt | GET /api/v1/transactions/transfer/receipt CUSTOMER, Idempotency-Key | Generic | transferReceipt | Customer Pay | Not Admin lookup; PAY-009 |
| Customer deposit/withdraw/transfer | Actual posting and key infrastructure | POST /api/v1/transactions/deposit, /withdraw, /transfer CUSTOMER | Generic | implemented | customer workflows | Part 14 later; not Admin cash desk |
| Teller opening funding | Actual posting on funded creation | POST /api/v1/accounts/{id} TELLER | Generic | staff account client | Teller opening | No Admin/Teller general correction |
| Reconciliation | reconcileAll/reconcileAccount | No mapped HTTP | None | None | None | Internal bean, TXN-014 L2 |
| Balance repair | No operational service established | None | None | None | None | V3 migration not a repair API |
| General ledger reporting / adjustment | No operational report/adjustment established | None | None | None | None | Account balances/history only |

Generic placeholder detail uses String id; authorization ownership query can succeed but response is only text. MANAGER not granted generic list/detail merely for role; staff Account history explicitly includes MANAGER. Do not score generic placeholders again. Internal repository access is not an operational Admin endpoint. No server journal search/paging/sort/actor/date/type/reversal filters, Account/Customer journal list, global transaction export, system vault inspection, liability total/trial balance, branch financial reports or manual adjustment contract identified. General reporting, cash desk, provider settlement not inferred from schema. #### 12.C Identifier and journal discovery matrix

| Identity | Storage / relation | Supported interfaces | Accepted for reversal? |
|---|---|---|---|
| User UUID | users.user_id; journal initiated_by_user_id FK | Actor from authenticated principal; directory reviewed Part 11 | No |
| Customer UUID | customers.customer_id, Account owner FK | Staff Customer/Account context | No |
| Account UUID | accounts.account_id; unique ledger customer_account_id mapping | Account detail/history, history DTO/CSV, payment receipts | No |
| Account number | accounts.account_number human-readable | Account heading/details; reconciliation discrepancy | No |
| Ledger Account UUID | ledger_accounts.ledger_account_id; unique customer_account_id or system_code | Internal repositories/postings only | No |
| Transaction UUID | transactions.transaction_id distinct row id; nullable journal_entry_id (V4); unique journal+Account | History DTO, CSV; not rendered as table column; generic detail placeholder | No |
| Journal Entry UUID | journal_entries.entry_id; immutable | Deposit/withdraw receipts and customer transfer receipt; reversal response; not Account history/CSV; no Admin list/read | YES, original journal only |
| Journal reference | unique entry_reference TX-… | Financial receipts; original reference included in reversal description, not a UUID | No |
| Posting UUID | journal_postings.posting_id; entry_id, ledger_account_id, unique sequence per entry | Internal ordered posting repository; no HTTP | No |
| Reversal link | journal_entries.reversal_of_entry_id unique FK to original | ReversalResponse.reversalOfEntryId; not projected history DTO | Original entry_id is natural reversal target |
| Operation type | JournalEntryType; core idempotency operation type limited to deposit/withdraw/transfer | Receipts; history uses separate legacy types | No |
| Client idempotency key | core_transaction_idempotency user/op/key, request fingerprint/result | Customer POSTs, transfer receipt GET | Not used by reversal |
| Reversal receipt | reconstructed from reversal entry and its projections, no separate receipt ID/key | POST original journal UUID + reason, replayed flag | Original UUID |

Account history maps transactionId, accountId, type, amount, balanceAfter, description, createdAt. It does not map journalEntryId despite stored relation. Web HistoryView verifies Account and row account IDs, table shows type, money, balance after, description, createdAt; CSV additionally exports transactionId/accountId. Two distinct history rows share one journal for transfer. No journal link, no ability to convert reference to UUID through HTTP. Original DEPOSIT/WITHDRAWAL/TRANSFER receipts contain journalEntryId/journalReference and customer balance context; customer transfer GET requires CUSTOMER original actor and key, no Admin search. A payer-supplied original receipt can contain an identifier but cannot replace authoritative Admin discovery/inspection; not a connected handoff. No direct database access used.

Internally JournalEntry stores ID, reference, type/status, totalAmount, currency, description, original link, actor type/User/system actor, channel, postedAt. JournalPosting stores posting ID, entry ID, ledger ID, sequence, direction, amount/currency/time. Repository findByIdForUpdate/findByEntryReference/findByReversalOfEntryId; postings by entry ordered sequence and ledger ordered time; internal query not HTTP. No original/current posting detail, actor, amount/currency/status/eligibility, original/reversal relationship or receipt retrieval from an authorized Admin read. #### 12.D Exact reversal HTTP and execution sequence (TXN-015 detailed, not rescored)

POST /api/v1/transactions/{journalEntryId}/reversal; UUID path; authenticated ADMIN only via @PreAuthorize. AuthenticatedUserIdProvider resolves trusted actor; no actor field supplied by caller. Required JSON body {reason:string} @NotBlank. ReversalCommand requires USER actor UUID, channel WEB, nonblank reason, trims outer whitespace, rejects ISO controls in normalized string; new description 'Reversal of {original.entryReference}: {reason}' must fit 255 characters (dynamic reason limit). No explicit amount/currency/account/partial amount/metadata or key required. No custom admin role check inside trusted internal service; HTTP controller is role gate. No customer ownership restriction on Admin correction. Reversal reason not independent structured column; stored in immutable description and projected descriptions. An invalid/blank reason fails even on retry; final description-length check occurs only new posting branch, not valid existing replay.

1. TransactionController resolves principal, validates path/body; calls reversals.reverse(actor, originalId, reason).
2. ReversalWorkflowImpl uses retryExecutor.execute("REVERSAL", () -> postReversal(new ReversalCommand(...))). FinancialTransactionAttempt REQUIRES_NEW; PostingEngineImpl @Transactional joins that attempt. Three attempts max (25/50ms backoff) only MySQL 1213 or SQLSTATE 40001, excludes 1205 even if 40001; all work re-executed after rollback; exhaustion 503 ERR_TRANSACTION_TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE.
3. Lock original JournalEntry PESSIMISTIC_WRITE; if missing ERR_REVERSAL_ORIGINAL_NOT_FOUND 404. Validate POSTED, not reversal, only DEPOSIT/WITHDRAWAL/TRANSFER, positive total. Natural lookup by reversal_of_entry_id under lock; if existing validate durable state and return replay, no new accounting mutation.
4. New path loads ordered original postings, checks exact sequence/no gaps, positive four-decimal-compatible amounts, matching currency, balanced totals equal original amount, exactly two valid original legs, original ledger identity and status. Deposit vault ASSET debit/customer LIABILITY credit; withdrawal opposite; transfer distinct two customer liabilities. Only active LedgerAccount, matching currency, original vault code SYSTEM_VAULT_CASH:LKR for system leg. No substitute mapping.
5. Reverse every original direction, preserve ledger IDs/amount/currency, build description; shared executePosting validates balanced positive instructions and DECIMAL(19,4) max, loads mappings, sorts affected banking Account UUIDs natural order, pessimistic row locks + entityManager.refresh, requires ACTIVE and matching currency.
6. Aggregate customer liability deltas (credit positive, debit negative) from inverse legs; add to materialized balance, set four decimals without rounding, reject negative (ERR_INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS); save each affected Account and updatedAt. Does not call full reconciliation or require ledger-derived balance equality before reversal; stored balance is overdraft predicate.
7. New UUID, collision-checked TX- reference, UTC microsecond timestamp; immutable POSTED REVERSAL header with original link, same total/currency, current admin USER actor and WEB channel, description. Persist new ordered inverse JournalPosting rows (new IDs), original unmodified.
8. MANDATORY legacy projection in same transaction: reversal of deposit → WITHDRAWAL, withdrawal → DEPOSIT, transfer → inverse TRANSFER_OUT/IN. Projection rows store new reversal entry ID, actual balanceAfter, description/time. Flush; commit at outer transaction boundary. If any later posting/projection/flush or balance check fails, whole attempt rolls back; no committed partial credit. No external payment or provider operation.
9. ReversalWorkflow returns immutable ReversalReceipt and controller HTTP 200 ReversalResponse, including original and reversal IDs, journalReference, operationType REVERSAL, BigDecimal amount, currency, resultingCustomerBalances map Account UUID→historical balance, postedAt, replayed. No actor, reason, postings, idempotency key or separate receipt ID returned.

#### 12.E Reversal eligibility matrix and Account restrictions

| Scenario | Source-supported new reversal outcome | Constraint |
|---|---|---|
| POSTED deposit | Eligible if exact valid shape, active mappings/Account and resulting nonnegative balance | Engine original shape/overdraft checks |
| POSTED withdrawal | Eligible if valid inverse credit and active Account/ledger/vault | No external vault cash settlement check |
| POSTED internal transfer | Eligible if valid original two distinct customer liabilities and both active; former recipient can fund debit | Two Account locks, atomic |
| Positive customer opening funding | DEPOSIT with Opening deposit description and same shape; type-eligible subject to same rules | AccountServiceImpl uses DEPOSIT, not OPENING_BALANCE; no opening-specific exclusion, no reversal test specific to opening confirmed |
| Positive Teller-assisted opening funding | Same shared DEPOSIT posting type and checks; no actor/channel exclusion | Does not close or delete Account; no explicit opening-specific reversal test |
| Zero-funded Checking | No opening journal exists | No target |
| V3 historical opening balance | Rejected | OPENING_BALANCE excluded, migration-only |
| Reversal of reversal | Rejected | reversal_of_entry_id nonnull / type excluded |
| Already reversed original | Return historical replay if valid | Unique reversal_of_entry_id, original lock; not second reversal |
| Unknown/corrupt original or unsupported operation | Reject | Missing 404, invalid type/state/posting/currency/class 422 |
| Partial / multiple partial | Not supported | No amount input; invert entire exact original |
| FROZEN/CLOSED banking Account | Reject new reversal | ERR_ACCOUNT_NOT_ACTIVE even if credit or zero balance |
| Inactive LedgerAccount or unavailable vault | Reject new reversal | ERR_LEDGER_ACCOUNT_NOT_ACTIVE |
| Spent original deposit / recipient transfer funds | Reject if debit would make balance negative | ERR_INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS; all changes rolled back |
| Historical replay after Account frozen/closed or later activity | Can return previously committed receipt if historical state structurally valid | Replay branch before new-path active Account/ledger checks, requireActive false for original ledger identities |
| External payment / general adjustment | Not established | No supported journal type/correction endpoint for external settlement |

Original customer/User status, KYC, owner role and actor activation not revalidated as target eligibility in reversal engine; current Admin authentication and active financial Account/mapping constraints remain. No balance repair or bypass. System vault ASSET class/identity/currency/status validated; no materialized vault overdraft check or proof of actual cash funds. Reversal can restore debit/credit effect but not undo Account opening or external settlement. Account closure locks same Account row, checks stored AND derived balances zero, retains history and Account; if closure commits first new reversal sees non-ACTIVE; if posting commits first closure checks resulting balances. Source protects shared-row serialization; actual interleavings not executed. #### 12.G Duplicate protection, reversal-specific replay and receipt recovery

Reversal idempotency differs fundamentally from TXN-008/PAY-007. CoreOperationType and V2 core_transaction_idempotency CHECK only DEPOSIT/WITHDRAWAL/TRANSFER; reversal path does not invoke CoreIdempotencyCoordinator, create PROCESSING/COMPLETED key rows or store request fingerprint/JSON result. V2 unique nullable reversal_of_entry_id FK plus original journal row lock gives natural one-reversal-per-original across all Admin actors. Same original with different valid reason, different Admin actor, same/different/no client key returns already committed reversal if structurally valid; no changed-payload conflict for this natural identity. A supplied Idempotency-Key is not consumed by reversal controller; same header against different originals is not a common identity, each independently eligible. First committed actor/reason remain immutable. Distinguish new-write vs historical replay authorization.

Replay checks original header/shape with requireActive false, existing header type/status/link/currency/amount, same count exact inverse sequence/ledger/direction/amount/currency, expected projection count/type/amount/account IDs and stored balanceAfter. Reconstructed receipt uses original reversal postedAt/reference/balanceAfter from projection, not current Account balance. No further posting and no update of old reason/actor. Replay flag true; new false. Invalid existing state ERR_REVERSAL_STATE_INVALID; invalid original ERR_CORRUPT_ORIGINAL as applicable. Historical replay can succeed despite later account activity or current non-active status, because new-post eligibility is not re-applied to committed receipt. No separate GET, no Admin receipt browser/search; customer transfer receipt only CUSTOMER + transfer key, not reversal. No safe assumption repeating POST is read-only: if first request never committed, repeat can perform the first reversal if eligible. No auto resend or manual retry UI. Actor-scoped idempotency of customer commands distinct; natural replay source not rescored because TXN-015 owns it.

| Outcome | Result / source-established mapping |
|---|---|
| First eligible POST | 200, new REVERSAL receipt replayed=false, one new journal/two legs/one or two projected rows |
| Repeated original same or changed valid reason | 200 existing receipt replayed=true, no additional financial rows |
| Different key / no key / same key different original | Header not used; original UUID determines identity |
| Invalid reason/UUID | @NotBlank or IllegalArgumentException 400 ERR_VALIDATION where mapped; path conversion 400 asserted in test; final description too long on new path 422 ERR_REVERSAL_REASON_INVALID |
| Missing original | 404 ERR_REVERSAL_ORIGINAL_NOT_FOUND |
| Not reversible | 422 ERR_REVERSAL_NOT_ALLOWED or ERR_REVERSAL_ORIGINAL_INVALID |
| Insufficient funds | 422 ERR_INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS, rollback |
| Account/ledger inactive | 422 ERR_ACCOUNT_NOT_ACTIVE / ERR_LEDGER_ACCOUNT_NOT_ACTIVE, rollback |
| Mapping or original corruption | 422 ERR_CORRUPT_ORIGINAL / ERR_CORRUPT_LEDGER_MAPPING / ERR_LEDGER_ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND / ERR_CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND / ERR_CURRENCY_MISMATCH as branch; rollback |
| Invalid balance/journal or projection | ERR_UNBALANCED_JOURNAL / ERR_AMOUNT_OVERFLOW / ERR_UNSUPPORTED_PROJECTION 422; rollback |
| Existing malformed reversal | 422 ERR_REVERSAL_STATE_INVALID |
| Unauthorized/forbidden | 401/403 from security; no mutation |
| Concurrent same original | Original lock + unique FK, second sees committed existing or retry; test source expects one new + one replay, not runtime verified |
| Concurrent normal posting/closure | Same Account lock + canonical multi-account order; reloaded state, checks under lock; no claim all interleavings executed |
| Deadlock | Up to 3 fresh transaction attempts; sanitized 503 ERR_TRANSACTION_TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE on exhaustion |
| MySQL 1205 lock wait timeout | Not retried by classifier; no dedicated controlled HTTP mapping established |
| Other persistence failure | No blanket conflict/duplicate mapping established; rollback on runtime failure; not a deterministic recovery receipt |
| Lost response after commit | POST same original with valid reason returns historical receipt, not read-only lookup |
| Failed precommit request | No committed reversal from failed atomic attempt; subsequent deliberate POST can post if eligible |
| Read-only GET receipt | Absent; no UI recovery |

No explicit optimistic version/lock timeout or isolation override established in reversal path; original pessimistic lock plus DB unique constraint and shared Account locking are actual protections. Shared retry TXN-009 not rescored. #### 12.H UI integration and history interpretation

Actual browser client transactionsApi.reverse(journalEntryId,{reason}) uses apiJson via generic versioned BFF; no key. Mock unit test asserts reason body/no key; no connected reversal component or route or dedicated UI state. Web TS ReversalResponse has operation? and affectedAccountBalances? array, amount string; Core uses operationType, resultingCustomerBalances Map<UUID,BigDecimal> and BigDecimal JSON numeric fields; mismatch is an integration contract boundary, not a demonstrated runtime failure (no consumer). No journal selection/detail, eligibility/compensating-effect preview, reason control, confirmation, duplicate-click guard, receipt rendering, recovery, history refresh or reversal list. README and architecture confirm deferred/blocked by authorized journal lookup/readback. Core endpoint is NOT missing from BFF; actual blocker is read-side contract and operator integration.

Customer and staff history: new inverse movement uses existing types not REVERSAL, positive amount and movement direction via type; description begins Reversal of original reference, includes reason. Web shows description and amount/balance/time and CSV includes it. Android history consumes same DTO, normal type badges/description; no dedicated reversal relation. Original rows and receipts remain original historical balanceAfter. No original marked reversed, no direct link to new reversal ID, no authoritative reversal history or receipt retrieval. Existing correction description is visible context, not full auditability. One original transfer and one reversal each produce two account projections. No rescoring basic history or projection.
