#### 12.I Reconciliation service, reachability and repair boundary (TXN-014 detailed, not rescored)

LedgerReconciliationServiceImpl @Service, reconcileAll() @Transactional(readOnly=true) AccountRepository.findAll (all statuses, no pagination/filter); per-account reconcileAccount(UUID) findById or IllegalArgumentException. For each Account: stored balance scale 4 UNNECESSARY; find ledger account by customerAccountId. Missing mapping emits discrepancy with derived zero, difference stored, warning; even zero stored flagged. Otherwise sum all journal_postings by ledger ID CREDIT positive/DEBIT negative with COALESCE zero; compare BigDecimal exactly, no tolerance. Difference = materialized − derived. Result immutable-style structured report totalAccountsChecked, reconciledAccountsCount, discrepancyCount, discrepancies list with accountId/accountNumber/materializedBalance/derivedBalance/difference, isClean. No aggregate money totals, per-journal reconciliation, provider settlement, independent expected posting count, trial balance or missing-posting detection beyond balance drift; no explicit class/currency/status/shape validation of mapped ledger in this service. Mapping uniqueness DB; missing postings producing equal balance cannot be inferred, no comprehensive journal integrity audit. No locks beyond read-only transaction, no claim of concurrent consistent operational snapshot. Warning logs only; no result persistence, timestamp/run ID, repair, alert or dashboard. Full account list and per-account queries not paginated.

| Capability | Actual reachability |
|---|---|
| All/per Account drift detection | Internal Spring service |
| Structured discrepancies and counts | Returned to internal caller |
| Missing mapping detection | Yes, explicit discrepancy even zero stored |
| Independent missing/corrupt posting diagnosis | Not established beyond derived-balance difference |
| HTTP/BFF/CLI initiation | No mapped operational entry found |
| Scheduled reconciliation/startup | No call found; search reconcileAll/reconcileAccount only implementation/interface/tests; @Scheduled matches KYC only |
| Admin read-only report / manual review | No page/client |
| Persisted runs / alert | None |
| Balance overwrite/rebuild/repair | None; service read-only |
| Controlled reversal of a posted operation | Separate ADMIN write endpoint, not generic reconciliation repair |
| Legacy opening balance migration | V3 one-time cutover, creates OPENING_BALANCE journals, system opening asset; not repair service |
| External settlement reconciliation | Not implemented by this service; Part 13 scope |

Only observed consumers outside implementation are test sources; no operational caller or scheduled/CLI/controller found in trees/search. No database records inspected. Reconciliation detects stored-vs-ledger drift; does not reconcile external payment nor imply correcting discrepancy by reversing arbitrary journal. Do not suggest editing balances or deleting financial history. #### 12.K Desired correction journey versus implementation

| Stage | Current status |
|---|---|
| Discover original financial movement | Partial via existing Account history |
| Identify original authoritative journal UUID | Missing from history/CSV; payer receipt not Admin search |
| Inspect journal and postings / original actor | Internal data exists; no authorized read contract |
| Establish eligibility/current balance context | Engine validates on POST only; no preview |
| Enter reason and prepare correction | Request DTO and web helper, no operator form |
| Review/confirm | Absent |
| Post full reversal | Backend functional + disconnected web API client, existing TXN-015 |
| Receive receipt | Core 200 structured response; no operator UI, TS mismatch |
| Recover uncertain result | Natural POST replay existing, not read-only, no operator recovery |
| Inspect updated history | Ordinary inverse movement/description, no authoritative link or reversed marker |
| Retain audit evidence | Immutable journal actor/reason/reference/postings, no dedicated Admin audit/history read |
| Initiate reconciliation/report/repair | Internal read-only discrepancy service; no operational entry/repair |

Critical path: authorized journal lookup + detail/readback before safe operator workflow; not a request to bypass eligibility or manually alter ledger. No new score for shared ledger, backend reversal, idempotency, retry, projection, history, reconciliation or generic stub. Two new records scope only partial administrative investigation context and disconnected administrative preparation/client integration.

#### 12.L Individual feature records

#### ADMIN-FIN-001 — Administrative financial investigation and correction-history context

- **Review part:** 12.
- **User roles:** ADMIN (staff history also TELLER/MANAGER, own history CUSTOMER; correction mutation ADMIN only).
- **User objective:** Investigate an original or compensating financial movement before considering correction, without database access.
- **Workflow boundary:** ADMIN opens staff Account history, reads original and correction movement context and optionally exports it; stops before authoritative journal UUID discovery, posting inspection and reversal eligibility. Scores only the administrative investigation/handoff and correction interpretation, not the existing basic Account history TXN-012/013, STAFF-ACC or projection TXN-011.
- **Complete workflow steps:** Sign in as ADMIN → header Accounts or Staff workspace → select Account → /staff/accounts/{accountId}/transactions → HistoryView concurrently fetches Account and history, checks matching IDs → TransactionTable displays type, amount, balanceAfter, description, timestamp; CSV exports transactionId/accountId/type/amount/balanceAfter/description/createdAt. Reversal adds opposite legacy movement with description 'Reversal of {original reference}: {reason}', not a REVERSAL transaction type. No link from row/reference to original or reversal journal. Customer Pay receipts provide journal UUID to the payer, not Admin lookup.
- **Frontend / Android:** Existing protected staff and customer history pages, shared HistoryView/TransactionTable; Android customer history uses ordinary movement type and description. No Admin journal search/detail route, cross-account matching, eligibility, original-reversal link, actor or postings inspection.
- **Next.js BFF / API integration:** GET /api/v1/accounts/{id} and /{id}/transactions via accountsApi and authenticated generic BFF. Core returns TransactionResponseDTO direct array, no journalEntryId, journalReference, reversalOfEntryId or actor; CSV is same data. GET /api/v1/transactions/{id} returns literal placeholder, not a journal lookup. No global journal HTTP contract or Admin transfer receipt GET.
- **Spring Boot implementation:** AccountController staff or owner authorization → TransactionQueryServiceImpl verifies Account exists → findByAccountAccountIdOrderByCreatedAtDesc → DTO mapping intentionally excludes persisted journal_entry_id; JournalEntryRepository/findByEntryReference and JournalPostingRepository queries are internal; projection inverts types on reversal.
- **Database / ledger:** Account UUID distinct from transaction UUID, ledger_account_id, journal entry_id and posting_id. V4 nullable journal_entry_id links projection, unique (journal,account), two rows per transfer. V2 immutable REVERSAL links original; no original record edit. Reversal description contains original reference (not UUID); existing original rows retain historical balanceAfter. No read-side DB mutation.
- **External dependencies:** None; internal ledger only.
- **Authorization:** Staff Account reads ADMIN/TELLER/MANAGER or persisted owner; ADMIN financial investigation uses staff route, not customer receipt endpoint. Generic BFF session cookie and Core current-role authorization.
- **Success, failure and recovery behavior:** History loading/empty/error/reload, CSV when successful. A later refresh can show additional compensating movement and current Account balance; it cannot establish authoritative journal eligibility or definitive receipt causality. No connected correction action or cross-journal readback. Original receipt unchanged.
- **Existing automated tests:** LegacyTransactionProjectionIntegrationTest source verifies journal links and both transfer rows; ReversalWorkflowIntegrationTest and ReversalApiIntegrationTest source check opposite projection, original immutable history and stable balances; TransactionContractTest serializes direct array; no connected Admin journal-discovery or reversal-aware UI acceptance.
- **Available live verification:** None attributable to actual integrated Admin browser/Core/MySQL execution during Part 12; source/tests inspected without execution.
- **Completeness level:** **L3 — Partially functional**.
- **Independent status:** Blocked by dependency (authoritative journal discovery/detail).
- **Evidence confidence:** **Source-confirmed**.
- **Supported behavior:** Inspect existing Account movements and correction description, including historical original reference if a reversal exists, and export existing Account history.
- **Unsupported / incomplete behavior:** No authoritative journal UUID from history/CSV, journal search/detail, posted legs, reversal relationship, eligibility preview, original marked reversed, or current receipt lookup for Admin. Basic history already scored elsewhere.

#### ADMIN-FIN-002 — Administrative reversal preparation and web request integration

- **Review part:** 12.
- **User roles:** ADMIN (staff history also TELLER/MANAGER, own history CUSTOMER; correction mutation ADMIN only).
- **User objective:** Prepare and deliberately confirm an eligible complete financial correction from an authoritative journal.
- **Workflow boundary:** Operator-facing reversal preparation and browser integration only; existing transactionsApi.reverse and generic BFF can forward a reason-only request, but no reachable Admin caller, lookup, preview, form, confirmation or recovery UX. Core reversal mutation, accounting, natural replay and retry remain TXN-015/005/006/009, not rescored.
- **Complete workflow steps:** Intended start Admin identifies original journal; actual UI cannot obtain/inspect it. Implemented transport helper requires caller-supplied original journal UUID + {reason}; apiJson POST adds CSRF; generic /api/v1 catch-all forwards cookie-derived bearer to Core ADMIN-only endpoint. Core returns ReversalResponse. No reachable component calls helper (default-branch search finds test only). No operation identifier generated by client or user-facing receipt handling.
- **Frontend / Android:** No Admin reversal route/component or navigation placeholder; /admin has only KYC and Users/access cards. README/architecture explicitly document blocker. TypeScript ReversalRequest reason; ReversalResponse declaration uses operation? and affectedAccountBalances? array/string amounts rather than Core operationType and resultingCustomerBalances UUID→BigDecimal map/JSON numbers; no runtime normalization for this helper established. No Android reversal API or screen.
- **Next.js BFF / API integration:** transactionsApi.reverse(journalEntryId, body) POST /api/v1/transactions/{encoded UUID}/reversal; no Idempotency-Key header, no dedicated BFF; generic forwarding permits path, session/CSRF, upstream status/timeout. No authorized journal or reversal GET. Core response operationType,reversalJournalEntryId,journalReference,reversalOfEntryId,amount,currency,resultingCustomerBalances,postedAt,replayed. Client transport test asserts body and no key with mock fetch.
- **Spring Boot implementation:** TransactionController @PreAuthorize ADMIN, @Valid ReversalRequest reason, authenticated principal; ReversalWorkflowImpl invokes transactional posting via bounded retry. For backend semantics see existing TXN-015 and Part 12 analysis. No independent new financial engine scored.
- **Database / ledger:** Underlying existing original/reversal journal and projection retention per TXN-015; no new client operation table or persistent unresolved receipt state; no separate reversal key row. Browser not a financial writer except explicit endpoint invocation.
- **External dependencies:** None; no FastAPI or provider call.
- **Authorization:** ADMIN controller only; generic BFF authenticated cookie/CSRF, not role-specific reversal policy. Original target belongs to journal not caller Account. Internal workflow expects trusted actor, not separate service-level role query.
- **Success, failure and recovery behavior:** No user-facing validation, reason entry, confirm, pending/duplicate-click prevention, replay indicator, post-reversal history refresh or unresolved state. Core POST natural replay exists but may create a reversal if none committed; no GET and no automatic or manual UI retry. Source mock client test not integrated evidence.
- **Existing automated tests:** tests/transactions.test.ts mocks fetch (reason body only and no key); Spring Boot MockMvc ReversalApiIntegrationTest source verifies auth, persistence, replay, errors, concurrent requests; no reversal BFF-specific browser or UI test found.
- **Available live verification:** None attributable to actual integrated Admin browser/Core/MySQL execution during Part 12; source/tests inspected without execution.
- **Completeness level:** **L2 — One-sided implementation**.
- **Independent status:** Blocked by dependency.
- **Evidence confidence:** **Source-confirmed**.
- **Supported behavior:** Typed API client and generic CSRF/authenticated forwarding path for known UUID, reason-only request. Backend endpoint independently implemented.
- **Unsupported / incomplete behavior:** Complete preparation, journal readback, eligibility/compensating-effect preview, confirmation, corrected receipt contract mapping, receipt GET and persistent recovery absent. No operator-facing page; classification L2 one-sided administrative client preparation, despite underlying write backend.

Non-debug → FakeWalletRepository in-memory. Conditional true branch: create local intent or card session → direct Core hosted HTML → browser would submit to PayHere; direct public Core callback would update wallet metadata only. BFF intentionally blocks provider HTML/callback and generic webhook. No payment-to-journal link or provider settlement. FastAPI KYC tree no payment service. No actual provider call.

#### 13.B External financial capability and money-movement matrix

| Operation | Web / Android | Core HTTP and service | Persistence / ledger | External boundary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Internal deposit | Connected web / Android preview | CUSTOMER POST transactions/deposit; own active Account | DR vault ASSET CR customer LIABILITY; journal, balance/history | No proof of external collection |
| Internal withdrawal | Connected web / Android preview | CUSTOMER POST transactions/withdraw | DR customer LIABILITY CR vault ASSET | No payout/disbursement |
| Internal Pay | Connected web / Android transfer preview | CUSTOMER POST transactions/transfer; source/destination internal UUIDs | DR source liability CR destination liability | No external bank/network |
| Funded Account opening | Customer/Teller web; mobile opening covered later | AccountServiceImpl funded DEPOSIT | Customer liability mapping and internal vault posting | No provider receipt/collection |
| PayHere checkout | No web UI; Android debug flow conditional, non-debug fake | Conditional GET checkout/{intentId}, disabled 404 | Reads local intent; form only | Browser provider submission if enabled, not verified |
| QR merchant, reload, bill | No web UI; Android Wallet controls | CUSTOMER POST wallet/payments/qr,reload,bill; disabled 422 | Conditional PROCESSING intent, optional wallet idempotency; no ledger | No merchant routing, telecom/biller fulfilment |
| External Account funding/payout/interbank | Absent; Android destination bank preview only | No operational provider-specific contract | No external journal/settlement relation | Not established |
| Wallet top-up/withdrawal/transfer | Absent as stored-value actions | No wallet balance/domain endpoint | No separate wallet balance or ledger | RELOAD is mobile phone reload, not wallet top-up |
| Saved cards | Android debug API, non-debug fake; no web UI | CUSTOMER list/default/delete, enrollment disabled | wallet_cards metadata only | No provider charge/revocation |
| External refund/chargeback | Absent | No operation found | No linkage to internal reversal | Internal REVERSAL not external refund |
| External settlement reconciliation | Absent | No provider report/query/job | No clearing settlement data | TXN-014 internal drift comparison only |

Internal vault SYSTEM_VAULT_CASH:LKR is an internal ASSET accounting mechanism, not evidence of cash collection/delivery. Deposit/withdraw request Account UUID, amount decimal text and core idempotency key; web selects Account and amount, not funding method/card/provider destination. No external proof or cash-desk confirmation. Opening funding also internal. Internal Pay uses owned source UUID and destination internal UUID, not bank name/beneficiary external routing. Android Transfer destination-bank field is preview (PAY-015). No external beneficiary creation, verification, saved recipient/routing, bank network, payout fee/status/recovery or settlement reference established. No duplicate scoring TXN-001/002/004/005/006/007/008/011/014/015/017, PAY-002/004/006/007/008/009/015, ACC-001/007, ADMIN-FIN. #### 13.C PayHere routes, exact disablement and authorization

All below prefix /api/v1/wallet. Direct Core PayHere controllers are @ConditionalOnProperty(prefix=payhere,name=enabled,havingValue=true); application.yml enabled defaults false via PAYHERE_ENABLED. Security permits payhere/** without customer JWT and disables Core CSRF (stateless bearer API); no controller mapping when false, source integration test asserts 404. Browser-origin BFF independently blocks wallet/payhere and wallet/webhook before forwarding, even if Core flag changed, returns JSON 404 NOT_FOUND and no-store. Ordinary JSON wallet endpoints are not blocked, require session/CSRF for writes in BFF, CUSTOMER at Core.

| Method / suffix | Handler / intended purpose | Current default | Conditional enabled behavior (source only) | Persistence / consumer |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET /payhere/checkout/{intentId} | Gateway hosted order | 404 | 200 HTML auto-submit from intent, unknown ID no explicit mapped branch | Read only; Android browser action |
| POST /payhere/notify | Gateway provider notification | 404 | form-urlencoded checksum, normal text invalid/ok | Metadata update only |
| GET /payhere/return | Gateway return | 404 | HTML meta refresh configured deep link, optional intentId | No state write |
| GET /payhere/cancel | Gateway cancel | 404 | HTML redirect with canceled hint | No state write |
| GET /payhere/preapprove/{sessionId} | Card preapproval | 404 | HTML auto-submit for existing unconsumed session, expired message otherwise | Read only; Android Custom Tabs |
| POST /payhere/notify/preapprove | Card callback | 404 | form-urlencoded checksum; invalid/ignored/unknown-session/already/OK | Card metadata + consumed flag only |
| GET /payhere/cards/return | Card browser return | 404 | HTML deep link sessionId and status/status_code, default 2 | No write |
| GET /payhere/cards/cancel | Card browser cancel | 404 | HTML deep link canceled | No write |
| POST /cards/session | WalletController CUSTOMER | 422 ERR_EXTERNAL_PAYMENTS_DISABLED | Create sessionId + URL; optional returnUrl ignored | Session save only |
| POST /payments/qr | CUSTOMER QR | 422 same code | AmountDto, qrData, merchantRef; local intent | No ledger |
| POST /payments/reload | CUSTOMER mobile reload | 422 same code | AmountDto, msisdn; local intent | No telecom fulfilment |
| POST /payments/bill | CUSTOMER bill | 422 same code | AmountDto, billerId, reference; local intent | No biller fulfilment |
| GET /payments/{intentId} | CUSTOMER owner intent | 200 if found/404 ERR_NOT_FOUND | Same | Read existing state, Android polling |
| GET /cards | CUSTOMER saved cards | 200 | Same | Owner list |
| PATCH /cards/{id}:default | CUSTOMER default | 204 | Same | Local owner metadata |
| DELETE /cards/{id} | CUSTOMER remove | 204 | Same | Local owner metadata |
| POST /webhook | WalletWebhookController legacy | 410 for authenticated validly bound request | Always 410, independent flag | No repo use; unauth blocked by security |

Default guard precedes creation/idempotency/persistence after resolving authenticated user. JSON 422 is not same as absent route 404. Legacy webhook independently retired, no state mutation; missing auth/parameters may fail earlier. BFF provider routes return local 404, not provider response. No provider navigation/SDK/status/checkout web page or dedicated wallet API module identified; generic catch-all is transport only. #### 13.D Provider configuration (names only, no secrets)

| Property / environment | Purpose / actual consumption |
|---|---|
| payhere.enabled / PAYHERE_ENABLED | false default; controls controller registration and service creation guard |
| payhere.merchant-id / PAYHERE_MERCHANT_ID | Merchant ID in hosted form/checksum; no real value retrieved/disclosed for use |
| payhere.merchant-secret / PAYHERE_MERCHANT_SECRET | Request and callback checksum helper; secret values omitted |
| payhere.sandbox / PAYHERE_SANDBOX | true default; selects sandbox vs production hosted checkout/preapprove URL |
| payhere.server-base-url / PAYHERE_SERVER_BASE_URL | Core-origin launch, return/cancel/notify URLs; example local loopback |
| payhere.app-deeplink / PAYHERE_APP_DEEPLINK | Example mybank://wallet/return |
| payhere.app-card-deeplink / PAYHERE_APP_CARD_DEEPLINK | Example mybank://wallet/card/return |
| PAYHERE_API_KEY / PAYHERE_API_SECRET | Legacy example entries, no matching consumed PayHereProperties API credentials or active provider API client |
| Separate API endpoint/access token/timeout/currency config | Not established; fixed URL branches, amount currency from intent, preapprove fixed LKR |

No secret stores, real credentials, configuration edits, external docs/provider traffic. Flag true would enable conditional controllers and permit local intent/session creation; not enough to establish provider integration, ledger, fulfilment or callback correctness. FakePspClient implements mock session URL/client-secret generator but search finds no runtime consumer outside interface/implementation; actual WalletService uses config and local URL. No provider SDK/server-to-server status/settlement client established. #### 13.E Initiation, lifecycle and provider verification

Conditional initiation: Android form → UUID key → real repo → CUSTOMER WalletController → service guard → optional wallet idempotency → createIntent with compact UUID string, actor User ID, PaymentType QR/RELOAD/BILL, PROCESSING, Double amount and currency, generic description and returnUrl (actually local checkout launch URL). DTO accepts destination data but actual createIntent does not populate merchantRef, qrData, msisdn, billerId or reference; no selected card or banking Account ID; no Core @Valid or amount/currency business validation established. Android validates reload/bill positive amount <=1,000,000 and two decimals, phone 9–12 digits, nonblank biller/ref; QR confirmation doesn't enforce same validation. Browser hosted form uses stored intent ID as order_id, amount formatted 2 decimals, items description, currency, configured merchant, request checksum and generated return/cancel/notify URLs, placeholder payer fields. No payment API call from server, local intent not provider order confirmation.

| Declared PaymentStatus | Reachable writer when enabled | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| PENDING | Enum/schema only in real create path; fake initializes PENDING | No ledger |
| PROCESSING | createIntent; notification code 0 | Local metadata/poll |
| SUCCESS | notification code 2 | Local status only, no settlement |
| CANCELED | notification -1 | Local status; browser cancel does not set |
| FAILED | -2, -3 and other codes | Local status |
| Settled/refunded/disputed/authorized/expired | Not declared | No transitions |

Provider POST form uses merchant_id, order_id, payhere_amount, payhere_currency, status_code and md5sig in checksum verification with configured secret. Normal failing checksum returns text invalid; successful checksum then local lookup/order status update; unknown order acknowledged ok. No separate comparison to configured merchant ID or stored expected amount/currency, no payment_id persistence, no distinct notification event ID or callback deduplication, no status transition validation or locking/terminal guard; later valid notification can overwrite previous status, description overwritten by status_message. No real provider status query/background job. Callback is not ledger posting. Return/cancel HTML navigation only, caller-supplied query hints not authoritative. No callback examples, signature generation details for execution, or bypass instructions. #### 13.F Persistence and identifier matrix

| Record | Actual fields/relations |
|---|---|
| wallet_payment_intents | id varchar64 PK, user_id binary16 NOT NULL, type QR/RELOAD/BILL, status five enums, amount_value DOUBLE, amount_currency varchar8, description, merchant_ref, msisdn, qr_data, biller_id, reference, return_url, provider_client_secret, idempotency_key nullable; created_at/updated_at. No User FK in V1, no Account/Customer/Journal FK, no provider payment ID or settlement timestamp. createIntent sets only id/user/type/status/amount/currency/description/returnUrl, ORM timestamps. |
| wallet_card_sessions | id varchar64 PK, user_id binary16, created_at, consumed. No explicit expiration, FK or version. |
| wallet_cards | UUID id PK, user_id, brand, last4, expiry_month/year, customer_token NOT NULL, is_default, created_at. No FK or token/default uniqueness. DTO exposes id/brand/last4/default/time, not token or expiry. |
| wallet_idempotency | idem_key varchar255 PK, request_hash, response_json LONGTEXT, created_at. No pending/completed state or intent FK. |
| Banking Account/ledger | Separate Account UUID, Customer UUID, liability ledger ID, Journal Entry UUID, transaction row and core idempotency. No wallet relation. |

User UUID scopes intents/cards/sessions. Customer UUID and Account UUID not accepted as wallet funding identity. Local intent ID (compact UUID) is merchant order reference in hosted form, session ID similarly for preapproval. Card UUID identifies saved metadata, not bank-issued Card ID. No independent Wallet ID/balance, no stored provider transaction ID, no external receipt identifier, no wallet journal relationship. GET status accepts local intent ID not idempotency key or provider reference. PaymentIntentRepository declares findByIdempotencyKey but actual create doesn't fill field or expose lookup. Card/session repositories ordinary JPA; no callback-specific row lock. Schema V1, ledger V2–V4 independent. #### 13.G Settlement and recovery boundary

No wallet service/controller dependency on PostingEngine, AccountRepository, financial workflow or core idempotency coordinator. No external clearing/provider settlement account, fee/gross-net contract, payment-to-journal relationship, atomic callback+ledger posting, payment journal receipt, merchant delivery or provider reconciliation. Ledger operational types DEPOSIT/WITHDRAWAL/TRANSFER/REVERSAL and migration OPENING_BALANCE; internal vault and opening asset, not provider clearing. SUCCESS is wallet metadata, not evidence Account credited, bill paid or telecom reload delivered. No payout/refund/chargeback/dispute operations, provider refunds or external reversal links. Internal reversal TXN-015 cannot refund provider; internal reconciliation TXN-014 does not compare provider records.

Separate wallet IdempotencyService uses optional key user:operation:key, SHA-256 serialized DTO, response_json. Null/blank bypass; same hash returns original initiation result, changed hash ConflictException -> 409 ERR_CONFLICT. Supplier and save transactional, no reservation/row lock, explicit concurrency protection not established. No callback dedup, no expiry. Guard before idempotency on default disabled path, including attempted replay. Distinguish from core financial idempotency. User status GET scoped to owner, 404 absent/nonowned, current local metadata; no global/list/history/CSV/provider receipt or staff/admin inspect. Cached POST result may have old PROCESSING state. Android polls known ID with 1s doubling to max 10s, nominal accumulated delay 120s (HTTP duration additional); failed read ignored until timeout then FAILED state, not proof of provider failure. Intent/key only in memory, no retry original-key UI/reload recovery.

| Recovery scenario | Actual boundary |
|---|---|
| Duplicate initiation | Disabled 422 default; conditional same valid key/hash replay; null/blank bypass |
| Changed payment details | Conditional 409 ERR_CONFLICT with same scope/key |
| Duplicate/delayed/out-of-order notify | Disabled 404 default; conditional metadata overwrite, no event dedup/transition check |
| Browser returns before notification | Navigation only; local status poll, no settlement proof |
| Provider timeout/unknown | No provider query; Android local timeout FAILED |
| Local posting failure | No provider-to-ledger posting exists; no such recovery contract |
| Lost initiation result | Conditional same-key replay if committed; no UI key recovery |
| Status lookup | Known intent ID owner GET; not provider API |
| Receipt/settlement recovery | No external receipt GET, no persisted cross-reload state |
| Card preapprove replay | Sequential consumed check; no atomic single-consumption guarantee |

#### 13.H Wallet saved-card and mobile UI implementation

Wallet is not a persisted balance, Account wrapper or separate money store. No Wallet entity, Wallet ID, currency balance, creation/suspension/closure, wallet-to-wallet/bank transfers, top-up or cash-out. RELOAD mobile phone number is not wallet top-up. Wallet is a saved-card and payment-intent UI/domain, independent User UUID ownership. Existing card metadata operations work independently of PayHere enabled flag. List sorted createdAt desc, default mutation updates only own cards (nonmatching ID clears defaults), delete only matching owner no-op if absent, no provider revocation. No token is returned in CardDto, expiry not returned. No charge uses selected saved card token. Bank-issued Card entity distinct.

Conditional enrollment: CUSTOMER POST cards/session accepts optional returnUrl ignored; random compact UUID, current User, timestamp, consumed false persisted. GET preapprove checks exists/unconsumed only (no lifetime check); renders hosted preapproval amount LKR 10.00, source comment describes tokenization preauth void but no actual provider evidence. Callback checksum, non-success consumes matching session, success checks session, sequential duplicate already, saves token candidate plus brand/last4/expiry, makes default if none, consumes session atomically with save. No explicit token validation, amount/currency/session binding or concurrency lock, no token revocation API. Browser card return uses status or default 2, not state. Core default appCardDeeplink mybank://wallet/card/return, manifest accepts that path; MainActivity tests path startsWith /return instead, payment return example not manifest match; activity refresh does not establish route-local CardsViewModel refresh. Android real repo passes bankapp://wallet/card/return ignored by Core. No verified deep-link acceptance.

| Wallet capability | Actual implementation |
|---|---|
| Navigation | Native WalletRoute via AppNavHost/Sidebar; no web wallet route |
| Repository binding | DEBUG real, !DEBUG fake; explicit source, not assumption about deployed APK |
| Card directory/default/delete | Debug real API and owner persisted data; non-debug seeded in-memory cards and local mutation |
| Card add | Debug gate rejects; conditional Custom Tabs launch, onError empty; non-debug fake example URL, no new card insert |
| QR scan | Camera preview, analyzer closes images without decoding; manual parse and confirmation present |
| Biller list | Static seed/local filtering; picking only navigates; form manually inputs biller ID/reference |
| Reload | Phone/amount UI and request, no carrier fulfillment |
| Payment processing | ViewModel creates and polls, actionUrl Custom Tabs, terminal text; non-debug fake PENDING→PROCESSING→SUCCESS by poll count |
| Payment result | Text success/failure/cancel, not authoritative settlement receipt |
| Fake idempotency | In-memory key→intent, no request fingerprint/user scope; reset process |
| Actual monetary wallet balance/history | Absent |
| Core/card mutation errors | Real repo PATCH/DELETE returns Result<Unit> without checking Retrofit Response success, then VM refresh; no runtime outcome established |

Non-debug fake repository singleton seeds two cards, no real Account data or provider settlement; fake delete auto-promotes remaining card unlike Core. A fake successful payment cannot count as integrated acceptance. #### 13.I Deferred products, merchant and external banking boundaries

| Product | Schema/entity | API/service/UI / provider boundary |
|---|---|---|
| Bank-issued debit/credit/prepaid cards | Card entity/card_number uniqueness, Account mandatory, optional Customer, ACTIVE/BLOCKED/EXPIRED, expiry/issued timestamps | No card issuing/activation/block/replacement/limits/history/processing service/controller found; no connected product. WalletCard separate provider token metadata. No sensitive card values inspected. |
| Loans | Loan PERSONAL/MORTGAGE, PENDING/APPROVED/REJECTED/PAID, amount, remaining balance, rate, term, frequency, dates, Customer FK | LoanController literal 201 apply and 200 list/own/approve/reject; no repository/service/actual state writer. L1 distinct EXT-PAY-006. |
| Repayments | LoanRepayment amount/date/method, loan FK, nullable Transaction FK | No payment, collection or disbursement service/ledger link writer. |
| Credit scores | CreditScore Customer FK, score, evaluation_date, source, notes | No calculation/query/credit bureau integration; analytics controller has unrelated literal fraud/spending placeholders, reserve Part 15. |
| Savings/Checking/Fixed Deposit | Existing Account product labels | ACC-001 retained; no interest accrual/maturity/fee or product schedule engine found. |
| Recurring/standing/scheduled transfers | No operational contract established | No scheduler or financial recurring operation identified. |
| Merchant registration/accounts/links/QR/invoices/bill payouts | Wallet QR/BILL/RELOAD DTO and intent scaffolding; no merchant/biller domain delivery | Generic checkout only, merchantRef/billerId/reference not bound; no actual merchant settlement, payment links, invoice/report/refund or merchant onboarding. |
| External bank/beneficiaries | Android preview bank field | No external API/beneficiary domain or settlement. |

Loan exact routes prefix /api/v1/loans: POST /apply CUSTOMER 201 Loan application submitted, GET root ADMIN/TELLER 200 List of all loans, GET /my CUSTOMER 200 User's loan details, PUT /approve/{id}, /reject/{id} MANAGER 200 Loan approved/Loan rejected. No actual persisted decision/ownership lookup. No loan UI identified. Schema-only card/score/repayment not separately scored; planning gaps. No loan or card test execution. #### EXT-PAY-001 — PayHere wallet payment initiation and hosted checkout

- **Review part:** 13
- **User roles:** CUSTOMER
- **User objective:** Create a QR, mobile reload or bill payment order and enter hosted checkout.
- **Workflow boundary:** Android Wallet forms and Retrofit initiation → Core service gate → conditional local intent and browser checkout form; stops before validated provider payment or delivery. No web page; no internal deposit or Pay rescoring.
- **Complete workflow steps:** WalletRoute QR/manual parse, reload or bill form → PaymentFlowViewModel generates UUID key and invokes repository → debug real Retrofit POST /api/v1/wallet/payments/{qr|reload|bill} → CUSTOMER principal → requirePayHereEnabled (default false, 422 before writes). Conditional enabled path creates PROCESSING intent from amount/type and generic description, returns checkout URL → GET direct Core /payhere/checkout/{intentId} loads local order and renders auto-submit HTML signed form. No actual provider visit. Non-debug fake returns local PENDING intent without checkout.
- **Frontend / Android:** Android has manual QR parsing/confirmation, camera preview analyzer only closes frames, no decode; reload and bill validators, seed billers, selection not passed to BillerPayScreen; no saved card ID sent. ProcessingScreen can launch Custom Tabs via actionUrl. Non-debug fake build not provider-backed. No web wallet UI/client.
- **Next.js BFF / API integration:** WalletApi and real repository direct bearer Retrofit, amount {value:Double,currency}; QR qrData/merchantRef, reload msisdn, bill billerId/reference accepted but not persisted/used by createIntent. Optional Idempotency-Key. Generic web BFF can forward authenticated wallet JSON with CSRF; /wallet/payhere and webhook locally blocked 404.
- **Spring Boot implementation:** WalletController /api/v1/wallet class CUSTOMER; service guard; PayHereGatewayController conditional payhere.enabled=true; generates provider form with configured merchant, local intent ID/order, amount formatted two decimals, currency, description, placeholder payer fields, constructed return/cancel/notify URLs, request checksum. No direct provider API client; fake PspClient unused. No Core bean validation on request DTO or explicit amount/currency check in createIntent.
- **Database / ledger:** wallet_payment_intents string primary ID, user UUID, type/status, DOUBLE amount, currency, description, checkout URL and timestamps; destination fields/providerClientSecret/idempotencyKey remain unset by this flow. Separate wallet_idempotency optional; no Account/Customer/Journal FK or balance mutation.
- **External dependencies:** PayHere hosted checkout would require actual merchant configuration/public Core origin and provider readiness; no provider contacted. No FastAPI, payment network or saved-card charge.
- **Authorization:** CUSTOMER only JSON; conditional public hosted launch by intent ID, no user token required for provider-facing routes.
- **Success, failure and recovery behavior:** Disabled 422 before state changes; direct PayHere 404; if enabled create response is initiation only, not settlement. No authoritative receipt, commercial fulfilment or durable reload recovery; non-debug fake success is simulated.
- **Existing automated tests:** FinancialTransactionApiIntegrationTest asserts disabled POST/404; web e2e mock tests routing only; no enabled provider integration test found.
- **Available live verification:** None attributable to actual provider or integrated wallet stack execution during this review; source only.
- **Completeness level:** **L2 — One-sided implementation**
- **Independent status:** Intentionally disabled
- **Evidence confidence:** **Source-confirmed**
- **Supported behavior:** Meaningful gated local order persistence and hosted HTML construction, native client and forms.
- **Unsupported / incomplete behavior:** No active checkout, verified merchant delivery, saved-card use, bank funding, ledger settlement, provider transaction reference or payout.

#### EXT-PAY-002 — PayHere notification and external payment lifecycle metadata

- **Review part:** 13
- **User roles:** Provider callback; browser return/cancel visitor; CUSTOMER owner status
- **User objective:** Record provider notification status against a local payment intent.
- **Workflow boundary:** Conditional hosted callback and status transition metadata only; no authoritative settlement or journal posting. Legacy generic webhook retirement is a separate guard, not a completed callback system.
- **Complete workflow steps:** Default false: no gateway controller, public direct paths 404; web origin rejects. If enabled: form-encoded POST /payhere/notify verifies provider checksum, reads order_id/status_code/status_message, looks up intent, maps code to status, overwrites description and saves in transaction; unknown order returns ok, invalid checksum invalid. Browser return/cancel only HTML deep-link navigation, no write. Legacy authenticated webhook with required params returns 410 no repository use.
- **Frontend / Android:** Android polling can consume owner status; result text is metadata, not receipt; fake repository independently simulates progression. Browser return not proof. No web UI.
- **Next.js BFF / API integration:** Direct Core provider form route, no JWT/CSRF on payhere/**; BFF never forwards it. No client callback action.
- **Spring Boot implementation:** Conditional PayHereGatewayController and PayHereSignature; checks checksum with configured secret but no separate binding of configured merchant or stored amount/currency, no provider payment_id persistence, no transition/dedup/locking rules, no status query to provider. SUCCESS/FAILED/CANCELED can be overwritten by subsequent valid notification; PENDING declared but creation PROCESSING. Legacy WalletWebhookController always 410 after auth/binding.
- **Database / ledger:** Updates wallet_payment_intents status, description and updatedAt only. No callback event table, unique provider ID, journal link, settlement timestamp, ledger balance/projection. Return/cancel no persistence.
- **External dependencies:** PayHere if enabled only; no provider API, callback execution, external reconciliation or FastAPI.
- **Authorization:** Conditional public callback verified by checksum, not customer session; legacy webhook authenticated any role at filter and no mutation; BFF local 404.

#### EXT-PAY-003 — Wallet payment status retrieval and initiation replay

- **Review part:** 13
- **User roles:** CUSTOMER
- **User objective:** Retrieve an owned payment intent and recover its local initiation result.
- **Workflow boundary:** Existing owner-scoped GET works independent of enablement; distinct wallet initiation idempotency service exists behind gate. No provider receipt or durable UI recovery; not TXN-008/PAY-009.
- **Complete workflow steps:** Known intent ID → GET /api/v1/wallet/payments/{intentId} → currentUser.requireUserId → findByIdAndUserId → DTO or 404. Android debug polling after successful initiation: 1s exponential backoff cap 10s, nominal delay budget 120s, exposes checkout action once, terminal result or FAILED timeout; no persistent ID/key. Non-debug fake uses local polling steps. Conditional POST optional key user:operation:key, JSON SHA-256 request hash, cached serialized response if same, conflict if changed, supplier and response save transactionally; null/blank bypass.
- **Frontend / Android:** WalletRoute/PaymentFlowViewModel/ProcessingScreen/PaymentResultScreen; status display no full receipt/history. No web wallet client or history. Fake status does not query provider.
- **Next.js BFF / API integration:** Retrofit owner GET; BFF generic authenticated JSON, no-store; POST header optional, GET requires ID not key. DTO intentId,status,amount,description,returnUrl,providerClientSecret (unset in actual create).
- **Spring Boot implementation:** WalletServiceImpl owner query even disabled. Separate IdempotencyService with storageKey, hash, response_json; no PROCESSING record or lock before supplier, no dedicated retry executor; concurrency guarantee not established. Cached initiation DTO may be stale status; GET current local state, not provider settlement.
- **Database / ledger:** wallet_idempotency idem_key PK, request_hash, response_json, created_at; wallet_payment_intents ID primary only, optional idempotency_key column not written. No relation to core_transaction_idempotency or journal.
- **External dependencies:** None for local read; provider state depends on conditional callback only.
- **Authorization:** CUSTOMER, owner predicate; missing/nonowned indistinguishable 404 ERR_NOT_FOUND; key scope user and operation.
- **Success, failure and recovery behavior:** Owner status GET 200 or 404; enabled same key replay / changed request 409 ERR_CONFLICT; disabled guard precedes replay; timeout locally FAILED but external state uncertain; no persisted recovery, retry by original key screen or list.
- **Existing automated tests:** WalletOwnershipTest mocked query; IdempotencyTest mocked repository checks cached result, actor scope, null/blank bypass, conflict and replay. Mock web routing status/CSRF. No concurrency or actual provider verification.
- **Available live verification:** None attributable to actual provider or integrated wallet stack execution during this review; source only.
- **Completeness level:** **L3 — Partially functional**
- **Independent status:** Partial; new external payment initiation intentionally disabled
- **Evidence confidence:** **Source-confirmed**

- **Unsupported / incomplete behavior:** No status lookup by provider/key, receipt/list, callback dedup, safe cross-reload recovery or proven concurrent initiation guarantee.

Return/cancel HTML only.
- **Frontend / Android:** Debug real Retrofit + Custom Tabs launch; AddCard onError callback empty; non-debug fake session example URL, no new-card insertion. Manifest matches mybank /card/return, MainActivity checks /return and refreshes activity CardsViewModel, not proven route-local refresh; Core default card deep link differs from repository-supplied ignored return URL.
- **Next.js BFF / API integration:** POST /api/v1/wallet/cards/session CUSTOMER, response sessionId/url; GET /payhere/preapprove/{sessionId}, POST /notify/preapprove form, GET /cards/return and /cards/cancel. BFF generic JSON only, public provider paths 404 at web.
- **Spring Boot implementation:** PayHereCardController conditional true, checksum check, token candidate, method/last4/expiry parse, first card default; no explicit token validation, configured merchant/expected amount/currency association, session expiry time enforcement or atomic consumed lock. Sequential duplicate returns already; normal invalid/ignored/unknown-session/already/OK responses text. Browser return may default status 2 but does not persist.
- **Database / ledger:** wallet_card_sessions PK string id; wallet_cards UUID PK, user_id, brand/last4/expiry, nonnull customer_token, is_default, created_at; no DB FK to user/Account/Customer and no token/default uniqueness. Session and card save in same transactional callback, no ledger posting.

- **Authorization:** CUSTOMER session create; public direct callback/launch if enabled, checksum, session ID; no role-based provider session.
- **Success, failure and recovery behavior:** Default disabled 422 / direct 404. Conditional sequential consumed flag; no explicit expiration or provider readback; return navigation not authoritative enrollment proof.

- **Workflow boundary:** Existing owner-scoped card list/default/delete remain reachable even while PayHere disabled; separate from bank-issued cards or stored-value wallet. Android debug actual API, non-debug simulated local data.
- **Complete workflow steps:** Wallet navigation → CardsViewModel refresh → GET /wallet/cards → owner query sorted createdAt desc → DTO safe metadata; PATCH /cards/{id}:default loops own cards sets selected true others false, saveAll; DELETE /cards/{id} owner lookup then delete if present; both 204. Nonmatching default ID clears own defaults; missing delete no-op. No provider revocation. Android refresh after action.
- **Frontend / Android:** WalletHome/CardList reachable; fake non-debug cards seeded, local default/delete, fake delete auto-default first remaining unlike Core. Debug repo calls API, does not inspect Retrofit Response<Unit> success on PATCH/DELETE; refresh afterward. Card UI expiry zeros due DTO omission. No web page.
- **Next.js BFF / API integration:** WalletApi direct Retrofit and generic BFF authenticated/CSRF JSON; no payhere gate for these three operations.
- **Spring Boot implementation:** WalletController class CUSTOMER; WalletServiceImpl currentUser owner query; no separate actual bank card issuance, no proof saved card used in payment initiation.
- **Database / ledger:** wallet_cards user UUID, card UUID, token/metadata/default; CardDto id, brand, last4, isDefault, createdAt, excludes token and expiry. No Wallet balance/Account relation. No provider or journal changes.

- **Authorization:** CUSTOMER only; owner list/filter, delete owner scoped; UUID parse for mutations.

### Part 14 — Android bank-app

**Status:** COMPLETE — source-based completeness assessment; no build, test or runtime verification. All four application main branches unchanged from Part 13. Android inventory: 367 tree entries, 227 blob paths; one app module, six Retrofit interfaces (27 methods), 11 registered authenticated destinations. Existing feature scores retained. Only two independently scoped native configuration policies receive new records.

#### 14.1 Architecture and source inventory

Hilt application and MainActivity → Compose auth/lock gate → AppNavHost and feature screens → ViewModels/StateFlow → repository interfaces and actual Hilt bindings → Retrofit/Moshi/OkHttp → direct Core bearer endpoints → existing Core persistence/ledger or KYC orchestration. No web BFF or CSRF cookie for ordinary native requests. Local encrypted token DataStore/Keystore, lock SharedPreferences, default Account DataStore and volatile screen/VM state are distinct. Wallet is the only discovered alternate repository binding. All source paths indexed at the pinned bank-app main; binary resources are enumerated, not interpreted as executable code.

#### 14.3 Startup, navigation, authorization and complete meaningful screen inventory

App.kt Hilt App; MainActivity installs platform splash, separate AnimatedSplashScreen has no established caller. Login/Register toggle remembered. LoginViewModel autoLogin observes encrypted token flow, calls validate-token; success username/role state, reads lock preferences, optional AppLocker then AppNavHost starts home. LoginScreen has role mapping callback but MainActivity supplies no-op; AppNavHost receives username only. Eligible non-CUSTOMER roles can enter same customer-oriented graph, not separate staff role workspace. Clarification to AUTH-003: role information is returned and stored, but this does not mean role-aware mobile destination selection. Preserve previous classification; Core role, session and ownership checks remain authoritative (AUTH-008). No independent native staff/admin operations. Sidebar popUpTo start, save/restore, singleTop; account history navigateUp. No bottom navigation discovered.

#### 14.4 Authentication, profile and local protection

Register only User identity, not Customer: 500ms username availability debounce (>=3), email regex, 8+ chars uppercase/digit/special, matching confirmation; POST register generic boolean failure, success returns login. Core inactive CUSTOMER registration and email verification; no native verification/resend/reset completion/deep link. Forgot password dialog checks email roughly (@), POST email, generic success independent of account existence; actual reset requires web/email link. No real mail verified. Login real token/username/role. AuthStoreImpl stores token only; username/role in VM. AES/GCM encrypted DataStore secure_prefs using AES256 Android Keystore; token restore validates against Core, any failure (even network) logs out/clears. 401 asynchronous local clear via active interceptor; no proactive renewal/refresh. Core JWT/session fingerprint/authorization eligibility, username/role/employee state remain authoritative. Logout server best effort then local token cleared, server outcome uncertain if failed. Password change Core deletes sessions, app success message not immediate explicit re-login until 401. Username availability 450ms then password dialog sends username/currentPassword to profile update, login under new username; no separate server verify-password call, limited failure recovery. Email change is pending verification; local copied requested email not authoritative re-read. Profile GET User fields nullable sanitized, userId/username/name/address/city/state/country/postal/home/work/office/mobile/email/roleName; role chip, no Customer DOB/gender/verification/avatar contract; PUT map edit local copy on success, blanks may diverge from Core semantics. No Customer sync inferred.

Settings app lock enable/change/disable; min4 digit setup confirmation, unlock input max6, string PIN/flag app-private SharedPreferences app_lock_prefs, no user scope, no established attempt limit/recovery. BiometricHelper availability WEAK or DEVICE_CREDENTIAL, prompt STRONG or DEVICE_CREDENTIAL; fallback PIN unavailable/failure/error. Uses OS enrollment, not bank biometric MFA. Gate after successful login/restore, no universal background resume hook. Preferences persist logout, changes not proof immediate universal relock. No other settings beyond Version/Logout. No notification controls actually connected. #### 14.5 API-to-screen matrix — every Retrofit method

Paths relative to configured Core base URL. All ordinary native calls bypass BFF. Auth public first four; all remaining authenticated unless specified. Wallet real calls only DEBUG. Response<Unit> bodies not meaningful DTOs. No TransactionsApi or other native internal posting/receipt interface.

| Interface / HTTP | Request / response | Consumer / Core boundary |
|---|---|---|
| AuthApi GET /api/v1/auth/available | username → Response<Unit> | RegisterVM/ProfileVM availability; public |
| AuthApi POST /api/v1/auth/register | RegisterRequest(username,email,password) → Response<Unit> | RegisterVM; public User create only |
| AuthApi POST /api/v1/auth/login | LoginRequest → token/username/role | LoginVM / username change; public |
| AuthApi POST /api/v1/auth/forgot-password | ForgotPasswordRequest(email) → Response<Unit> | login dialog; public |
| AuthApi GET /api/v1/auth/validate-token | ValidateTokenResponse username/role | restore; bearer |
| AuthApi POST /api/v1/auth/logout | Response<Unit> | logout; bearer |
| AccountsApi GET /api/v1/branches | List<BranchNet> id Int/name | OpenAccountVM; Core four roles |
| AccountsApi POST /api/v1/accounts | AccountOpenRequest(type,initialDeposit Double,branchId Int) → AccountResponseNet | OpenAccountVM; CUSTOMER, KYC and Customer prerequisites; no key sent |
| AccountsApi GET /api/v1/accounts/{id}/transactions | List<TransactionNet> | AccountTransactionsVM; owner/staff |
| AccountsApi GET /api/v1/accounts/my | List<AccountNet> | MyAccountsVM/HomeVM; CUSTOMER |
| CustomerApi PUT /api/v1/customers/me | CustomerRequestBody → CustomerResponseDto | CustomerRegistrationVM; auth + latest approved KYC |
| CustomerApi POST /api/v1/customers | same DTO | conditional fallback 404/405/501; staff-only Core, no valid ordinary customer fallback |
| KycApi POST /kyc/upload | multipart file,type → UploadedPart(id) | capture/upload; owner |
| KycApi POST /kyc/submit | docFrontId,docBackId,selfieId,addressId,consent → caseId/status | review; no X-Idempotency-Key |
| KycApi GET /kyc/me | KycCaseStatusResponse | KycStatus/MyAccounts; own latest |
| KycApi GET /kyc/{id}/checks | List<KycCheckDto> | status; owner/Admin |
| ProfileApi GET /api/v1/users/me | UserProfileDto | profile and customer UUID |
| ProfileApi PUT /api/v1/users/me | map<String,String> → Response<Unit> | inline edit / username / email |
| ProfileApi PUT /api/v1/auth/change-password | map → Response<Unit> | profile password dialog |
| WalletApi GET /api/v1/wallet/cards | card list | CardsVM; CUSTOMER owner |
| WalletApi POST /api/v1/wallet/cards/session | returnUrl query → session | add card; default 422 disabled |
| WalletApi PATCH /api/v1/wallet/cards/{id}:default | Response<Unit> | default local metadata |
| WalletApi DELETE /api/v1/wallet/cards/{id} | Response<Unit> | local metadata removal |
| WalletApi POST /api/v1/wallet/payments/qr | QR request + Idempotency-Key → PaymentIntentDto | PaymentFlowVM; default 422 |
| WalletApi POST /api/v1/wallet/payments/reload | reload request + Idempotency-Key → PaymentIntentDto | same; default 422 |
| WalletApi POST /api/v1/wallet/payments/bill | bill request + Idempotency-Key → PaymentIntentDto | same; default 422 |
| WalletApi GET /api/v1/wallet/payments/{intentId} | PaymentIntentDto | owner poll; conditional on accepted intent |

All 27 declarations have a source consumer (including conditional fallback, hosted/disabled flow); no evidence all execute successfully. #### 14.6 KYC and Customer onboarding

KycRoute DEV_PREVIEW=false in both variants. Four steps; TakePicture FileProvider cache URI or image-only photo picker; document preview/remove. KycUtils downsample for analysis not upload compression; Laplacian blur >=.10, glare >=.60, >=3 corners. SelfieLivenessScreen real CameraX+ML Kit centering/blink/yaw assistance; cleanup; callback liveness and faceMatch 0.9 placeholder, not authoritative ML. Selection triggers immediate multipart upload of file/type via resolver copied temp file; MIME default JPEG; no explicit file-size limit/deletion/compression. Core allows JPEG/PNG/WebP, 10MB and 20/day; Android no PDF. VM volatile upload ID map, failures ignored, remove URI not ID clear; submission requires four URIs + consent and IDs. JSON submit no key; recognized six case statuses navigates status, false/exception home. Core active case returns existing PENDING/AUTO_REVIEW/UNDER_REVIEW/NEEDS_MORE_INFO; orchestrator uses FastAPI and persists actual checks. Poll every 3s while active until APPROVED/REJECTED/NEEDS_MORE_INFO; no fixed deadline; errors null fallback UNDER_REVIEW and empty checks; latest case resume not draft resume; no dedicated RFI correction/rejected restart. Approved CTA.

MyAccounts 404 message Customer not found triggers latest KYC check: APPROVED register else verification, including unknown. Manual first/last/gender/email/phone/DOB YYYY-MM-DD/address optional/status ACTIVE; User UUID fetched from users/me if required; Core principal overrides, requires latest APPROVED and upserts linked Customer. 409 maps not approved, self endpoint 404/405/501 fallback staff-only POST, native DTO id vs Core customerId optional and ignored; success Home, no durable recovery. #### 14.9 Local state, persistence, lifecycle and recovery

| State | Storage/ownership | Logout / restart / recovery |
|---|---|---|
| bearer token | encrypted DataStore + Keystore | clear on logout/401, validate on restore; temporary error clears; no refresh |
| username/role | LoginState | recreated by validate-token/login; no separate role routing |
| PIN/enabled | app-private device-wide SharedPreferences | survives logout/restart; standard device backup excluded |
| default Account | device-wide UUID DataStore | survives logout/restart; Home falls back owned account |
| KYC files/URIs/upload IDs | cache files + VM map | no durable resume or cleanup policy; latest status read only |
| Account create/profile/form | Compose/VM memory | no durable operation key/draft; uncertain outcome unresolved |
| history account number visibility | rememberSaveable | local display state; not financial persistence |
| Payments draft | local enum + strings | volatile, no Core effects |
| Wallet intent/key | VM memory | no durable receipt recovery |
| fake Wallet | singleton in-memory | may survive logout/process lifetime; not user-scoped; process reset |
| Android backup | manifest false + legacy/cloud/device-transfer exclusions | fresh device expected login/preferences; no OEM/runtime guarantee |

Legacy and modern nine exclusions root/file/database/sharedpref/external/device_root/device_file/device_database/device_sharedpref, path dot. No cross-platform-transfer include. README documents OEM caveat. No actual migration tested. Cache retention/deletion and Core remote session revocation separate. [app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-app/blob/9d98ba24cb754b8295bd58770cd502438d3b7b38/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml); [README.md](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-app/blob/9d98ba24cb754b8295bd58770cd502438d3b7b38/README.md); [backup_rules.xml](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-app/blob/9d98ba24cb754b8295bd58770cd502438d3b7b38/app/src/main/res/xml/backup_rules.xml); [data_extraction_rules.xml](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-app/blob/9d98ba24cb754b8295bd58770cd502438d3b7b38/app/src/main/res/xml/data_extraction_rules.xml); [Auth007PolicyTest.kt](https://github.com/gimesha-adikari/bank-app/blob/9d98ba24cb754b8295bd58770cd502438d3b7b38/app/src/test/java/com/bankingsystem/mobile/Auth007PolicyTest.kt)

#### ANDROID-002 — Native app-private data backup and device-transfer exclusion

- **Review part:** 14 — Android bank-app
- **User roles:** All native users; device migration/restore lifecycle
- **User objective:** Prevent standard Android backup or device transfer from carrying private application state into another installation.
- **Workflow boundary:** Native manifest and standard backup/transfer resource policy; distinct from same-device encrypted bearer restore, local app lock and default Account preferences.
- **Complete workflow steps:** Main manifest sets allowBackup=false and references legacy full-backup-content and modern dataExtractionRules; legacy rules exclude all nine specified root/file/database/sharedpref/external/device-protected domains at path dot; modern cloud-backup and device-transfer blocks repeat exclusions; fresh device expected to require login and local preference setup.
- **Frontend / Android:** Applies to main source set; no debug/release override found for backup. README documents fresh authentication/preferences and OEM caveat.
- **Next.js BFF / API integration:** No BFF or API invocation caused by backup configuration.
- **Spring Boot implementation:** Core session/Customer/Account records are not erased or revoked by these native rules.
- **Database / ledger:** Local DataStore encrypted token, SharedPreferences lock and default Account DataStore are app-private state. Cache retention/deletion is separate; no server DB effect.
- **External dependencies:** Android standard backup and transfer framework; device/OEM behavior depends on platform.
- **Authorization:** Local exclusion policy, not server MFA or authorization.
- **Success, failure and recovery behavior:** Source policy excludes standard restore/transfer. Fresh installation signs in again; existing backend records remain subject to Core eligibility; no universal OEM guarantee.
- **Existing automated tests:** Auth007PolicyTest checks allowBackup=false and legacy/modern exclusion domains; no migration/device execution.
- **Available live verification:** None; no backup, restore, OEM transfer, emulator or device test.
- **Completeness level:** L4 — Functionally implemented (source-defined backup/transfer policy)
- **Independent status:** None
- **Evidence confidence:** Source-confirmed
- **Supported behavior:** Explicit legacy and modern exclusions for standard Android app-private data backup and device transfer.
- **Unsupported / incomplete behavior:** Not proof of all OEM transfer behavior or actual runtime migration; no remote-session revocation, secure deletion or general cache cleanup guaranteed.

Generic proxy allowlisted request headers accept, accept-language, cache-control, content-type, idempotency-key, if-match, if-none-match, x-correlation-id; response content-type/cache-control/location/retry-after; no-store, upstream stream. Cookie bearer injection and unsafe-method CSRF; specialized auth, 401 cookie deletion; 502/504 transport and 500 misconfiguration; no automatic mutation retry. Generic refresh and provider/wallet webhook blocked. Verify-email redirect token-free 303, prefetch 204; reset query rejected. KYC specialized handlers forward unversioned routes, 11 MiB body bound, X-idempotency-key translation and authorized file response with disposition/sandbox/nosniff. Generic forwarding does not implement literal endpoints. Web API clients accounts/admin-access/auth/customers/kyc/staff/tellers/transactions/users; earlier owners preserved, reversal helper disconnected from page.

RoleSeeder order1 ensures ADMIN/EMPLOYEE/MANAGER/TELLER/CUSTOMER case-insensitively; BranchSeeder order1 creates missing branches (ACC-002); DefaultUsersInitializer order2 creates configured missing users ADMIN/CUSTOMER/TELLER/MANAGER by username, BCrypt/role/active/timestamp. No Employee/Customer creation or profile gate in these classes.

Dev example DB loopback3307/SMTP1025/server8080; JWT expiration86400000ms issuer bank-core audience bank-core-api; verification24h, reset1h; AUTH-016 Caffeine limits IP20/30s, user10/60s, pair5/60s, cache10000/15m, retry cap60s. No secret values. Source config not actual deployment. ML config as above. KYC filesystem default uploads/example ./storage/kyc, date directories and UUID names/checksum/metadata in KycUpload; authorized retrieval and best-effort file deletion then metadata. Upload 10MiB jpg/png/webp, 20 per user UTC day; BFF 11MiB. No remote store or orphan cleanup proven; earlier KYC records retain ownership. ## 15.F Scheduled work, email, error, logging and audit boundaries

| Capability | Actual source behavior | Boundary / dependency |
|---|---|---|
| Core scheduling | @EnableScheduling; KycAutoReviewOrchestratorImpl default fixed delay 10s, example60s, up to50 pending, conditional processing mark, transaction/checks and under-review fallback; synchronous submission path also exists | Existing KYC ownership; no financial scheduler |
| Retention | KycRetentionService 03:15 daily, approved/rejected updated before 30 days, attempts four file deletes and catches exceptions | KYC-010; no generic purge |
| FastAPI background | Aggregate BackgroundTasks log summary; optional calibration CSV write synchronous, default false | No durable queue/retry |
| Email | EmailServiceImpl JavaMailSender synchronous, configured base/frontend/from/brand, escaped HTML/plain templates registration/resend/reset/change-email | No delivery history, durable queue, retry or actual send proof |
| Errors | Core advice 400 validation, 403, 404, 422 business except reversal missing404, 409 conflict/key, 503 retry; Jackson Hibernate6/JavaTime no timestamps; Next preserves statuses/code, typed ApiError; native AccountRepo parses message/CustomerMissing; FastAPI detail | No universal envelope or coverage of all filter/default errors |
| Diagnostics | Logback stdout root INFO/project DEBUG; protected auth MDC/TurboFilter excludes sensitive detail; method/route/status/correlation UUID; Next incoming query suppression; Android debug BASIC/nondebug NONE | No centralized audit/log retention/tracing/alerts |
| Health | Core literal status/health, Actuator dependency but no explicit dependency readiness mapping; FastAPI basic public process health | No DB/SMTP/ML readiness verified |
| Audit / retention | AuditLog/Notification/Device/SupportTicket entities no independent service established; token expiry/consume, verification delete, reset used, logout/revoke, KYC terminal file deletion, immutable ledger/retained account closure, Customer deletion FK, wallet local metadata delete | No generalized audit, data purge or backup/restore workflow |

## 10. Standard feature record template

Copy this structure into the appropriate part when a feature is actually reviewed; replace placeholders only with observed evidence:

```md
#### [FEATURE-ID] — [Feature name]

- **Review part:** [00–16]
- **User roles:** [roles and permissions]
- **User objective:** [reason this feature is used]
- **Workflow boundary:** [entry condition through observable outcome]
- **Complete workflow steps:** [ordered stages and branch conditions]
- **Frontend / Android:** [routes/screens/components/action links, or N/A]
- **Next.js BFF / API integration:** [client, endpoint, method, payload, response, error handling, or N/A]
- **Spring Boot implementation:** [controllers/services/validation, or N/A]
- **Database / ledger:** [entities, tables, migrations, journal effects, or N/A]
- **External dependencies:** [FastAPI, provider, mail, etc., or N/A]
- **Authorization:** [authn/authz, role/ownership checks]
- **Success, failure and recovery behavior:** [actual user-visible states]
- **Existing automated tests:** [file paths, scope, mock boundaries]
- **Available live verification:** [dated evidence, environment and scope, or none]
- **Completeness level:** [0–5, or unscored when insufficient evidence]
- **Independent status:** [status, if applicable]
- **Evidence confidence:** [one of the five evidence labels]
- **Supported behavior:** [precisely what works from inspected evidence]
- **Unsupported / incomplete behavior:** [precise missing portions]
- **Source references:** [commit-pinned repo links and file paths]
- **Future implementation opportunities:** [possible follow-ups, not defects]
```

### Part 14 native dependency reconciliation

| Dependency | Reviewed boundary |
|---|---|
| AUTH-001–014 → Android | Direct bearer/restore, common graph and local app lock; Core remains authoritative |
| KYC-013/014 → DASH-016 → ACC-015 | Native KYC approval and Customer creation precede opening; no durable KYC/opening recovery |
| DASH-008/009 → TXN-018 | Real scoped balance/history separate from Home demonstration data |
| TXN-017/PAY-015 → Core financial contracts | Preview only; no native posting/receipt consumers |
| EXT-PAY-001–005 → Android | Debug real gated flow, non-debug fake; no duplicate scoring |
| ANDROID-001/002 → AUTH-011/012/DASH-015 | Build transport and backup policy distinct from local auth/preferences |
| Android → Part 15 | Remaining platform API inventory deferred; no Part 15 assessment begun |

### Part 15 dependency additions

- PLATFORM-009/010: Core DB schema and startup roles/logins underpin AUTH and staff eligibility; linked Employee/Customer still separate.
- PLATFORM-011: auth verification/reset/change-email depend on configured SMTP and link origins.
- PLATFORM-012/013/014: errors, safe diagnostics and process health support existing journeys without establishing uniform contract, audit or readiness.
- PLATFORM-015/016: separate debug and local calibration developer tools, not verified accuracy or banking workflows.
- PLATFORM-001–008: no implemented domain logic merely because a route responds successfully.

## 13. Known evidence limitations

- Part 00 inspected GitHub repository metadata, the default-branch refs, three known commits and root-level directories **only**.
- No frontend-to-backend workflow tracing, test inspection, API verification or live-stack acceptance was performed during Part 00.
- Matching the named local commits to GitHub main does not establish the absence of subsequent unpublished changes.
- No expected local commit was provided for bank-app, so local-vs-GitHub parity for the Android app is unknown.
- Future parts should provide source links pinned to inspected commits, distinguish documentation from independent verification, and disclose relevant access or version gaps.

- Part 01 inspected GitHub source only at the four pinned SHAs above, including web BFF, Spring security/services/entities, Android auth/storage/lock, and FastAPI internal authorization. No code was executed, no credentials tested, and no commits modified application sources.
- The committed Playwright tests run a mock core via `e2e/mock-bank-core.mjs`; they do not establish a real Spring/MySQL/Mailpit workflow. The Spring integration and unit tests were read as code, not executed in this review.
- No historical F1–F8 real-stack reports were found as readable evidence within the four GitHub trees. Their contents may exist outside these repositories; none were used to claim live verification.
- Android device/emulator runtime and email SMTP delivery were not observed. Hence all Part 01 evidence confidence is Source-confirmed and no Level 5 is asserted.
- Config-dependent email-change link destination and cross-platform difference in password-change sign-out are identified as completeness boundaries, not established live defects.
- Features not found in inspected source (MFA, social login, device-session management, etc.) are catalogued only as unsupported possibilities, not falsely scored as implemented.
- Part 02 inspected source only at pinned GitHub SHAs; no application source changed, and no tests, device/emulator runs, ML inference, real document processing, SMTP, or database mutations were performed.
- No attributable historical F1–F8 actual integrated-stack execution reports or verifiable outputs were accessible in the reviewed four GitHub repository trees; web Playwright uses mock bank-core.
- KycMlContractIT is environment-gated integration test source, not independently confirmed successful execution. Optional ONNX model weights are not tracked in reviewed bank-service source; local/external model snapshots were not available for verification.
- Part 02 found explicit source limitations in NEEDS_MORE_INFO customer correction, Android placeholder face/liveness indicators, mobile submission recovery and upload-draft persistence.
- Part 02 confirms latest approved KYC and separately saved Customer record are both required for self-service account opening; this review does not certify account-opening/ledger, Admin-workspace completeness, staff lifecycle or whole Android platform.

- Part 03 rechecked four GitHub main baselines and traced web dashboard, profile, BFF, Spring User/Customer/Account APIs and Android Home/Profile/My Accounts navigation and local settings. bank-service/FastAPI does not participate in dashboard or profile reads/updates.
- Web dashboard gets the Customer record for existence, account list for stored per-account status/balance and conditional latest KYC for no-account eligibility. It has no aggregated balance or real recent activity feed. Navigation links are not destination workflow verification.
- Web /customer/profile only reads User; banking Customer fields are maintained through /customer/onboarding with approved latest KYC. General backend User contact edits are available via Android, not a general web User editor; overlapping fields need not synchronize.

- Account lifecycle (04), transactions and ledger (05), Internal Pay (06), staff Customer management (07), and full Android app (14) remain not reviewed beyond Part 03 integration boundaries.

- Part 04 checked all four prior GitHub main refs at pinned commits, then source-reviewed bank-web, bank-core and bank-app account lifecycle. No Spring account-lifecycle call to bank-service/FastAPI exists, so no artificial FastAPI dependency.
- Core offers SAVINGS/CHECKING/FIXED_DEPOSIT with LKR opening minimums 1000/0/5000; Branch is persisted and required, but branch list ignores pagination, lacks status and branch admin mutations are stubs. No demonstrated interest/term/fee product lifecycle.
- Customer self-service POST /accounts enforces role, linked banking Customer and latest APPROVED KYC; Teller POST /accounts/{userUuid} uses a different role and bypasses latest KYC. Neither opening path checks Customer.status ACTIVE or account count.
- Self-service web opening holds page-memory Idempotency-Key and decimal string, Core persists user-scoped idempotency claim and account+ledger/funding under one transaction. Claims replay successful response; no-key direct API, Teller and Android lack this durable contract. Positive opening deposit posts from system vault to Customer liability; zero Checking does not post journal/transaction.
- Account UUID, 10-digit account number, User UUID, Customer UUID and integer Branch ID are distinct. AccountResponseDTO omits branch/currency/owner; customer /accounts/my lists all statuses and by-ID reads enforce ownership; staff /accounts directory has no pagination.
- Staff PUT changes type/branch (reuses opening DTO and ignores initialDeposit); staff-only DELETE checks ACTIVE and zero Account.balance and ledger-derived balance under a posting-compatible row lock, persists CLOSED and retains history. changeAccountStatus for FROZEN/ACTIVE exists only as service method without a route; no customer closure.
- Android opening has type and branch input but Double amount serialization, no Idempotency-Key/recovery and unwired KYC banner. Dashboard account display and My Accounts default choice remain Part 03; deeper ledger Part 05 and staff Part 08 and Android Part 14 remain NOT REVIEWED.

Transfer uses same infrastructure but whole Pay remains Part 06.
